jobs.title: PhD Candidate in International Business
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is at NTNU in Ålesund at the School of International Business. We are looking for candidates with an educational background in international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees, including technology management, innovation management, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management, will also be considered.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate and, at the same time, gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a future career in higher education and research, both within and beyond academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, automation, and remote operations are transforming not only where people work, but also how work is organized. As technologies redistribute tasks, expertise, decision-making authority, and responsibility across people and locations, they can reconfigure established roles, relationships, and ways of working. These changes raise important leadership questions: How do leaders help employees navigate changing roles and responsibilities? How are trust, shared understanding, and coordination maintained when work becomes increasingly technology-mediated and geographically distributed? And how do leadership practices emerge as established authority structures are reshaped by technology?

These leadership challenges can become particularly pronounced in culturally diverse teams, where members may differ in their expectations regarding leadership, authority, autonomy, participation, communication, and responsibility. Such differences may reflect both the cultural composition of the team and the cultural values and orientations of individual members. The aim of this PhD project is to investigate how leadership and culture jointly shape responses to technology-driven changes in distributed work, with particular attention to how leaders navigate culturally diverse expectations as new ways of working emerge, and how these processes influence trust, role clarity, and coordination. 

The PhD project seeks to advance research on leadership, cross-cultural management, and technology-driven organizational change, potentially using remote maritime operations as a relevant empirical context in which geographically dispersed and culturally diverse actors must navigate shifting roles and authority while coordinating effectively in a safety-critical environment.

The successful candidate will have scope to develop the theoretical framework, research questions, and methodological design within the project's overall direction.


About the proposal

The PhD candidate should develop and submit a proposal within the scope of the topic, and, if selected as the preferred candidate, conduct research on the topic. Preferably, the PhD candidate’s research should focus on industries relevant to the Møre and Romsdal county, such as the marine and maritime industries.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group on international business and innovation.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have an academically relevant background, preferably within international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees including technology management, management of innovation, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management may also apply. 
  • You must have a master’s degree in international business, international management, business administration, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course in which 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may still be considered if you can demonstrate that you are particularly well-suited for a PhD program.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty of economics and management doctoral programme (https://www.ntnu.edu/ok/research/phd)
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English and/or Norwegian.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Good knowledge of industries represented in the region, such as the marine, maritime and furniture industry, both local and global.
  • Have strong motivation for advanced research work demonstrated by a motivation letter and a proposal within the scope of the project description above.
  • Good demonstrated theoretical and analytical skills.
  • Contribute to a positive work environment in general is emphasized.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 2000 words/5 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications, etc., other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Possible letter(s) of reference/recommendation
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact the Head of Department, Associate Professor Mark Pasquine (mapa@ntnu.no), Professor Ghulam Mustafa (guma@ntnu.no), or the Deputy leader, Research & Innovation, Professor Richard Glavee-Geo (rigl@ntnu.no). If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Adviser Oddny Lyngvær at email: oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no or telephone: +47 95011957. 

Application deadline: 25.10.2026

jobs.title: KAPELLAN I TILLER SOKN
jobs.description:
Tiller er en bydel sør i Trondheim, med store næringsarealer og en relativt ung befolkning. Syv av ti er medlemmer i Den norske kirke. Kunne du tenke deg å være prest blant dem?

Tiller er både bygd og by, en del av Trondheim, men også et eget lokalsamfunn med et mangfold av butikker, bedrifter og virksomheter. Tiller kirke, fra 1901, ligger vakkert til i bydelen, omgitt av en stor og velstelt kirkegård. Her er en rekke skoler for alle alderstrinn, blant annet Kristen videregående skole Trøndelag. I bydelen finnes også Birgittaklosteret, et buddhistisk tempel, et hindutempel og Jehovas Vitner. I det hele er Tiller en mangfoldig bydel med nesten 15000 innbyggere og mange arenaer for samarbeid og utvikling.

Tiller menighet ønsker å være et felleskap i folkekirken der alle kan føle seg hjemme, og der det er rom for å søke mening og dybde i livet. Det er to prester i en relativt stor stab, med kateket, menighetspedagog, diakon, kantor, daglig leder og kirketjener, som holder til i kontorer på Menighetssenteret sentralt plassert i bydelen. Huset rommer også en åpen barnehage som drives i samarbeid med menigheten. I Tiller tilbys ulike aktiviteter for alle aldersgrupper: gudstjenester, småsprell, tweens, menighetstreff, KFUK-KFUM-speidergruppe, familiemiddag, formiddagstreff, vaffeltorsdag og kirkekor. Det er god oppslutning om dåp og konfirmasjon, med om lag 100 konfirmanter årlig. Den nye kapellanen vil ha et særskilt fokus på menighetens barn og unge. Oppgavene er varierte og du som søker vil få rom til å utforske hvilke av dine kvaliteter som passer best inn i helheten. Det er utstrakt og godt samarbeid i Kirkelig fellesråd i Trondheim og prostiet, på tvers av soknegrenser og bydeler.

Som ny prest blir du også del av et flott arbeidskollegium i Trondheim prosti, som dekker et område med om lag 175.000 av Trondheims innbyggere. Prostiet har 13 sokn og 27 prester. Det betyr et allsidig og robust prestekollegium i ett tjenesteområde, som innbyr til faglig utveksling og gode samarbeidsprosjekter.  I Trondheim har vi by-omfattende tilbud innen retreat, kurs og samtalegrupper og konfirmanttreff mm. Vi har kontekstuelle utviklingsprosjekter som Barnas katedral, U-kirke, Grønn katedral og Frivillighetsprosjekt, som kan inspirere og gi rom for differensierte tjenester som prest i byen.
Prestene har månedlige samlinger, tilbud om ukentlig tekstverksted, og fagdager i byen og bispedømmet. Trondheim er, med Nidarosdomen sentralt plassert, et senter for pilegrimsteologi og forvaltning av Olavsarv og olsokfeiring i Den norske kirke, og den kirkelige aktiviteten er utforskende og variert. Sørsamisk kirkeliv og nasjonaljubileet 2030 er et særlig ansvar i bispedømmet.

For mer informasjon: Se hjemmesidene til Trondheim kirkelige fellesråd, menigheten, Nidaros bispedømme og til Trondheim kommune når det gjelder bydelen.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kapellanen må påregne alle oppgaver i henhold til Tjenesteordning for menighetsprester.
  • Tjenesten er regulert gjennom arbeidsplaner og samarbeid med andre prester i prostiet.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Søkere må fylle vilkårene i henhold til "Kvalifikasjonskrav for tilsetting som menighetsprest", jfr. § 3 i Tjenesteordning for menighetsprester.
  • Ved tilsetting blir det tatt forbehold om at den som tilsettes kan fremlegge tilfredsstillende politiattest.
  • Målformen i soknene er bokmål. Søkere må opplyse om de behersker begge målformer.
Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker en prest som:

  • vil bidra til gode samarbeidsforhold, trivsel og engasjement
  • vil bygge levende fellesskap rundt gudstjenester og kirkelige aktiviteter
  • ønsker å utforske mulighetene som ligger i møte med menighetens barn og unge
  • har sansen for at det er mange forskjellige arbeidsoppgaver i en menighet. 
Vi tilbyr
  • Stillingen er plassert i kode 0922 Kapellan. Lønnsfastsettelse skjer etter dokumentert krav om godskriving av ansiennitet.  
  • Medlemskap i offentlig pensjonsordning (KLP).
  • Bispedømmet har godt utbygde personaltiltak, herunder arbeidsveiledning.
*************************************************
Nidaros bispedømme skal være en arbeidsplass med rom og respekt for mangfold, uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønnsidentitet, funksjonsevne og legning. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.

Tilsetting skjer på de vilkår som til enhver tid gjelder og den som tilsettes må rette seg etter følgende:
a) endring i lover, tariffavtaler, reglement m.v. herunder spørsmål vedrørende tjenesteordning og beredskapsordning.
b) avgjørelser som kan influere på tjenestens gjøremål.

Søkerne gjøres oppmerksom på at de kan bli ført opp på den offentlige søkerlisten, selv om de ber om ikke å bli det.

Helsefagarbeidar
jobs.description:
Ålesund kommune ved Sandøy omsorgsdistrikt har grunna permisjonar og vakanse ledig 2 x 100 % stilling som helsefagarbeidar. Arbeidsstad er pt. avdeling sjukeheim. Sjukeheimsavdelinga har 8 plassar som dekker langtid og korttidspasientar. Helsefagarbeidar stillinga er pt. innplassert i tre-delt arbeidsplan med arbeid kvar 3. helg. Vi har årsturnus. 
Tenestestad er Sandøytunet på Harøya i Ålesund kommune.
Sjukeheim er samlokalisert med med dagaktivitetssenter, heimetenester og bufellesskap og andre kommunale tenester på Steinshamn, Harøya. 
Helsefagarbeidarstillingane er knytt til Sandøy omsorgsdistrikt som består av eit lokalsamfunn med fleire øyar, Harøya og Finnøya har fastlandsforbindelse- Nordøyvegen.  Andre tilbod ein har i nærleiken til Sandøytunet er barnehage, barne og ungdomsskule, daglegvarebutikkar, bank og mange private bedrifter. Det er mange tilbod for fritida lokalt innan friluftsliv, idrett, treningssenter og kultur. Kommunen har verdiane open, engasjert og modig og har fokus på bærekraft i planlegging, gjennomføring og evaluering i tenestene.
Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Sikre at bebuar/pasientar får nødvendig helsehjelp og tenester av god kvalitet i tråd med gjeldande lover, avtalar og retningslinjer.
  • Observasjon, kartlegging, iverksetting av tiltak og dokumentasjon i pasientjournal (Helseplattformen).
  • Legemiddelhandtering.
  • Rettleiing av pasientar, pårørande, kollegaer og studentar.
  • Bidra til kvardagsmeistring og auka livskvalitet hos pasientar.
  • Samarbeide tett med pårørande og interne/eksterne aktørar.
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Fagbrev som Helsefagarbeider (eventuelt fagbrev som hjelpepleier og omsorgsarbeider)
  • Relevant erfaring er ein fordel
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne. Krav om norsk språkferdigheit tilsvarande B2 munnleg og skriftleg (Europarådet sin nivåskala - CEFR)
  • Beherske IKT-verktøy
  • Ved tilsetjing krevst politiattest, MRSA- og TBC-eigenerklæringar
  • Aktuelle kandidater må ha norsk personnummer eller gyldig D-nummer og formidle dette til arbeidsgiver i god tid før oppstart i jobben.
  • Det forutsettes at den som skal ansettes kan bekrefte sikker identitet i form av gyldig pass (internasjonalt) eller nasjonalt ID-kort (EU/EØS).
  • Det kreves også at personlig bankid eller idporten kan benyttes som alternativ innlogging mot ulike digitale løsninger ved behov (Helseplattformen, OTTO-app mm).
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Vi søkjer fagarbeidar med interesse for teamarbeid, som evnar å være med i ulike endringsprosessar.
  • Trygg, tydeleg og engasjert, med fokus på beboeren
  • Løysingsorientert, fleksibel og glad i nye utfordringar
  • Sjølvstendig og samarbeidsorientert
  • Bidrar til eit godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Nytenkande og endringsvillig
  • Personlege eigenskaper blir vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Ein interessant arbeidskvardag med varierte og utfordrande oppgåver i eit godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Fagleg påfyll og moglegheit for vidareutdanning etter virksomhetens behov

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen i Møre og Romsdal og den største byen mellom Bergen og Trondheim med ca. 60 000 innbyggere 

Det lokale næringslivet er både lokalt, nasjonalt og ikkje minst internasjonalt orientert. Ålesund er «bygd» på fiske og fangst. Framleis er Ålesundregionen er verdsleiande på det marine og maritime området. Fleire av landets største fiskebedrifter og oppdrettsselskap held til i kommunen vår. Ålesund har Noregs største cruisehamn, største fiskerihamn og nest største containerhamn. Vi er og Noregs største eksporthamn på fiskeriprodukter. 

Kommunen er det største kollektivknutepunktet i fylket, og tal frå 2016 viser at det årleg er rundt to millionar passasjerer som går av eller på ein buss eller båt i Ålesund.  
Ålesund by er viden kjend for sin vakre jugendstil. Tårn, spir og vakre utsmykkingar møter deg som går gatelangs der.
Byen ligg som ein døropnar til fjordsystemet på Sunnmøre og strekk seg heilt nord til Ona utanfor Romsdalskysten. Andre attraksjonar i kommunen er Ona fyr og fantastiske fjell, fjordar og natur rett utanfor stovedøra. 
Vi er ein universitetskommune og har eit nært samarbeid med NTNU på Campus Ålesund. På Campus Ålesund finn du òg Ålesund framtidslab - U4SSC ip.  

Kommunen er ein stor arbeidsgjevar med sine over 4.400 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidarar som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglege arbeidet vektlegg vi verdiane våre: open, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».
Ønsker du ein meiningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrande oppgåver, er Ålesund kommune eit spennande alternativ.

jobs.title: Vil du bidra til koordinering av viktige regelverk i Hæren?
jobs.description:
Vi søker en dyktig og engasjert regelverkskoordinator til Fagmyndighetssekretariatet (FMS) ved Hærens våpenskole (HVS).

HVS er Hærens kompetanse- og utviklingsavdeling. Vi arbeider for å styrke Hærens operative evne gjennom utvikling, utdanning, trening og videreutvikling av fag- og styringsdokumentasjon. Hos oss får du muligheten til å bidra til utvikling og forbedring av hvordan Hæren løser sine oppgaver, både i dag og i fremtiden.

FMS koordinerer utøvelsen av fagmyndighet på vegne av sjef Hæren. Utdanning, trening og øving innebærer risiko, og tydelige og oppdaterte regler og styrende dokumenter er avgjørende for at tjenesten gjennomføres på en enhetlig, effektiv og trygg måte. Som regelverkskoordinator får du en sentral rolle i dette arbeidet. Du skal bidra til å forenkle, forbedre og videreutvikle Hærens interne regelverk og styrende dokumenter. Samtidig skal du bidra til bedre oversikt, struktur og kontroll med regelverket, både i Hæren og ved Hærens våpenskole. Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å se sammenhenger, skape struktur og gjøre komplekst innhold enklere å forstå og bruke. Du får samtidig muligheten til å bidra til noe som har direkte betydning for kvaliteten og sikkerheten i Hærens virksomhet.


Hva skal du jobbe med?

Som regelverkskoordinator vil du:

  • Arbeide med å organisere, utvikle og videreutvikle interne regelverk for Hæren, herunder støtte avdelingssjefene gjennom rådgivning, saksbehandling og utredning
  • Koordinere og bistå saksbehandling som gjelder godkjenning og implementering av NATO-standarder innenfor rammen av Hærens fagmyndighet
  • Være kontaktpunkt for regelverk både internt i Hæren og mot resten av Forsvaret, herunder bidra til samarbeid med andre fagmyndigheter og fagansvarlige
  • Ha god oversikt over eksisterende regelverk og styringsdokumenter i egen fagmyndighet i Forsvaret og i Hæren
  • Legge til rette for redigering, oppdatering og publisering av regelverk for Hæren
  • Bidra til at gjeldene og nytt regelverk implementeres i Hæren
  • Ha oversikt over pågående og relevant regelverksarbeid i Forsvaret
  • Ha god kjennskap til Forsvarets dokumenthierarki og Forsvarsdepartementets (FD) retningslinjer som regulerer utforming av Forsvarets interne regelverk
  • Støtte opp om daglig drift i egen seksjon og avdeling, og delta i ulike regelverksforum
Hvilke kvalifikasjoner kreves?

Det kreves at du har:

  • Relevant utdanning på bachelornivå, eksempelvis innen administrative fag
  • Gode skriftlige og muntlige ferdigheter på norsk 
  • Du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres til HEMMELIG og NATO SECRET før tiltredelse (for mer informasjon om sikkerhetsklarering, se www.nsm.no)

Det er en fordel om du også har:

  • Erfaring innen offentlig regelverksforvaltning og arkivloven
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode skriftlige og muntlige ferdigheter på engelsk
  • Relevant arbeidserfaring fra Forsvaret
  • Erfaring innen offentlig forvaltning
  • Erfaring med digitale arkivsystemer, Office 365 og/eller SharePoint
  • Gjennomført grunnleggende soldatutdanning (førstegangstjeneste eller grunnleggende soldatkurs) eller villighet til å gjennomgå grunnleggende soldatkurs etter tiltredelse i stilling

All utdanning og relevant arbeidserfaring må dokumenteres ved å laste opp vedlegg i Webcruiter. Høyere utdanning gjennomført i utlandet må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høgare utdanning og kompetanse eller NOKUT, og godkjenningen må legges ved søknaden.

Hvilken kollega ser vi etter?

Vi søker deg som:

  • Er nøyaktig, har en strukturert tilnærming til arbeidsoppgaver og har en systematisk arbeidsmetodikk som kan bidra til en god oversikt
  • Innehar gode kommunikasjonsevner, er løsningsorientert og har et ønske om å bidra til at arbeidsplassen skal være et godt sted å være
  • Viser sterkt engasjement og viser høy grad av integritet og serviceinnstilling
  • Er faglig nysgjerrig og liker å holde deg oppdatert, samtidig som det er naturlig for deg å dele kunnskap med de rundt deg
Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
  • Et spennende og aktivt arbeidsmiljø med varierte oppgaver og utfordringer
  • Kurs og opplæring etter behov
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Mulighet for inntil 2 timer trening i arbeidstiden per uke
  • Egen bedriftshelsetjeneste
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse (http://spk.no) som har en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger

Stillingen lønnes som seniorkonsulent i stillingskode 1363, for tiden kr. 645.300 - 714.700 brutto per år, avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. Av lønnen trekkes 2 % lovbestemt innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse.

Ønsker du å bidra til Forsvarets videre utvikling? Da oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

En jobb i Forsvaret er noe mer enn en jobb. Forsvarets viktigste oppgave er å skape sikkerhet for Norge og trygghet for befolkningen. Uansett hvilken stilling du har, er du med på å ivareta landets og fellesskapets interesser. For å verne om alt vi har og alt vi er, må vi selv leve ut de verdiene vi er satt til å forsvare. Vi ønsker derfor ansatte som bidrar til en god kultur ved å vise respekt og ta ansvar for hverandre, og ha mot til å handle riktig og våge å si ifra.

Som en del av Hæren er du med på å skape sikkerhet på landjorda. Et forsvar kan ikke greie seg uten styrker på bakken. Hæren er avgjørende for å beholde kontrollen over norske landområder, og oppgavene er mange også i fredstid.

Hærens våpenskole er Hærens kompetanse- og utviklingsavdeling. Den støtter Hærens videreutvikling og utdanning og bidrar til struktur- og materiellutvikling.

I Forsvaret er det ønskelig at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, kulturell bakgrunn, hull i CV-en eller funksjonsevne. Vi vil sørge for tilrettelegging på arbeidsplassen hvis det er behov for dette. Noen av Forsvarets stillinger kan ha egne helsekrav og krav til fysisk skikkethet.

I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25 andre ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Det er egne regler for militære stillinger.

Forsvaret benytter elektronisk søknadsbehandling. Attester og vitnemål må legges ved søknaden. Høyere utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være offentlig godkjent av NOKUT eller Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse. Godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Det blir gjennomført bakgrunnsjekk når sikkerhetsklareringen gjennomføres.

jobs.title: Nu söker vi en supporttekniker!
jobs.description:
Tillsammans skapar vi glädje, kreativitet och löser våra kunders problem – stora som små. Slår ditt hjärta lite extra för service och kundnöjdhet? Är du en riktig stjärna som vill bidra till din egen och företagets utveckling? Då är vi som gjorda för varandra.

Hur det är att jobba hos oss

Hos oss på StjärnaFyrkant kommer du till en arbetsplats där alla våra medarbetare brinner för att göra skillnad – för kunder och varandra, men framför allt för de som behöver det som mest. Hållbarhet och välgörenhet ligger oss därför varmt om hjärtat.

Vi bygger relationer med varandra och våra kunder. Tillsammans skapar vi en arbetsplats som präglas av öppenhet, gemenskap, eget ansvar och där alla medarbetare ska ha en möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och få vara med och påverka.

Hjärtat i vår verksamhet är våra medarbetare och som anställd hos oss får du dela dina dagar med riktigt jäkla duktiga och härliga kollegor som alla drivs av att göra det lilla extra.

Hos oss är ingen dag den andra lik, vi växer och blir utmanande varje dag men möter utmaningarna som ett team. Tillsammans skapar vi en arbetsplats som blir mer än bara ett jobb!

Din vardag hos oss

Som supporttekniker ingår du i vårt serviceteam och hanterar tillsammans med övriga servicedeskagenter den inkommande ärendekön, både via telefon och ärendehanteringssystemet. Kombinerat med det är du ute hos våra kunder och där du kommer ha fokus på installation, underhåll och driftsättning och din kommer innehålla bland annat kabeldragning, montering och felsökning.

Du är ofta vårt ansikte utåt och därför är det viktigt att alltid ha ett trevligt bemötande, vara lyhörd och ha kundens bästa i åtanke. Din relation till kunden kommer vara helt avgörande för kundens upplevelse och om vi får en nöjd kund.

Resor inom och utanför länet förekommer i denna tjänst. Du utgår från våra lokaler på Västerslätt och behöver ha B-körkort för att kunna ta dig ut till våra kunder.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig

Vi tror att du är lösningsorienterad, utåtriktad och gillar stor variation i ditt arbete. Det är önskvärt att du har tidigare erfarenhet inom IT-branschen men vem du är som person är något vi värdesätter högre. Vi tänker att du har ett genuint intresse för teknik, är driven, kundfokuserad och praktiskt lagd. Det är viktigt att du bidrar med positiv energi och vill vara med och utveckla vårt IT-erbjudande. I rollen som supporttekniker har du även du stora möjligheter att utvecklas och ta nästa kliv in i rollen som IT-konsult.

Om oss

Vi är ett lokalägt företag med korta beslutsvägar och ett absolut fokus på att skapa en arbetsplats där vi kan ha kul, som ger oss energi och som skapar kreativa och nöjda medarbetare.

jobs.title: Working Student – Laser Lab & Cleanroom Operations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Focused Energy seeks a Working Student - Laser Lab & Cleanroom Operations (f/m/d) for our Laser Lab in Darmstadt to support laser experiment design and setup. You will assist with cleanroom operations, including preparing and inspecting optical components, setting up support systems, electronics, and measurement equipment, and helping commission cooling and driver units. After setup, you will operate experiments and collect data. This immersive, hands-on role involves daily collaboration with lab and controls engineers in a cleanroom, requiring precision, adherence to

What You'll Do

  • Assist the Laser Lab team in designing and building laser experiments in the Darmstadt Optical Lab.

  • Support cleanroom operations by setting up support systems and preparing components.

  • Clean and inspect optical and mechanical components according to cleanroom standards.

  • Set up electronics and measurement equipment for experiments.

  • Collaborate with engineers to commission cooling and driver units.

  • Operate experiments and collect data under engineering supervision.

  • Adhere to cleanroom and lab safety protocols, and promptly report any deviations.

Who You Are

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics, Optics/Photonics, Laser Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • You possess a basic understanding of optics, lasers, or experimental physics through coursework or laboratory experience.

  • Comfortable with hands-on hardware work, demonstrating careful, precise, and methodical handling of sensitive components.

  • Able to reliably follow structured procedures and safety protocols (such as cleanroom or laboratory guidelines).

  • Basic familiarity with electronics and measurement equipment, such as oscilloscopes, power meters, or similar devices.

  • You demonstrate reliability, a structured and proactive approach, and a willingness to learn in a hands-on laboratory environment.

  • Strong English skills.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is a pioneering international deep-tech company with locations in Germany and the US, dedicated to commercializing laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to deliver clean, safe, and virtually limitless energy to the world. As we rapidly scale, we seek talented individuals who thrive on bringing clarity and structure to fast-growing environments.

About the Role

Focused Energy’s German operations are growing, and the IT systems supporting that growth need an engineer who can own their operation with confidence. As an IT Systems Engineer, you’ll ensure that Focused Energy’s Darmstadt IT environment runs reliably, securely, and efficiently across device management, endpoint security, cloud services, access management, and automation.

 

This is a systems ownership role, with end-user support as a secondary responsibility. You’ll work onsite in Darmstadt, collaborate with colleagues across Berlin and Austin, and help build a more stable, automated, and scalable IT environment for the scientists and engineers developing fusion technology.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the operation and maintenance of IT systems and infrastructure in Darmstadt, including MDM, endpoint security, cloud services, device lifecycle, and access management.

  • Lead automation and scripting initiatives that reduce repetitive manual work, improve consistency, and increase operational efficiency.

  • Manage onboarding and offboarding IT execution, including account provisioning, device readiness, access management, and access revocation.

  • Maintain and improve Focused Energy’s security baseline by supporting MFA enforcement, endpoint hardening, patch management, access reviews, and security event response.

  • Build and maintain accurate system documentation, configuration records, support processes, and operational runbooks.

  • Identify recurring incidents and improvement opportunities, investigate root causes, and implement lasting technical solutions.

  • Contribute to IT improvement projects such as MDM consolidation, cloud service migration, DLP implementation, EDR rollout, and unified device management.

  • Provide efficient end-user support to Darmstadt employees while coordinating shared infrastructure with the wider IT team and escalating architectural changes, security incidents, and vendor decisions appropriately.

 

Who You Are

  • You take ownership of systems issues and improvement opportunities without waiting to be assigned tasks.

  • You are technically confident, hands-on, and comfortable operating interconnected systems in a fast-growing environment.

  • You think in systems, considering how components interact before making configuration or production changes.

  • You are proactive about identifying risks, recurring issues, automation opportunities, and operational improvements.

  • You communicate system status, incidents, risks, and project progress clearly in English; German language skills are a plus.

  • You follow through to resolution, document what was changed and why, and work to prevent issues from recurring.

  • You can balance systems engineering responsibilities with secondary end-user support demands.

  • You collaborate effectively with employees, People Operations, IT colleagues across sites, vendors, and service providers.

 

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience in IT systems engineering, including endpoint management, cloud services, identity and access management, and network fundamentals.

  • Strong experience with MDM platforms and device lifecycle management across Windows and macOS environments.

  • Practical knowledge of endpoint security, EDR and DLP tooling, endpoint hardening, patch management, and MFA enforcement.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, including Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune or an equivalent MDM platform.

  • Experience with Box, Atlassian tools such as Jira and Confluence, access management platforms, and cloud infrastructure services.

  • Scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, or an equivalent language.

  • Knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident and change management, root-cause analysis, and documentation-first operational practices.

  • Understanding of GDPR requirements applicable to German IT operations and disciplined access review and security procedures.

jobs.title: Customer Success - DACH
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the DACH region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Proven experience working across the DACH market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

Manufacturing runs on fragmented data: machines, sensors and decade-old systems that don't talk to each other. Department of Clinical Sciences

The University Animal Hospital (UDS) at the Department of Clinical Sciences (KV), serves as SLU's centre for clinical research and education. At UDS, veterinary students, veterinarians, and veterinary nurses receive hands-on training, while clinical research is actively conducted. The management team promotes a forward-thinking and supportive environment, encouraging employees to develop their skills and pursue their interests through ongoing professional development. Benefits include a wellness allowance and a standard 39-hour work week.

We are now seeking a Specialist in Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia with broad experience in small animal practise. Welcome with your application!

About the position

Your primary responsibilities will include responsibility for patients and patient safety in the daily clinical work and supervising students in anaesthesia and analgesia within the university clinics. Participation in the out-of-hours service is also expected.

In your day-to-day role, you will be actively involved in the clinical teaching of veterinary students, interns, and residents. You will also provide guidance and support to veterinary nurses.

Opportunities to engage in ongoing clinical research are available, and you may also contribute to lecturing, small group teaching, and assessing veterinary students. A crucial aspect of your work will involve advising and collaborating with veterinarians in other disciplines, such as intensive care and in patient care. Regular consultations with veterinarians, including referral veterinarians, are an integral part of this role.

Your profile

You are a licensed Veterinarian eligible to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden, and a EBVS® European Veterinary Specialist in Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia or an ACVAA board-certified specialist.

Teaching and/or research experience in the field is considered merits.

Proficiency in English is required, and you either speak a Scandinavian language or are committed to learning Swedish within a time-period of ca 2-3 years.

Significant emphasis will be placed on personal qualities. We value a professional approach and expect you to be flexible, appreciate teamwork, and contribute to the smooth operation of the surgical department.

About us

The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities within all these fields encompass all animal species.

At the SLU University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate tomorrow’s veterinarians and veterinary nurses and provide first-class care for companion animals, competition animals and production animals. We also share knowledge with the general public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are developing the veterinary care of the future.

Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern, purpose-built facilities, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging and a specialist veterinary laboratory.

jobs.title: Timvikariat - Behandlingspedagog som vill göra skillnad
jobs.description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning. Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de ungdomar och klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper  inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på med skolgång, städning, matlagning med mera. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

Arbetstiden är dag, kväll och helg.

Som ny medarbetare kommer du att genomgå SiS grundutbildning på 10 veckor.  I utbildningen varvas teori med en handledd introduktion och utbildningen rustar dig för behandlarrollen i SiS verksamhet.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra ungdomar. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med ungdomar likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du ska också ha:

    Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig
    B- körkort
    God svenska i tal och skrift

Nedan återfinns exempel på meriterande krav som kan användas i rekrytering (välj ut vad som passar er specifika rekryteringsprocess)

    Erfarenhet av arbete med människor i utsatta livssituationer, t.ex. arbete inom psykiatri eller inom LSS omsorg
    Erfarenhet från klientnära befattningar på Kriminalvården, t.ex. Kriminalvårdare
    Utbildning inom vård-och omsorg
    Erfarenhet av arbete med vår målgrupp (t.ex. missbruksvård, ungdomsvård, unga pojkar etc.)

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är ett timvikariat. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.







SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.



För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning.



Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.





OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

And that is where you, together with the Material Impact Assessment team, come in!

Job Description

As a Material Impact Analyst, you will help IKEA understand and reduce the environmental impacts of materials, products, and supply chains. By combining scientific analysis with business understanding, you will provide the data, insights, and recommendations needed to support material innovation, product development, sourcing decisions, and long-term sustainability goals.

Your assignment is to:

    Conduct Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), material impact assessments, and develop emission factors to help IKEA understand and reduce the environmental footprint of materials, products, and supply chains.
    Provide environmental expertise to material transformation and sustainability initiatives, including a focus on emerging topics such as biogenic carbon, recycled and renewable materials, land use, and carbon capture utilisation (CCU).
    Develop and maintain IKEA's environmental footprint data assets, including assurance-ready emission factors and LCA datasets, while collaborating with suppliers, data owners, and stakeholders to improve data quality, coverage, and representativeness.
    Contribute to the development of environmental impact methodologies, reporting, and impact claims, to support credible, transparent, and fit-for-purpose environmental information for business decision-making and external communication.
    Provide subject-matter expertise, training, and decision support to internal stakeholders and external partners, enabling fact-based decisions on materials, innovation priorities, and decarbonisation pathways.

You will report to the Material Impact Manager in Purchasing Development, Core Business Supply.

Qualifications

This role is critical to building and maintaining IKEA's internal capability to assess and improve the environmental performance of materials and products. Beyond delivering LCAs, you will contribute through supplier engagement, methodology development, environmental data management, environmental claims review, and strategic support for business decisions.

You will work closely with stakeholders across sustainability, materials, product development, sourcing, engineering, supply chain, climate, quality, and data management functions. Collaboration with colleagues and partners across multiple countries and business areas will be a natural part of your everyday work.

We are looking for someone who is collaborative, curious, and self-driven, with a strong ability to build trust and work effectively across functions, disciplines, and countries. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and can translate complex environmental insights into clear and actionable recommendations. You are motivated by continuous learning and improvement and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex sustainability challenges.

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have:

    A master’s degree in environmental engineering, Industrial Ecology, Material Science, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
    Minimum 2 years of experience independently conducting detailed Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), from scoping to communication of results.
    Strong knowledge of LCA methodology and environmental assessment standards, including ISO 14040/14044, Product Environmental Footprint (PEF), EN 15804, GHG Protocol, and related frameworks.
    Experience assessing and interpreting environmental impacts, including climate change, biodiversity, water use and resource use and understanding how these impact categories can support business decision-making.
    Experience developing and applying emission factors, environmental datasets, and impact models, with an understanding of data quality, representativeness, uncertainty, and assurance requirements.
    Hands-on experience with LCA tools and databases such as SimaPro, OpenLCA, ecoinvent, or equivalent platforms.
    Knowledge of materials and their environmental impacts, including emerging topics such as circularity, recycled and renewable materials and biogenic carbon.
    The ability to translate complex environmental analyses into clear insights and recommendations that support material strategies, innovation, sustainability initiatives, and business decisions.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across functions in a global and matrixed environment
    A scientific, analytical, and curious mindset, balanced with the pragmatism needed to deliver actionable results.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Additional information

This is a permanent position based in Älmhult, Sweden. We are looking for 2 positions. Please send us your application – CV and letter of motivation – in English latest by 12 October 2026.

Welcome with your application!

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Ceph / On-Prem Cloud Storage (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your Role

You will help us build, operate and industrialize the storage foundation of our on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, experienced team, you will own the Ceph clusters behind our block, object and file storage services – essentially the storage every customer workload eventually lands on. The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes

Unser Tech Stack 🚀

· Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium
· RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance.

  • Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact.

  • Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal, working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity.

  • Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes.

  • Own capacity planning and growth forecasting, use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security.

  • AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation.

  • Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling, document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team.

What we offer

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages


  • Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Storage Engineer or Platform Engineer running production storage infrastructure, with solid experience deploying, operating and debugging Ceph in production.

  • You know the Ceph fundamentals from real-world operations: CRUSH, pools and placement groups, replication vs. erasure coding, BlueStore, scrubbing, recovery and backfill under load.

  • You have managed storage infrastructure end to end, from the physical layer with drives, firmware, BIOS, controllers and hardware diagnostics through rebalancing, host drains, capacity expansion and hardware generation migrations.

  • You are comfortable using Kubernetes as a control plane, not only as a workload runtime, and understand operators/controllers, custom resources, reconciliation and GitOps. You can also move confidently around OpenStack and debug issues involving Ironic, Neutron, Nova or Glance when needed.

  • You have dealt with situations where durability really matters – such as degraded or near-full clusters, recovery under load or split-brain conditions – and you are used to making changes in a staged, evidence-based and reversible way.

  • You have strong Linux and bare-metal skills, understand the block layer, filesystems and I/O behaviour, and are comfortable working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps.

  • AI-assisted engineering is already part of your day-to-day work. You have practical experience with LLMs and agentic tools and know where they can meaningfully support development, testing, reviews or operations.

  • Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi, deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role.

  • You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership, and are comfortable debugging problems where the actual root cause may sit somewhere between storage, networking, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You would rather verify what is happening from evidence than assume how the system should behave.

  • We work in an international environment in English, so you should feel comfortable discussing technical topics, documenting decisions and working with the team in English.

jobs.title: Keukenmedewerker (voltijds of deeltijds)
jobs.description:
Voor onze gezellige brasserie Greenview Terrace, gelegen aan de prachtige Golfclub van Brasschaat, zijn wij op zoek naar een gemotiveerde keukenmedewerker om ons keukenteam te versterken. Bij ons staan kwaliteit, sfeer en gastvrijheid centraal. Wij bedienen voornamelijk clubleden, maar verwelkomen ook wandelaars en passanten die willen genieten van een ontspannen culinaire ervaring.

Jouw takenpakket:

  • Voorbereiden van de dagelijkse mise-en-place.
  • Snijwerk en algemene keukenvoorbereidingen.
  • Ondersteunen aan zowel de warme als de koude kant.
  • Instaan voor de algemene orde en netheid van de keuken.
  • Mee zorgen voor een vlotte en kwalitatieve service.
  • Zelfstandig kunnen werken wanneer dat nodig is.

    ° Je werkt snel, nauwkeurig en georganiseerd.

jobs.title: Production Supervisor
jobs.description:
As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.

Tasks:

  • Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
  • Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
  • Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
  • Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
  • Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
  • Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Who we are looking for:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
  • Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
  • Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
  • Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

jobs.title: Leefgroepbegeleider Basale Werking voor MFC Het Punt
jobs.description:
MFC Het Punt (Evergem) is op zoek naar een leefgroepbegeleider voor de instroom mogelijkheid basale werking. Onze leefgroep basale werking specifieert zich op kinderen en jongeren met een matig tot ernstig mentale beperking en kinderen en jongeren met een meervoudige beperking.

De focus in deze groep ligt op veiligheid en houvast
We bieden cliënten een veilige en voorspelbare omgeving, met bijzondere aandacht voor medische zorgen en welzijn. Structuur vormt de basis van onze begeleiding. Vanuit nabijheid en zorg ondersteunen we waar nodig en nemen we taken van hun dagelijks leven over. Tegelijk stimuleren we stap voor stap de ontwikkeling van zelfredzaamheid en hebben we oog voor ieders talenten en mogelijkheden. Kernzin: "Wij dragen en sturen."

Onderstaand lichten we onze concrete verwachtingen toe op twee gebieden.

Algemeen:

  • Als leefgroepbegeleider sta je samen met je collega’s in voor de dagelijkse begeleiding van onze kinderen/jongeren;
  • De opdracht is gericht op groeps- en individuele begeleiding waarvan de belangrijkste taken zijn:
    • het creëren van een aangenaam en aangepast leefklimaat,
    • het organiseren en begeleiden van activiteiten,
    • het zorgen voor een huiselijke sfeer.
  • Je verzorgt de verslaggeving en administratie;
  • Je kan je aanpak afstemmen op maat van de cliënt en op hun actuele noden;
  • 1 slapende/wakende nacht per week
  • Je maakt deel uit van de grotere groep leefgroepbegeleiders en kan flexibel inspringen waar nodig in andere groepen, ondersteunen in de dagbesteding,…

Specifiek basale werking:

  • Zorgen in al zijn aspecten. Verzorgende handelingen maar ook zorg dragen voor onze kinderen en jongeren.
  • Nabij zijn, co-regulatie
  • Structuur bieden
  • Veiligheid bieden en de-escalatie
  • Externe sturing geven
  • Voor doen, samen doen en herhaling
  • Teamconsistentie: samen in teamverband werken en afspraken consequent toepassen

Wil je deel uitmaken van onze voorziening, wil je meewerken aan het uitbouwen van een gevestigde waarde in de zorgregio en houd je van avontuur, aarzel dan niet om ons te contacteren.

We ontvangen graag je CV en motivatiebrief.

  • Technisch secundair onderwijs 3de graad Jeugd en gehandicapten zorg
  • Se-n-Se leefgroepenwerking
  • Menswetenschappelijke bachelor opleidingen
  • Graduaat Orthopedische Begeleiding
  • Je bent flexibel en kan zowel in de ochtend, avond als in de nacht aan de slag.

jobs.title: Grond -en wegenwerkers
jobs.description:
• Algemene grond -en kabelwerken.
  • Aanleg van nutsleidingen zoals het graven van sleuven in verschillende diepten in openbare en/of private domeinen.
  • Je voert herstellingswerken uit aan het desbetreffende wegdek en zorgt voor een opgeleverd resultaat.

jobs.title: Civil & Structural Asset Management Engineer
jobs.description:
As an Asset Management Engineer for civil and structural assets, you strengthen the asset team at an industrial production site in Hoboken. Your focus is to help shape, implement and continuously improve the asset management approach for buildings, structures and related civil assets.

You work on tactical asset planning, maintenance strategy and lifecycle management. You collect and structure operational remarks, technical findings and improvement opportunities, and translate them into concrete proposals and follow-up actions.

You operate in an engineering environment that supports production across the full lifecycle of technical projects, from feasibility and design to realization and start-up. As asset management maturity is still evolving, you help define and embed practical working methods in daily operations.

  • Support the design, implementation and rollout of the asset management system for civil and building assets.
  • Help organize processes, asset registers, hierarchies, criticality models, maintenance logic, KPIs and documentation workflows.
  • Translate asset management principles such as ISO 55000, lifecycle thinking and risk-based decision-making into practical methods for an industrial environment.
  • Develop tactical plans to improve the reliability, safety and service life of buildings and structural assets.
  • Create and refine multi-year maintenance plans and monitor relevant performance indicators.
  • Translate risks, degradation insights and operational improvement opportunities into maintenance strategies, improvement actions and project proposals.
  • Investigate degradation, deficiencies and incidents to control and reduce structural risks.
  • Perform root cause analyses for recurring technical problems and structural shortcomings.
  • Interpret inspection data, trends, degradation curves and remaining-life evaluations.
  • Apply criticality and risk analysis methods to prioritize interventions and lifecycle actions.
  • Define preventive and mitigating measures and convert them into practical maintenance strategies.
  • Prepare interventions to an execution-ready level, including scope, technical descriptions, permits, safety conditions, materials, contractor input and planning constraints.
  • Transfer complete work packages to the work coordinator and use execution feedback to improve future plans and strategies.
  • Translate identified measures into practical civil and structural improvement actions.
  • Define scope, risks, planning and budget for smaller interventions on buildings and structures.
  • Coordinate contractors and condition-monitoring partners during engineering and execution.
  • Provide technical direction, quality follow-up and documentation support for assigned interventions.
  • Prepare project scope documents and CAPEX/OPEX proposals when required.
  • Support design, review and handover so assets are inspectable, maintainable and reliable.
  • Safeguard compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including ISO 55000, SEVESO and Eurocode where relevant.
  • Ensure accurate and high-quality asset data management in EAM and DMS systems.

This full-time position is based onsite in Hoboken, Belgium. Occasional homeworking may be possible with prior alignment and approval.

  • You have hands-on experience in industrial asset management, with a clear focus on tactical asset planning, maintenance strategy, criticality-based decision-making and lifecycle management.
  • You have experience with the implementation of an asset management system in an industrial environment.
  • You hold a master's degree in engineering. A background in civil or construction engineering is an advantage, but engineers from other disciplines are also considered if they have grown into asset management and can demonstrate a strong civil/structural affinity.
  • You bring solid civil / structural knowledge & experience. This is an essential requirement for the role.
  • You can demonstrate a strong affinity with construction and civil engineering.
  • You have working knowledge of ISO 55000, SEVESO and Eurocode.
  • You are capable of analysing technical and inspection data and translating conclusions into practical maintenance strategies and improvement proposals.
  • You have experience with or exposure to methodologies such as RBI data interpretation, RCA, criticality analysis, risk analysis, degradation analysis and remaining-life assessment, and you are motivated to further deepen your expertise.
  • You have experience coordinating projects and collaborating with contractors, inspectors or other external partners.
  • Experience in a mature industrial asset management environment is a plus.
  • Experience with EAM systems, DMS platforms, inspection databases, spreadsheets used for degradation models or predictive analysis tools is an asset.
  • Experience with industrial structures, corrosion issues, cracking, renovation works or smaller civil interventions is a plus.
  • Experience with work preparation in an industrial maintenance or turnaround environment is an advantage.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and work effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.
  • You combine problem-solving skills, learning agility and the motivation to further specialize in asset management.
  • You are fluent in English and Dutch, both spoken and written. Other languages are a plus.

jobs.title: Teamplanner Zorg
jobs.description:
In deze job maak je de werkplanning op voor poetshulpen en verzorgenden in de thuiszorg. Als onderdeel van het team, samen met de teamcoach en administratief ondersteuner, zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten altijd de gepaste zorg krijgen.

Wat ga je doen?
  • Je plant de zorg voor onze klanten nauwgezet en bent mee verantwoordelijk voor het tijdig doorgeven van de planning aan onze verzorgenden en poetshulpen. Dankzij de planningstool stem je vraag en aanbod makkelijker op elkaar af. Annulaties door de klant en ziekte of verlof van de medewerkers horen erbij, maar dankzij die tool en jouw creatieve geest vul je die uurroosters toch keer op keer goed in.
  • Je onderhoudt nauwe contacten via telefoon of mail met zowel de klant, de medewerker als andere collega’s zodat alle betrokken partijen steeds op de hoogte zijn van de gemaakte afspraken of bij wijzigingen.
  • Voor de poetshulpen en verzorgenden sta je ook in voor de goedkeuring van verlofaanvragen en het bevestigen van prestaties zodat de personeelsdienst de lonen correct kan uitbetalen.
  • Vereist: Bachelor- of masterdiploma dat in aanmerking komt als kwalificatiebewijs voor begeleidend personeel van de diensten voor gezinszorg. Niet zeker of jouw diploma in aanmerking komt? Bekijk de lijst hier
  • Je bent organisatorisch sterk en behoudt steeds het overzicht.
  • Een eerste ervaring met het opmaken van personeelsplanning is een pluspunt.
  • Klantgericht telefonisch communiceren is voor jou een plezier.
  • Je bent assertief en kan opkomen voor je mening, mét openheid en respect voor de beleving van anderen.

jobs.title: Neuropsycholoog
jobs.description:
Wij heten je graag welkom!

Ons team van psychologen voor onze campus in Menen (60%) en onze campus in Rumbeke (20%) kijkt uit naar een enthousiaste neuropsycholoog.

Wij hebben deze job voor jou

Enerzijds bestaat het takenpakket overwegend uit neuropsychologische diagnosestelling, anderzijds bied je zowel ambulant als residentieel psychosociale ondersteuning aan patiënten en hun netwerk met een neuropsychologische vraagstelling ziekenhuis breed. Je zal tewerkgesteld worden op het geriatrisch dagziekenhuis en de revalidatieafdelingen.

  • Je voert een anamnese en heteroanamnese uit met het oog op het verzamelen van informatie over het functioneren van de patiënt.
  • Je kan een psychodiagnostische testing afnemen door middel van een individueel aangepaste testbatterij, teneinde op een gestandaardiseerde manier psychometrische gegevens te verzamelen inzake het huidige neuropsychologisch functioneren. Het onderzoek wordt aangevuld door nauwkeurige observatie van het functioneren van de patiënt tijdens de afname van de testbatterij.
  • Je kan een onderbouwde rapportage uitwerken, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, waarbij anamnestische informatie gecombineerd wordt met observatie- en psychodiagnostische gegevens. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor correcte verslaggeving en een adequaat dossierbeheer.
  • Je participeert aan multidisciplinair overleg om tot een gezamenlijke, door het team gedragen indicatiestelling en therapieplan te komen.
  • Je maakt deel uit van de psychologische dienst en werkt samen met diverse andere disciplines zoals artsen, sociale dienst, verpleegkundigen. Je participeert aan de crisiswacht.

Wij kijken uit naar jou

  • Je genoot een opleiding Master in de Klinische Psychologie.
  • Ervaring met neuropsychologisch onderzoek is een must.
  • Opleiding neuropsychologie en/of psychodiagnostiek strekt tot aanbeveling.
  • Kennis/ervaring met Parkinson en dementie is een belangrijke meerwaarde.
  • Je bent een enthousiaste teamspeler die ook autonoom kan werken.
  • Je neemt graag initiatief. Je zoekt actief naar nieuwe mogelijkheden en past bestaande methodes aan.
  • Je hebt een duidelijke visie op normen en waarden en implementeert deze.
