jobs.title: Orthoptistes : un CDI à Sedan H/F Debutant ok !
jobs.description:
DN8 Solutions LTD recrute un orthoptiste (H/F) pour exercer au sein d'un cabinet ophtalmologique situé à Sedan. Ce poste en contrat à durée indéterminée constitue une opportunité d'intégrer une structure médicale à taille humaine, où vous jouerez un rôle central dans la prise en charge des patients aux côtés des médecins ophtalmologistes.
Vous assurez l'ensemble des actes orthoptiques dans le cadre de consultations organisées et encadrées.
Vos missions portent principalement sur le bilan visuel, le dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation, ainsi que sur la rééducation orthoptique des patients de tous âges.
Vous contribuez activement à la fluidité des consultations en réalisant les examens complémentaires nécessaires à l'établissement du diagnostic médical.
Le poste est ouvert aux candidats débutants. Vous bénéficiez d'un encadrement adapté à votre niveau d'expérience et d'une montée en compétences progressive dans un environnement clinique structuré. Cette configuration est particulièrement favorable pour les orthoptistes souhaitant consolider leur pratique clinique en sortie de formation.
Vous évoluez dans un cadre de travail stable, avec des horaires définis permettant un équilibre satisfaisant entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Les équipements techniques mis à disposition sont adaptés aux exigences de la pratique orthoptique contemporaine, incluant les outils de réfractométrie, de périmétrie et d'imagerie fonctionnelle.
Ce poste représente une opportunité concrète de développer votre expertise clinique au sein d'une équipe médicale investie dans la qualité des soins apportés à ses patients.
Profil recherché:
Titulaire du Certificat de Capacité d'Orthoptiste (CCO), vous êtes débutant(e) ou disposez d'une première expérience en cabinet ophtalmologique ou en structure de soins. Les candidatures en sortie de formation sont les bienvenues.
- Maîtrise des techniques de bilan visuel et de réfraction subjective et objective
- Connaissance des protocoles de dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation
- Capacité à réaliser des examens complémentaires ophtalmologiques : réfractométrie, périmétrie, et imagerie fonctionnelle
- Aptitude à conduire des séances de rééducation orthoptique auprès de patients de tous âges, de la pédiatrie à la gériatrie
- Connaissance des pathologies relevant du champ orthoptique : strabisme, amblyopie, troubles oculomoteurs, basse vision
- Capacité à travailler en coordination avec les médecins ophtalmologistes dans le cadre de consultations structurées
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de traçabilité et de suivi patient utilisés en cabinet médical
- Rigueur dans la réalisation des actes et sens des responsabilités vis-à-vis des patients
- Qualités relationnelles permettant d'instaurer un climat de confiance avec des patients d'horizons et d'âges variés
- Capacité d'adaptation et volonté de progresser dans un environnement clinique encadré
- Sens de l'organisation pour contribuer à la fluidité des consultations au sein du cabinet

Bilklargjører søkes til Innlandet Bilutleie – 60 % stilling, førerkort klasse B kreves
jobs.description:
Vi søker en effektiv og pålitelig bilklargjører til vårt team i Gjøvik. Hos oss får du en variert og fysisk arbeidshverdag med klargjøring av leiebiler, og vi ser etter deg som liker å jobbe praktisk, effektivt og nøye. Erfaring er ikke nødvendig – opplæring gis.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er nøye, pålitelig og tar stolthet i arbeidet du gjør. En bil skal ikke bare se ren ut -- den skal være ordentlig klargjort og klar for neste kunde.

Du må være grundig og ha et godt øye for detaljer, både når det gjelder vask og når du kontrollerer bilen for skader eller andre avvik. Vi ser også etter deg som tar ansvar, jobber selvstendig og sier ifra dersom du oppdager noe som ikke er som det skal.

Du trenger ikke ha erfaring fra bilutleie eller bilpleie fra før. Det viktigste er at du er lærevillig, effektiv og opptatt av å gjøre en skikkelig jobb.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Innlandet Bilutleie søker bilvasker / bilklargjører i Gjøvik

Vi søker en pålitelig og effektiv medarbeider til vask og klargjøring av våre leiebiler.

Arbeidsdagen vil hovedsakelig bestå av:

  • Innvendig og utvendig vask av biler

  • Støvsuging og rengjøring

  • Klargjøring og enkel kontroll av biler før utleie

  • Flytting av biler og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til bilparken

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er pålitelig og møter til avtalt tid

  • Jobber effektivt og er opptatt av et godt resultat

  • Trives med fysisk arbeid og høyt tempo

  • Kan jobbe selvstendig, men også fungerer godt sammen med andre

  • Har førerkort klasse B -- dette er et krav

Tidligere erfaring med bilpleie eller klargjøring er en fordel, men ikke nødvendig. Du vil få nødvendig opplæring.

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet ca. 60 %, tilsvarende omtrent tre arbeidsdager i uken. Arbeidstid og konkrete dager avtales nærmere.

Vi ønsker en person som kan starte så snart som mulig.

Du trenger ikke skrive en lang søknad. Send oss noen korte ord om deg selv, når du kan starte og telefonnummeret ditt.

Arbeidssted: Gjøvik

Arbeidsgiver: Innlandet Bilutleie AS

Vi tilbyr

Hos Innlandet Bilutleie blir du en del av et lite og uformelt arbeidsmiljø med korte beslutningsveier og varierte arbeidsdager. Du får ansvar og tillit tidlig, samtidig som du får god opplæring i oppgavene.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et hyggelig og uformelt arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte arbeidsdager med praktiske oppgaver

  • God opplæring -- erfaring er ikke nødvendig

  • Selvstendig arbeid og ansvar

  • Mulighet til å lære mer om bil, bilutleie og drift

  • Forutsigbar deltidsstilling med mulighet for mer arbeid ved behov

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Vi er en liten organisasjon der alle bidrar, og hvor det er kort vei fra idé til handling. For den rette personen kan det også være muligheter for mer ansvar og flere oppgaver over tid.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bilklargjører søkes til Innlandet Bilutleie -- 60 % stilling, førerkort klasse B kreves

jobs.title: Sykepleier
jobs.description:
Brenner du for å utgjøre en ekte forskjell i menneskers liv?. Enten du er den sprudlende energibunten som sprer umiddelbar glede, eller den rolige, strukturerte 
klippen som har full kontroll - vi trenger akkurat dine superkrefter.

Hos Nidarvoll hjemmetjeneste feirer vi ulikheter, for det er sammen vi skaper byens råeste arbeidsplass.

Vi har nå ledig tre faste 100 prosent stilling som sykepleier. Er du klar for ditt neste karrieresteg?

Hvorfor velge oss?

  • Topp fasiliteter: Flytt inn i store , lyse og moderne lokaler på Risvollan helse og velferdssenter
  • Smertefri pendling: Gode bussforbindelser og gratis parkering for alle ansatte
  • Faglig tyngde med sjarm: Bli del av et fargerikt, internasjonalt og brennende dedikert fagmiljø
  • Vi heier på din karriere: Du får tilbud om kurs, fagdager og muligheter for videreutdanning

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Som sykepleier vil du få ansvar for et helhetlig pasientforløp og å utføre sykepleie til våre pasienter i tråd med krav til kvalitet
  • Observasjon, behandling og pleie
  • Legemiddelhåndtering
  • Håndtering av medisinteknisk utstyr som blant annet smertepumper og ernæringspumper.
  • Utøvelse av eget fag i samsvar med lokale og sentrale rutiner
  • Samarbeid med fastleger og andre ulike aktører
  • Veiledning av andre kolleger og være veileder for sykepleie studenter
  • Sikre god dokumentasjon
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Offentlig godkjent sykepleier
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige norskkunnskaper
  • Evne til å arbeide systematisk og strukturert
  • Førerkort for bil
Personlige egenskaper
  • Evner til å jobbe selvstendig og i team
  • Du har interesse for fagutvikling og opptatt av kvalitet
  • Har tydelige og gode etiske og faglige holdninger
  • Du er motivert, engasjert og interesse for den enkelte pasient
  • Liker faglige utfordringer
  • Du liker å jobbe i turnus
  • Bidrar aktivt til et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Du har lyst og evne til å jobbe i hjemmetjenesten
Vi tilbyr
  • Varierte og faglig utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter og individuell opplæring
  • Veiledning og tett oppfølging av din avdelingsleder og din egen sykepleiefaglige mentor
  • Mulighet for videreutdanning
  • Faste fagdager og kursdager
  • Stor medvirkning på egen turnus/arbeidsplan
  • Et godt og inkluderende faglig felleskap og arbeidsmiljø
  • Parkeringsmuligheter
  • Simulatorrom med medisinteknisk utstyr, herunder Nursing Anne Simulator dukke
  • Vi tilbyr lønn basert på sentrale tariffavtaler og Trondheim kommunes lokale lønnspolitikk med fagstiger og lokale lønnsmodeller. Lønn avtales ut fra din kompetanse, erfaring og stillingens ansvar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Trondheim kommune 

Trondheim kommune er landets tredje største kommune, og Norges største arbeidsplass nord for Dovre med om lag 15 000 medarbeidere. Sammen jobber vi for å gi byens innbyggere gode helse- og velferdstjenester, oppvekst- og utdanningsmuligheter, kultur- og fritidstilbud og et godt bymiljø. Trondheim kommune håndterer samfunnskritiske oppgaver og informasjon som krever ekstra forsiktighet for å ivareta sikkerheten og tryggheten til innbyggerne og samfunnet. Derfor er det viktig for oss at du som søker er en person vi kan stole på, som tar kloke valg og er lojal mot samfunnsoppdraget. 

Trondheim kommune er en framtidsrettet og moderne arbeidsgiver som samarbeider med byens forsknings-, universitets- og høgskolemiljø. Hos oss finnes det spennende karrieremuligheter innen en svært bredt spekter av fagfelt. Mange av våre medarbeidere har hatt et langt og variert karriereløp internt i organisasjonen. Vi er stadig på utkikk etter nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere. Les mer om Trondheim kommune på vår hjemmeside og siden Jobb hos oss.

Trondheim kommune legger til rette for mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion, etnisitet, eller hull i CV-en. Trondheim kommune tilrettelegger arbeidsforholdene så langt det er mulig.

Deltidsansatte i Trondheim kommune som ønsker utvidelse av sin stilling og som er kvalifisert oppfordres og tilbys her å søke på stillinger som er utlyst. 

Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å benytte Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (tidligere NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om anonymitet, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25. 

Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges der det er påkrevd. Gyldig legitimasjon fremvises både på intervju og første arbeidsdag. 

Som en del av vårt samfunnsansvar og vårt arbeid med personellsikkerhet, foretar vi bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater der dette er relevant.

jobs.title: Vernepleier
jobs.description:
Er du vernepleieren som vil utgjøre en reel forskjell, både for pasientene og i et råsterkt tverrfaglig team?

Nidarvoll hjemmetjeneste rigger seg for fremtiden og nå girer vi opp den tverrfaglige slagkraften vår.

Vi søker en engasjert og handlekraftig vernepleier til en fast 100 prosent stilling.

Enten du er en erfaren ringrev fra kommune eller spesialisthelsetjenesten, eller en sulten nyutdannet som vil ha den beste starten på karrieren - her får du rom til å vokse.

Hvorfor velge oss:

  • Faglig muskler og videreutdanning: Vi snakker ikke bare om utvikling, vi investerer i den. Hos oss blir du oppmuntret tilrettelagt for å ta videreutdanning
  • Trygg og råstart: Som nyansatt blir du ikke kastet på dypt vann. Med vår mentorordning og to ukers skreddersydd opplæring får du den verktøykassen du trenger for å lykkes.
  • Arbeidsglede i monitor: Vi er stolte av det gode, inkluderende og humørfylte arbeidsmiljøet vårt. her støtter vi hverandre, feirer oppturene og løser utfordringene sammen

Mer informasjon om jobb i helse i Trondheim kommune finnes på vår hjemmeside. 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utføre ulike helsetjenester og miljøarbeid til våre pasienter etter pasienters vedtak og tjenestetilbud
  • Legemiddelhåndtering
  • Være primærkontakt for pasienter og følge opp kvalitetsrutinen helhetlig pasientforløp
  • Utvikle et godt pårørende samarbeid
  • Delta aktivt med din vernepleie kompetanse  i eksterne og interne møter
  • Samarbeid med kolleger, fastleger og sykehus
  • Veileder for vernepleier studenter
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid med ulike yrkesgrupper 
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Offentlig godkjent vernepleier
  • Førerkort for bil
  • Gode muntlige og skiftlige norskkunnskaper
Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som har:

  • Tydelige etiske og faglige holdninger
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og deltar aktivt med dine fagkunnskaper i teamet
  • Trives med og er i stand til å jobbe selvstendig
  • Bidrar til fagutvikling og forbedring av tjenesten
  • Fokuserer på løsninger og fleksibilitet
  • Bidrar aktivt til et positivt arbeidsmiljø
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Store muligheter for medbestemmelse og påvirkning av din arbeidsplan/turnus
  • Varierte og faglig utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter og individuell opplæring
  • Veiledning og tett oppfølging fra din avdelingsleder
  • Oppfølging fra din egen  mentor.
  • Mulighet for videreutdanning
  • Nursing Anne Simulator dukke som i tillegg til å benyttes som en pasientsimulator også kan benyttes som en ferdighetstrener
  • Faste fagdager og kursdager i arbeidsplan
  • Et godt og inkluderende faglig fellesskap og arbeidsmiljø
  • Parkeringsmuligheter
  • Vi tilbyr lønn basert på sentrale tariffavtaler og Trondheim kommunes lokale lønnspolitikk med fagstiger og lokale lønnsmodeller. Lønn avtales ut fra din kompetanse, erfaring og stillingens ansvar.

Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å benytte Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (tidligere NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om anonymitet, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25. 

Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges der det er påkrevd. Gyldig legitimasjon fremvises både på intervju og første arbeidsdag. 

Som en del av vårt samfunnsansvar og vårt arbeid med personellsikkerhet, foretar vi bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater der dette er relevant.

jobs.title: Engineering Site Lead
jobs.description:
Perplexity is revolutionizing how people discover and interact with information through AI-powered search and knowledge tools. As we expand our global footprint, we're establishing a strategic presence in London to drive innovation and growth across Europe.

The Role:

We're seeking an exceptional Site Lead to establish and scale our London office. This is a unique opportunity to shape Perplexity's presence in one of the world's leading tech hubs, building teams and culture from the ground up while driving technical excellence in infrastructure and AI systems.

As Site Lead, you'll serve as the face of Perplexity in London, responsible for building our technical organization, fostering a world-class engineering culture, and directly managing one or more infrastructure teams. You'll report to senior leadership and work cross-functionally with teams across our global footprint.

 

The individual in this role will manage teams in LON themselves while also facilitating.

 

Responsibilities:

Site Leadership & Culture

  • Establish and lead Perplexity's London office, setting the cultural foundation and operating principles

  • Build a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture that aligns with Perplexity's values while embracing the strengths of the London tech ecosystem

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all London-based activities and represent the site in company-wide strategic discussions

  • Partner with People/HR, Finance, and Operations to ensure seamless site operations

  • Drive local community engagement, partnerships, and Perplexity's brand presence in the London and European tech community

 

Technical Leadership:

  • Directly manage and mentor one or more infrastructure or AI infrastructure teams in London (5-15+ engineers)

  • Set technical direction and strategy for London-based infrastructure initiatives in alignment with company-wide goals

  • Drive architectural decisions and technical excellence across teams

  • Ensure robust systems for deployment, monitoring, scalability, and reliability of infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads

  • Collaborate with engineering leaders globally to align on technical standards, best practices, and cross-site initiatives

 

Team Building & Talent:

  • Build and scale high-performing infrastructure and AI infrastructure teams through strategic hiring

  • Develop and execute talent acquisition strategy for the London site in partnership with recruiting

  • Create career development frameworks and growth opportunities for engineers

  • Foster technical mentorship and knowledge sharing across teams and sites

 
 

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Research teams globally to understand infrastructure needs and deliver solutions

  • Coordinate with other site leads and engineering leaders to ensure effective cross-site collaboration

  • Contribute to company-wide infrastructure strategy and roadmap planning

  • Facilitate knowledge transfer and best practice sharing across global teams

Qualifications:

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering with 5+ years in infrastructure, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure roles

  • 3+ years of people management experience, including building and scaling teams

  • Proven track record of establishing or significantly growing an engineering site or office

  • Deep technical expertise in distributed systems, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and infrastructure automation

  • Experience with infrastructure supporting large-scale AI/ML systems, including:

  • GPU infrastructure and orchestration

  • ML training and inference pipelines

  • Model serving and deployment at scale

  • Strong understanding of modern infrastructure technologies: Kubernetes, Terraform, container orchestration, CI/CD systems

  • Demonstrated ability to set technical vision and drive execution across multiple teams

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth technology companies

  • Passion for building inclusive, diverse, and high-performing teams

Preferred

  • Experience at companies focused on AI/ML, search, or large-scale consumer applications

  • Previous experience as a site lead, office lead, or similar multi-team leadership role

  • Background in building infrastructure for LLM training or inference

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or AI infrastructure projects

  • Experience scaling teams from 0 to 20+ engineers

  • Active involvement in the London or European tech community

  • MBA or advanced technical degree

What Success Looks Like:

30 Days

  • Deep understanding of Perplexity's infrastructure, technology stack, and organizational structure

  • Established relationships with key stakeholders across engineering, product, and leadership

  • Initial hiring plan and culture strategy for London site established

  • Help the Search, API, AI and Infra teams build out their hiring pipelines

 

90 Days

  • Core infrastructure team established and ramping in London

  • Clear technical roadmap and priorities defined for London-based teams

  • Site culture and operating rhythms established (team meetings, all-hands, cross-site syncs)

  • London office actively participating in company-wide infrastructure initiatives

 

1 Year

  • London site operating as a high-functioning hub with 15-30+ engineers

  • Infrastructure teams delivering measurable impact on system reliability, performance, and scalability

  • Strong talent brand established in London market with healthy hiring pipeline

  • London recognized internally as a strategic site contributing to Perplexity's technical leadership

 

Why Join Perplexity

  • Ground-floor opportunity to build and lead a strategic site for a fast-growing AI company

  • Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure challenges at massive scale

  • Shape the culture and technical direction of an entire office

  • Competitive compensation including equity

  • Comprehensive benefits package

  • Flexible work environment

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact on how millions of people access and interact with information

Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid)

jobs.title: Head of Marketing (Director)
jobs.description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to take full ownership of our marketing strategy, rebrand Keyrock and reposition us as the market evolves from crypto-native to institutional, merging with traditional finance.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a transformation mandate with full discretionary decision-making on how to implement our commercial strategy. You will work as a close strategic partner to the CCO, operating almost as co-marketeers.

The team is lean by design: 2-3 direct reports plus heavy use of AI and agentic tooling. We are looking for someone who inspires and sets direction, not someone who runs campaigns. Operational execution will increasingly be handled by AI agents.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the complete rebrand and repositioning of Keyrock in the market

  • Define and drive the marketing strategy across institutional and crypto-native audiences

  • Build a premium, forward-looking brand identity. Think distinctive, audacious, credible to both institutional allocators and crypto-native operators

  • Push information into the market in ways that make people pay attention and take Keyrock seriously

  • Partner closely with the CCO and commercial team to drive measurable commercial impact

  • Build and lead a small, high-impact team augmented by AI tooling

  • Shape how Keyrock is perceived as the industry converges with traditional finance

Who You Are

  • Crypto-native. You have been through market cycles. You understand blockchain technology deeply but you are pragmatic, not ideological. You know this is not a binary world.

  • A brand-builder, not an ops person. You are inspiring, not operational. You set direction, tone and creative vision.

  • An exceptional communicator. You can face institutional allocators who care about regulation and licensing, and crypto-native counterparties who value speed and edge. You switch between both with ease.

  • Confident and assertive. You project authority. You bring conviction and directness - you challenge constructively and don't default to consensus. You bring edge, energy and a slightly audacious style.

  • Human-centric. You connect with people, build followership and bring teams along.

  • Detail-oriented. Despite the strategic focus, you sweat the details on brand consistency, messaging precision and design quality.

  • A challenger mindset. You dare to think differently, question the status quo and push things forward through constructive tension.

Our Recruitment Philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Experience and Background

Required

  • Significant experience in marketing leadership at a crypto or digital-asset firm

  • Deep understanding of the crypto market, its participants and its culture

  • Track record of building or transforming a brand in a fast-moving, commercially-driven environment

  • Strong communication skills Exceptional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or closely aligned with the CET time zone.

Preferred

  • Experience positioning a firm through a TradFi/crypto convergence narrative

  • Exposure to publicly listed or IPO-track companies

  • Familiarity with EU regulatory environment (MiCA) and how it shapes marketing and financial promotions

  • Experience working with or building AI-augmented marketing functions

Why Keyrock

  • Step-up opportunity. Own the function globally, report directly to the CCO, shape the brand from scratch.

  • Transformation moment. Keyrock is pivoting from appreciated-but-underrated to a firm that commands respect. This is a before-and-after career story.

  • Commercial partnership. Not a siloed marketing role. Deeply embedded in commercial strategy with commission upside.

  • Lean and AI-augmented. Small team, big impact. No bureaucratic bloat. Use agents and tools to move fast.

  • Global footprint. Offices across EU, UK, US and Switzerland. International exposure from day one.

  • Competitive offer. A competitive compensation package, attractive global benefits, and a performance-based variable.

  • Annual Team Retreats. A yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

The Implementation Team is responsible for the onboarding of all our Premium and Pro customers on the Perk platform, and providing recommendations to optimize the customer experience. We guide new customers from signup to launch, providing consultative, administrative, technical, and educational support to maximize the customer’s experience with the Perk platform.

You'll use your platform expertise and stakeholder management skills to build a bridge between platform capabilities and customer expectations. In order to serve the customer beyond the bounds of the platform you'll produce a thoughtful rollout plan that accurately covers the scope of the specific customer’s needs, including immediate travel and a long term success. As an IS, you'll be both a mentor and an example to the Implementation team and across the Revenue organization.
The IS ensures that new customers are fully prepared to use Perk to book their business travel, by executing platform configuration, providing technical support and troubleshooting, and user readiness. This includes configuring customer accounts to their specifications and requirements, providing proactive support on any integrations, as well as coordinating and executing tailored training sessions with key customer stakeholders.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Provide the first impression of Perk to all customers in your portfolio and serve as the first point of contact for customers during the implementation process.

  • Define the best onboarding strategy, leading the change within the customer´s org and providing support in any technical aspects related to the integrations and account setup. That means preparing and executing onboarding plans through the use of project management.

  • Carry out consultative conversations with customers to collect their requirements.

  • Proactively providing customers with recommendations with your experience and data-driven best practice recommendations.

  • Drive customer onboarding forward by providing influential recommendations and creating urgency for customer stakeholders.

  • Manage the rollout of a new platform for your customers; providing guides, templates, and recommendations to the customer for how to ensure adoption and long-term success of the platform.

  • Take full ownership of timeline, rollout plan and handling of the account while the account is in implementation, including directing work through the internal team supporting customers and, in essence, being the subject matter expert in the area of change management.

  • Take on additional projects related to IS Team alignment with other departments. Ensure that project team members have a clear understanding of timelines, tasks, risks and issues.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated relevant professional experience, either as an Implementation Specialist, Sales, Customer Care, Account Management, Project Management or other related roles.

  • English fluency is essential; strong comprehension, writing, and verbal communication skills are required.

  • Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering complex projects.

  • Although Implementation Specialists need to be tech-savvy and understand some basic technical concepts in the area of integrations and open APIs, they do not need to be experts in this area right away.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

The Process

1) A 20-minute screening call with our Talent Acquisition Partner

2) A 1-hour practical assessment presentation with our Hiring Manager

4) A 30-minute in-person culture‑fit interview in our Birmingham hub

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.



The Role

Due to our rapid growth and the expansion of our research capabilities, we are seeking an experienced Partnerships Manager to lead the development of our R&D "supply chain" across EMEA, ensuring CuspAI has the data, compute, and laboratory access required to accelerate materials discovery.

Your main focus initially will be securing high-value compute agreements and establishing formal data-sharing partnerships with publishers, experimental labs, and academic institutions.   • You are an expert communicator who can translate high-level scientific goals into compelling commercial proposals.

There would be an expectation around you being in the office three days per week depending on which projects you’re working on at the time. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner sites and/or other locations for collaboration and project work.

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
About Us 

Avenir Collective. Building the future of beauty, personal care and lifestyle brands. 

We acquire and scale high-potential consumer brands, bringing together the capital, people and operating expertise to turn strong brands into enduring businesses. Our difference is that we are operators, actively managing our brands and providing the capabilities, infrastructure and expertise they need to scale, while preserving the product, purpose and consumer connection that make each brand special. 

We’re building a connected house of brands where great people, brands and ideas come together. If you’re excited by building businesses, solving problems and working with a collaborative, entrepreneurial team, we’d love to hear from you. 

Your role at a Glance 

The commercially minded, entrepreneurial Head of Product leads the end-to-end product strategy, innovation and lifecycle management across Avenir Collective's portfolio of beauty, personal care and lifestyle brands. This is a high-impact, group-level leadership role responsible for defining and scaling our product capability, ensuring we continue to deliver differentiated, consumer-led products that drive brand growth, commercial performance and long-term competitive advantage.

Reporting to the Chief Brand Officer, this role acts as the strategic product leader for the organisation, partnering closely with Brand Managers, who define brand strategy and positioning, to translate consumer insight, market opportunity and commercial objectives into market-leading product portfolios. You own the innovation roadmap, end-to-end product lifecycle, commercial evaluation, regulatory excellence and supplier partnerships, whilst building the systems, governance and processes required to support a scalable, multi-brand business.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of Avenir Collective's beauty and personal care portfolio, while supporting expansion across adjacent lifestyle categories and integrating future acquisitions into a unified product capability. Working cross-functionally with Brand, Commercial, Supply Chain and Finance, you will ensure product innovation remains a strategic driver of growth, balancing consumer desirability, operational excellence, commercial viability and regulatory compliance

Location & Flexibility

  • Full-time, permanent role based at our modern office in Holborn, London

  • 40 hours per week, 9 am to 6 pm with a one-hour lunch

  • This position is hybrid, with the expectation to go to the office 3 days per week

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Portfolio

  • Own the product strategy and innovation roadmap across our portfolio of beauty, personal care and lifestyle brands, aligned to brand, consumer and commercial priorities. 

  • Identify and assess new product, category and portfolio opportunities using consumer insight, market trends, competitive intelligence and commercial analysis. 

  • Lead portfolio prioritisation and investment decisions, developing robust business cases and ensuring resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities. 

  • Review portfolio performance and drive optimisation, renovation, reformulation, rationalisation and investment decisions. 

Product Development & Innovation

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and development through launch, optimisation and retirement. 

  • Drive innovation across formulations, ingredients, formats, packaging and product experience, with a particular focus on beauty and personal care. 

  • Establish effective stage-gate, project management and product governance processes to deliver products on time, within budget and against agreed commercial objectives. 

  • Partner with Brand, Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain and Finance to ensure products are differentiated, commercially viable, scalable and successfully launched. 

Quality, Regulatory & Commercial Governance

  • Own product quality, regulatory compliance, testing, claims substantiation, labelling and documentation across all products and markets. 

  • Develop strategic supplier and manufacturing partnerships that support innovation, quality, speed to market and commercial value. 

  • Own product costing, margin and development investment governance, ensuring product decisions deliver sustainable commercial returns. 

  • Oversee product IP and integrity, including product naming, trademarks and protection of proprietary innovation. 

Leadership

  • Build and develop a high-performing Product function with strong technical, consumer and commercial capability

  • Establish scalable processes and ways of working that support portfolio growth and the successful integration of future acquired brands.

About the Ideal Candidate 

  • Proven experience leading Product or Product Development within beauty, personal care, consumer goods or adjacent lifestyle categories.

  • Demonstrated success developing and launching commercially successful consumer products from concept through to market.

  • Strong understanding of beauty and personal care product development, regulatory requirements, supplier management and quality standards.

  • Experience building innovation pipelines and managing complex product portfolios across multiple brands.

  • Demonstrated experience developing commercial business cases, product costing models and investment recommendations that balance consumer value with commercial return.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including pricing strategy, margin management and portfolio optimisation.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable product processes, governance frameworks and high-performing teams within a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

  • Passion for innovation, consumer insight, and developing products that strengthen brand equity and deliver sustainable commercial growth.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Salary: £80,000 - £90,000 per year

  • 30 days holiday + 8 UK bank holidays

  • Pension contribution Scheme – 5% from you, 3% from us.

  • Private Medical Insurance – Includes travel, vision & dental (Vitality)

  • Work from Abroad – One month per year, anywhere in the world

  • Bonus Scheme – Discretionary bonus, based on individual and company performance

  • Mental Health Support – Free, confidential therapy via Spill

  • Opportunity for International Travel – Our team members have been to New York, Vegas, Amsterdam… and Birmingham!

  • Flexi-Fridays – Finish early one Friday per month

  • Avenir Events – Quarterly meetups, celebrations & socials

  • Vibrant Office – Runway East, Bloomsbury

Avenir Collective is proud to be a disability-committed employer registered in the UK. If you identify as having a disability and meet all of the criteria set out in the job description, we would like to support you through the interview stage. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where all employees and applicants can flourish.

Note: By submitting your application to join our talent pool, you consent to the collection and processing of your personal data in accordance with our privacy policy.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Trondheim kommune 

Trondheim kommune er landets tredje største kommune, og Norges største arbeidsplass nord for Dovre med om lag 15 000 medarbeidere. Sammen jobber vi for å gi byens innbyggere gode helse- og velferdstjenester, oppvekst- og utdanningsmuligheter, kultur- og fritidstilbud og et godt bymiljø. Trondheim kommune håndterer samfunnskritiske oppgaver og informasjon som krever ekstra forsiktighet for å ivareta sikkerheten og tryggheten til innbyggerne og samfunnet. Derfor er det viktig for oss at du som søker er en person vi kan stole på, som tar kloke valg og er lojal mot samfunnsoppdraget. 

Trondheim kommune er en framtidsrettet og moderne arbeidsgiver som samarbeider med byens forsknings-, universitets- og høgskolemiljø. Hos oss finnes det spennende karrieremuligheter innen en svært bredt spekter av fagfelt. Mange av våre medarbeidere har hatt et langt og variert karriereløp internt i organisasjonen. Vi er stadig på utkikk etter nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere. Les mer om Trondheim kommune på vår hjemmeside og siden Jobb hos oss.

Trondheim kommune legger til rette for mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion, etnisitet, eller hull i CV-en. Trondheim kommune tilrettelegger arbeidsforholdene så langt det er mulig.

Deltidsansatte i Trondheim kommune som ønsker utvidelse av sin stilling og som er kvalifisert oppfordres og tilbys her å søke på stillinger som er utlyst. 

Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å benytte Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (tidligere NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om anonymitet, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25. 

Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges der det er påkrevd. Gyldig legitimasjon fremvises både på intervju og første arbeidsdag. 

Som en del av vårt samfunnsansvar og vårt arbeid med personellsikkerhet, foretar vi bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater der dette er relevant.

jobs.title: Vernepleier
jobs.description:
Ved Lade bo- og aktivitetstilbud har vi, med snarlig tiltredelse, ledig en fast 100 prosent stilling for vernepleier ved tjenestested Markaplassen 475.

Vi søker nå en kvalifisert og engasjert vernepleier som ønsker å ha fokus på både fagutvikling på enhet og direkte pasientkontakt. Stillingen innebærer turnusarbeid, med arbeid på dag, kveld, og hver tredje helg.

Bo- og aktivitetstilbudene står foran en spennende tid, med stort fokus på å utvikle bærekraftige tjenester for fremtiden. Startskuddet går nå og vi ønsker ansatte som vil være engasjert og deltakende i dette arbeidet.

Ønsker du å være med å bidra til at innbyggere i Trondheim får en god og meningsfull hverdag? Da har du nå muligheten til å bli en del av teamet i BOA.

Lade bo- og aktivitetstilbud er en enhet som gir helse- og omsorgstjenester til mennesker over 18 år med ulike funksjonsnedsettelser. Det kan være en utviklingshemming, fysisk utviklingshemming, utviklingsforstyrrelse, ervervet hjerneskade eller mennesker med psykiske lidelser. Vi tilbyr tjenester i hjemmet,- både heldøgns - og ambulant, aktivitetstilbud og avlastningstilbud. Vi er organisert i flere ulike tjenestesteder i Østbyen, med godt etablerte fagmiljø som er tverrfaglig sammensatt.

Bolig og bomiljø er viktige faktorer i velferd. Det handler om å ha et sted som er ens eget hjem, et sted man kan slappe av, være seg selv, samtidig som det gir mulighet for å delta i arbeid og samfunnsliv. Vi har som mål at de som mottar tjenester skal oppleve god livskvalitet. Vi skal sørge for individuelt tilrettelagte tjenester med menneskets selvbestemmelse i fokus. Vi ønsker engasjerte og deltakende ansatte i dette arbeidet.

Lade bo- og aktivitetstilbud er i dag organisert i flere ulike tjenestesteder, med personalgrupper som er tverrfaglig sammensatt. Sentrale yrkesgrupper er blant annet vernepleiere, sykepleiere, ergoterapeuter, hjelpepleiere, og omsorgsarbeidere.

Bo- og aktivitetstilbudene er en del av universitetskommune- samarbeidet. Vi har nylig etablert universitets-Boa. Dette blir ett forpliktende, gjensidig samarbeid mellom Bo- og aktivitetstilbudene og universitetet, for fag- og kompetanseutvikling. Vi jobber for at de vi bistår, skal få en god og forutsigbar hverdag.

Vi jobber med å implementere positive atferdsstøtte som et felles faglig rammehjelpe for tjenesten.

Mer informasjon om jobb i helse i Trondheim kommune finnes på vår side "jobb hos oss"


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Direkte tjenesteyting i henhold til vedtak, rutiner og prosedyrer
  • Jobbe systematisk med mål, tiltak og evaluering, samt veilede andre på dette området
  • Tilrettelegge for at bruker opplever selvstendighet, utvikling og mestring i hverdagslivet 
  • Bidra til fagutvikling og videreutvikling av tjenestetilbudet
  • Målrettet arbeid med brukere i dagliglivets gjøremål som blant annet stell, pleie, legemidelhåndtering ,i tillegg til individ tilpasset aktivitet
  • Håndtering av utfordrende atferd
  • Jobbe forebyggende i forhold til makt og tvang
  • Kunne inneha funksjonen fagansvarlig primærkontakt
  • Ha rollen som vaktansvarlig
  • Legge til rette for godt samarbeid med pårørende, verge og andre samarbeidspartnere
  • Tverfagligarbeid, veiledning og opplæring av kollegaer, studenter og lærlinger 
  • Ansvar for legemiddelhåndtering og opplæring i henhold til lovverket
  • Dokumentasjon i Helseplattformen
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Krav om norsk autorisasjon i vernepleier
  • Bachelor i helse-, eller sosialfaglig kan vurderes
  • Erfaring med å gi tjenester til mennesker med utviklingshemming eller utviklingsforstyrrelse.
  • Kunnskap om gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk, herunder også Helse- og omsorgstjenestelovens kap. 9
  • Erfaring med å forebygge og håndtere atferd som utfordrer
  • Gode samarbeid - og kommunikasjonsferdigheter 
  • Fordel med erfaring som primærkontakt
  • Fordel med erfaring i ASK
  • Fordel med erfaring i epilepsi
  • God muntlig og skriftlig på norsk på B2-nivå eller høyere.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Har fokus på kvalitet og bidrar til faglig utvikling
  • Du er nysgjerrig og forståelsesfull i møte med tjenestemottakere med ulike atferdsuttrykk
  • Du er god på å skape og opprettholde tillitsfulle relasjoner
  • Du mestrer å stå i krevende situasjoner over tid
  • God samhandlingskompetanse
  • Evne til å veilede kolleger
  • Du mestrer å løse utfordringer på "sparket" og å gjøre justeringer underveis
  • God omstillingsevne og er åpen for endringer 
  • Du tar initiativ og er ansvarsfull
  • Du mestrer å jobbe selvstendig, men samtidig i team.
  • Du har gode etiske holdninger
  • Godt humør og kan bidra til et positivt arbeidsmiljø

Personlig egnethet vektlegges

Vi tilbyr
  • Intern opplæring i PAS - et rammeverk for gode helse- og omsorgstjenester og ASK- alternativ og supplerende kommunikasjon
  • Kurs i MAP - et helhetlig opplæringsprogram for å forebygge og håndtere aggresjons- og voldsproblematikk i helse- og sosialsektoren
  • Kurs i helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven kap. 9 
  • Intern opplæring i rollen som vaktansvarlig
  • Vi tilbyr lønn basert på sentrale tariffavtaler og Trondheim kommunes lokale lønnspolitikk med fagstiger og lokale lønnsmodeller. Lønn avtales ut fra din kompetanse, erfaring og stillingens ansvar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Trondheim kommune 

Trondheim kommune er landets tredje største kommune, og Norges største arbeidsplass nord for Dovre med om lag 15 000 medarbeidere. Sammen jobber vi for å gi byens innbyggere gode helse- og velferdstjenester, oppvekst- og utdanningsmuligheter, kultur- og fritidstilbud og et godt bymiljø. Trondheim kommune håndterer samfunnskritiske oppgaver og informasjon som krever ekstra forsiktighet for å ivareta sikkerheten og tryggheten til innbyggerne og samfunnet. Derfor er det viktig for oss at du som søker er en person vi kan stole på, som tar kloke valg og er lojal mot samfunnsoppdraget. 

Trondheim kommune er en framtidsrettet og moderne arbeidsgiver som samarbeider med byens forsknings-, universitets- og høgskolemiljø. Hos oss finnes det spennende karrieremuligheter innen en svært bredt spekter av fagfelt. Mange av våre medarbeidere har hatt et langt og variert karriereløp internt i organisasjonen. Vi er stadig på utkikk etter nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere. Les mer om Trondheim kommune på vår hjemmeside og siden Jobb hos oss.

Trondheim kommune legger til rette for mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion, etnisitet, eller hull i CV-en. Trondheim kommune tilrettelegger arbeidsforholdene så langt det er mulig.

Deltidsansatte i Trondheim kommune som ønsker utvidelse av sin stilling og som er kvalifisert oppfordres og tilbys her å søke på stillinger som er utlyst. 

Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å benytte Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (tidligere NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om anonymitet, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25. 

Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges der det er påkrevd. Gyldig legitimasjon fremvises både på intervju og første arbeidsdag. 

Som en del av vårt samfunnsansvar og vårt arbeid med personellsikkerhet, foretar vi bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater der dette er relevant.

jobs.title: Flexijob onderhoudstechnieker grootkeukentoestellen
jobs.description:
Ben jij een krak in elektriciteit en elektronica? Zoek je een flexibele bijverdienste? Sleutel je graag aan professionele keukenapparaten?

Kom dan werken als reparateur bij onze toonaangevende partner in professionele keuken- en restaurantinrichtingen in Lummen.

Onze klant is dé B2B-totaalleverancier voor professionele keukeninrichting en horeca-uitrusting. Zij begeleiden professionele klanten zoals horecazaken, scholen en zorginstellingen van A tot Z. Dit gaat van het ontwerpen van complete keukentrajecten tot de levering van specifieke toestellen en tafelbekleding. Zij produceren zelf niet, maar ontzorgen de klant volledig met oplossingen op maat, van ontwerp tot nazorg.

Jouw missie!

Jij bent als technieker de redder in nood voor professionele keukens en grootkeukentoestellen.

  • In het atelier: Je herstelt binnengebrachte professionele keukenapparatuur (o.a. mixers, ovens,…)
  • Op locatie: Je onderhoudt professionele keukenapparatuur bij de klant (o.a. vaatwasser, kookplaat,…). Dit doe je van Limburg tot de grens met Antwerpen en Brussel

Ben jij de vliegende technieker die paraat staat wanneer een keukentoestel stopt met werken?

Herken jij jezelf hierin?

  • Goede basiskennis van elektriciteit en elektronica
  • Heb je al ervaring als technieker met keukenapparaten, elektronica,…? Dan is dit héél mooi meegenomen!
  • Handig en weet van aanpakken
  • Rijbewijs B in je bezit: je onderhoudt keukenapparatuur op locatie bij klanten
  • Flexibel inzetbaar naargelang nood en vraag, zonder vaste uren of dagen (soms 1 à 2 dagen per week, soms een week niet)

jobs.title: Reach truck operator
jobs.description:
TPCE (Toyota Parts Centre Europe) is Toyota's European distribution center. It supplies Toyota and Lexus parts to distributors throughout Europe. In addition, TPCE delivers directly to garages and dealerships in Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, and Northern France. At the Diest facility, imported Toyota and Lexus automotive parts are stored, orders for dealers and distributors are picked and assembled, and shipments are prepared and dispatched. TPCE is a modern, highly automated distribution center specializing in automotive parts logistics.


Jobomschrijving

Toyota Diest is looking for reach truck operators who are passionate about their profession and seeking a long-term career opportunity.

Are you the person we're looking for? Then Toyota is the right place for you!

As a Reach Truck Operator, your responsibilities include:

  • Order picking
  • Moving automotive parts and placing/removing them from warehouse racks
  • Stacking various pallets
  • ...

You will start working in a specific department, where you will learn all aspects of the operation. Over time, you will also become familiar with other departments. At Toyota, there is always room for growth and development! You will have the opportunity to develop into a fully-fledged Toyota team member. Who knows, you might even become Toyota's next supervisor or team leader.

Did you know that?

  • Toyota offers highly stable employment.
  • After approximately six months of employment, you may be offered a long-term contract.
  • Toyota grants permanent contracts to temporary agency workers twice a year.
  • More than 1,000 employees work at Toyota, making it one of the largest employers in the region.
  • Toyota encourages continuous development and promotes a culture based on teamwork and respect.
  • It is the ideal workplace for people who value innovation, people-oriented values, and a stable career.

Experience? Not necessary at all! We invest in our employees and provide comprehensive training. With the right attitude, you'll go a long way!

You are looking for a job where you can build a future. After positive performance evaluations, you may qualify for a permanent contract.

In addition:

  • You have experience operating a reach truck.
  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

jobs.title: Lead Biosensor Scientist - Continuous Monitoring
jobs.description:
About Level Zero
Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health.

Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are.

We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.
 

About the Role

We are seeking a lead biosensor scientist to drive the development and commercialisation of our continuous aptamer sensor platform. The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in developing continuous monitoring devices for regulated healthcare applications, demonstrated experience transitioning research-stage sensors into manufacturing-ready products, and a track record working with in vivo validation studies and large-scale analytical verification programs.

This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London.


What you'll do
  • Lead the development and optimisation of electrochemical continuous sensor systems from bench concept through manufacturing readiness.
  • Design and execute large-scale analytical verification studies, including multi-parameter performance characterisation, stability assessments, and biocompatibility validation.
  • Oversee in vivo validation studies in human subjects and troubleshoot sensor performance in clinical settings.
  • Define manufacturing processes, material specifications, and quality control parameters aligned with regulatory expectations and QMS frameworks.
  • Engage directly with regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) to define performance specifications and shape submission strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts with electrochemistry, microfabrication, and manufacturing to translate designs into scalable production.
  • Develop technical documentation packages (CMC, analytical performance dossiers) for regulatory submissions and investor communications.
  • Mentor junior scientists and technicians in sensor characterisation and assay validation methodologies.

    • What You Bring
  • A Ph.D. degree in electrochemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or related discipline, with specific focus on electrochemical biosensors. Minimum 4 years of industry experience commercialising continuous monitoring or diagnostic sensor technologies.

    • The ideal candidate will possess expertise in the following areas:

  • Deep experience in electrochemical sensor development-particularly amperometric, potentiometric, or impedance-based platforms-with demonstrated progression from research concept to clinical or commercial application.
  • Proven track record managing regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking) for continuous monitoring devices.
  • Strong experience designing and executing large-scale analytical verification studies including stability, accuracy, precision, and matrix interference assessments.
  • Demonstrated experience working with in vivo validation studies, including study design, data interpretation, and regulatory reporting.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing readiness, scale-up strategy, and GMP-compatible processes.
  • Proven ability to operate in QMS-ready environments with familiarity of ISO 13485, design controls, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Understanding of biocompatibility, sterility, and shelf-life requirements for implantable or skin-worn continuous devices.
  • Proficiency in surface chemistry, material selection, and biointerface optimisation.
  • Expertise in aptamer-based biorecognition elements and aptamer optimisation for continuous monitoring applications.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience with microneedle or transdermal ISF technologies.
  • Familiarity with SELEX or aptamer discovery workflows.
  • Experience with MEMS & electrode microfabrication processes.

    • Who You Are
    We value culture as much as we value technical expertise, creating an environment that’s equal parts collaboration, curiosity, and fun.

    We’re a fast-paced, mission-driven young team on a quest to make a lasting impact, fueled by uncompromising integrity, unwavering support for one another, and the thrill of exploring uncharted territories. Our passion for excellence drives everything we do, and we welcome individuals who share our commitment to shaping the future.

    If our vision excites you, here are the qualities we look for:
    • You live and breathe integrity, tackling challenges with honesty and transparency
    • You’re a self-starter who loves diving into the unknown, collaborating on complex problems, and taking full ownership of results
    • You excel at open, clear communication and see every piece of feedback as a springboard for growth—especially in a science and data-focused environment
    • You’re motivated by creating real impact, particularly when it comes to advancing human health
    • You strike a balance between independence and collaboration, knowing when to seek support or invite others to join in
    • You’re confident in defending your ideas, while also valuing respectful, constructive debate as a path to better solutions
    • You thrive in the dynamic atmosphere of a startup, constantly evolving your skill set and fearlessly applying what you learn

    What We Offer
    • A full-time role with a competitive salary and equity options, reflecting our value in your expertise and potential
    • An environment where you’ll collaborate directly with the founding team at a leading biosensor startup, gaining access to industry experts and thought leaders
    • The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration
    • Travel to New York and other potential sites for R&D purposes
    • The excitement of working on cutting-edge technology, shaping strategic decisions, and driving innovation at an early-stage venture alongside a superstar team
    Be Part of Our Journey
    If you're ready to be at the forefront of biosensing innovation and thrive in fast-paced, learning-rich environments, we'd love to hear from you.

    If your skills and experience do not align perfectly with this role, yet you believe you have something unique to offer, we're keen to listen. Reach out to us with a short statement on how you can contribute and let's discuss where you might fit into our team.

jobs.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!
 
E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are fundamentally changing the design, economics, manufacturing, coverage limitations and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.
 
By building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system—with a unique antenna design, highly sustainable spacecraft system and low-cost, small portable end-user devices—we can extend global satellite coverage, capacity and connectivity beyond legacy space services to provide a new kind of IoT platform that lets users sense, track, connect and act on information gathered, anywhere.
 
We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence.

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Digital Hardware Design Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. You will play a key role in the design, development, and delivery of complex digital hardware solutions for high-performance products. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will take ownership of designs from concept through to production, driving technical excellence across the full development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement digital hardware including high-speed interfaces, signal processing, and switching/routing architectures.
  • Develop, simulate, and verify RTL designs, ensuring correctness, timing closure, and design robustness.
  • Define and review hardware architectures, contributing to system-level design decisions and trade-off analyses.
  • Produce and review detailed design documentation, including specifications, schematics, and test plans.
  • Perform functional simulation, static timing analysis, and synthesis targeting FPGAs and/or ASICs.
  • Collaborate with firmware, software, and systems engineers to ensure seamless hardware/software integration.
  • Support hardware verification and validation activities, including lab bring-up and debugging.
  • Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering processes
  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure seamless design for high volume manufacture and test
  • Work with component manufacturers and distributors to ensure longevity of manufacture.
  • Experience with Altium Designer
  • Design principles for operation in harsh environments.

Required Skills & Experience
  • Degree (BEng/MEng/BSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals including clocking strategies, CDC (clock domain crossing), reset architecture, and timing constraints.
  • Experience with FPGA design flows using tools such as Vivado, Quartus, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with simulation tools such as ModelSim, Questa, or similar.
  •  Experience writing and executing hardware test plans and debug at the board level using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers).
  • Strong understanding of high-speed PCB design considerations and signal integrity principles.

Desirable Skills
  • Five or more years experience with high speed digital design.
  • Experience with Altium Designer
  • Experience with Hyperlynx
  • Accelerated life testing

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Vykonávanie administratívnych činností a vedenie obchodnej agendy spojenej s predajom automobilu. Vypracovanie cenových ponúk a návrhy riešenia potrieb podľa zákazníkov v oblasti financovania a poistenia nových vozidiel. Aktívna komunikácia a ponuka príslušenstva. Práca s informačným systémom.
