From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion sits at a rare intersection: a product people love, a flexible system businesses run on, and a new platform for people and AI to work together. We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn that opportunity into products that feel inevitable. You’ll find consequential customer problems, set a bold but grounded strategy, and build alongside design, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market partners. This is a high-agency role for someone excited to shape what Notion becomes next—and make powerful new capabilities feel simple, trustworthy, and delightful to millions of customers.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Uncover the customer problems and product opportunities that will define Notion’s next chapter, then turn them into a focused strategy and roadmap.

 - Take ambitious ideas from first principles to launch, building closely with design and engineering to create experiences that feel simple, useful, and distinctly Notion.

 - Make the hard calls—balancing customer impact, business opportunity, technical complexity, speed, and long-term product quality.

 - Shape how AI changes both the product and the way we build, using it to improve research, decisions, experimentation, and execution.

 - Raise the bar for product thinking across the team by creating clarity, accelerating learning, and establishing principles and success measures that endure.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Demonstrated ability to identify meaningful customer problems and turn them into products that are intuitive, useful, and built with a high level of craft.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs among user experience, business impact, technical complexity, quality, and speed.

 - A track record of moving ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition to shipped outcomes while creating clear ownership and alignment.

 - Customer depth: you can learn directly from users across segments and translate differing needs into a coherent strategy rather than a collection of one-off requests.

 - Practical AI fluency: you use AI to sharpen research, product thinking, decisions, and execution, and you’re excited to rethink how people and agents work together.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building collaborative, productivity, or AI-powered products used by a broad range of customers.

 - Experience operating across both zero-to-one product development and the improvement of products at scale.

 - Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with engineering on complex product systems.

jobs.title: Global Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:


As a Global Security Program Manager on Notion’s Global Safety & Security team, you’ll help protect our people, workplaces, and operations across a distributed global portfolio. This role exists to bring greater consistency to physical security programs as Notion scales—strengthening technology, vendor operations, incident readiness, and local execution without losing the welcoming experience we want employees and guests to feel. You’ll work across Workplace, People, IT, Legal, business leaders, vendors, and building partners, balancing hands-on operations with repeatable program design. This is a remote role based in the United States, with travel to Notion offices, events, and other locations expected—up to 50% based on operational needs.




A GREAT TUESDAY:

 - Review regional differences in access control or visitor management and turn them into clear priorities for the global parity project.

 - Work with a vendor or building manager to resolve a security gap, balancing local context with global standards.

 - Draft an incident update, using AI to improve clarity, then validate the details and judgment behind the message.

 - Coordinate international project work while responding thoughtfully to an urgent operational issue.
   

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, kick off a global physical security parity project that creates shared visibility into regional practices, gaps, and priorities.

 - By your 90th day, use AI to accelerate clear, effective communications, reduce busywork, and keep detail-heavy work accurate and reviewable.

 - By the end of your first year, take ownership of Notion’s physical security technology program, improving how systems, data, and operating practices support safe and resilient workplaces.

 - By the end of your first year, demonstrate program ownership in one major physical security or safety pillar, such as business continuity and disaster recovery, event security, travel risk management, monitoring operations, crisis management, guard force operations, or governance.

 - By the end of your first year, deliver multiple international projects with clear plans, sound judgment, and effective coordination across regions, vendors, and cross-functional partners.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated ability to own physical security or safety programs across multiple sites or regions, including security technology, access control, incident response, or vendor operations.

 - Effective project management skills, with the ability to move multiple international projects from ambiguity to clear plans, decisions, and delivery.

 - Clear, thoughtful communication with internal partners, vendors, building management, and local stakeholders—especially when translating security requirements into practical action.

 - A service-oriented approach and eagerness to help create secure, welcoming workplace experiences; you bring curiosity, ownership, and sound judgment to how you work with others.

 - Novice AI proficiency and a willingness to use AI as a practical collaborator for communication, accuracy checks, documentation, and reducing repetitive work.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $208,000 – $233,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work

As a Senior Securities Lending Product Manager, you will play a leading role in shaping, developing, and commercializing Clearstream's securities lending and borrowing proposition within the broader Collateral, Lending & Liquidity Solutions (CLLS) franchise. The role combines strategic product leadership with practical product ownership across securities lending and borrowing, aligned with collateral management and liquidity, settlement efficiency, regulation, risk, digital transformation, and commercial growth.

You will drive the evolution of securities lending solutions for various clients' segments, ensuring the proposition remains competitive, scalable, risk-aware, operationally robust, and aligned with client demand, market structure, regulatory expectations, and digital capabilities. You will work closely with Trading, Sales and Relationship Management, Client Service, Collateral Management and Liquidity Products, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to translate market opportunities into deliverable product outcomes and resilient day-to-day operating models.

Your responsibilities

• Define, support and execute the strategic roadmap for securities lending and borrowing solutions, aligning product development with client needs, market trends, regulatory change, operational resilience, and the wider CLLS growth strategy.
• Identify opportunities across securities lending, funding and financing, balance-sheet optimization, and settlement efficiency, translating overlapping needs into scalable product capabilities and commercial solutions.
• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept and business case through design, governance, implementation, launch, operational readiness, post-launch performance review, and continuous enhancement.
• Develop clear product positioning, value propositions, pricing approaches, commercial proposals, and go-to-market materials that support client adoption and differentiate Clearstream in the securities finance market.
• Act as a senior subject matter expert on securities lending market structure, lender and borrower dynamics, collateral flows, settlement efficiency, and regulatory developments including SFTR, CSDR, T+1, and evolving capital and liquidity requirements.
• Translate regulatory and market changes, into practical product, operational, legal, and control requirements. Coordinate the alignment across Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and client-facing teams.
• Drive digital transformation across the securities lending proposition, including data-led decision-making, automation, workflow optimization, digital client channels, analytics, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, KPIs, and platform scalability.
• Use market data, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, incident trends, and performance analytics to identify opportunities for revenue growth, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved client experience.
• Maintain strong awareness of risk, credit, collateral eligibility, control frameworks, and operational dependencies to ensure the robustness of the securities lending proposition
• Represent Clearstream at industry conferences, client events, market forums, trade associations, and working groups, contributing to thought leadership and strengthening the firm's market presence.
• Prepare and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales and Relationship management, Trading, Client Service, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and operational sustainability.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, commercially focused, risk-aware, and innovation-oriented product culture.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Financial Markets, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
• 7+ years of experience in securities lending, securities finance, collateral management, market infrastructure, product management, or related capital markets activities.
• Good understanding of securities lending and borrowing, funding and financing market dynamics
• High awareness of the links between securities lending, collateral management, liquidity, funding, capital efficiency, risk, credit, control frameworks, and regulatory constraints in a financial market infrastructure environment.
• Proven track record of executing product strategy, building business cases, managing roadmaps, defining pricing approaches, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in regulated financial services.
• Ability to translate market and regulatory change into clear product impacts, operational requirements, legal documentation needs, control considerations, and implementation priorities.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to convert market intelligence, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, and industry developments into practical product enhancements and revenue opportunities.
• Strong digital and data orientation, with practical understanding of analytics, automation, workflow tools, dashboards, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, platform transformation, KPIs, and Agile delivery concepts.
• Experience engaging in industry forums, client events, working groups, conferences, or market associations,
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus across matrix teams, and drive clarity in complex, technical, or ambiguous situations.
• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills,
• Fluency in English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

Market Head for Central and Northern Europe

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

As Market Head for Central and Northern Europe, you'll directly manage the Netherlands Desk based in Luxembourg and build profitable long-term client relationships. The role focuses on generating Net New Money (NNM), growing Assets Under Management (AUM) and increasing gross revenue through high-quality new client acquisition and deeper client solutions. You'll partner across Global Private Banking (GPB) and Commercial Banking (CMB) to bring the right products and services to clients and prospects. Success means delivering agreed financial targets through a strong pipeline, effective referrals across the Group and consistently high standards of client service. You'll also shape a strong risk and control environment with clear expectations on KYC, sales quality and compliance.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Lead and manage the Netherland Market composed of Senior Relationship Managers (hunters), as well based out of PBLU.
• Drive business development efforts through the focus on new client acquisition of UHNW and Family Office segments in the Netherlands and other key International markets related to your business.
• Stir share of wallet increase discipline with the existing UHNW client base through systematic client planning, sales management, client connectivity and other means.
• Ensure collaboration with other markets and locations within HSBC Private Banking, as well as enhance connectivity with HSBC Commercial and Global Banking business lines in the Netherlands and other key International markets.
• Promote brand visibility of HSBC Private Banking in the Netherlands and other key International markets through various initiatives, including proactive marketing, communication, collaboration with business introducers.
• Actively promote, manage, train, develop and assess all members of the team within assigned area of responsibility.

You should apply if you have:

• Min. 10 years of relevant experience in Private Banking within UHNW Netherlands and other key International client segments.
• Strong hunter mindset, proven track record of growing the business and driving acquisition of new clients.
• Demonstrated track record of leading a team of Relationship Managers.
• Decision maker, capable of providing judgment and clear direction within the established framework.
• Fluency in English and Dutch. French and/or German would be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Strategic Finance Business Partner to support our AI team and other business functions. Our Strategic Finance Business Partnership team serves as a trusted advisor to the company, driving our financial planning, forecasting, and review processes, and guiding critical decisions through insightful analyses and strategic thought partnership.

This is a high-impact role on a lean team: you’ll partner deeply across Engineering and Product to strengthen executive-level visibility into financial performance, improve forecast accuracy, and evaluate strategic investments across our product.

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Deliver thoughtful analyses to support strategic decisions with strong judgment, speed, and attention to detail.

 - Support the monthly close and reporting process with Accounting, vendor and PO tracking, budget-versus-actuals cost analyses, and flux reviews

 - Partner with the AI team, Product, Data Science, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to deliver accurate forecasts and budgets.

 - Strengthen AI cost data and reporting infrastructure by identifying data gaps, improving recurring workflows, and using AI and automation to make reporting more durable, scalable, and timely.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

    Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.description:
**Hae neuvojaksi Salon työllisyysalueella maahan muuttaneiden omankieliseen ohjaus- ja neuvontapalveluun 1.11.2026-31.12.2027!**

Monikulttuurinen varhaiskasvatus, koulu ja koti (Mvkk) ry. hakee neuvojan, joka osaa darin-, pashtun ja persian kieliä, maahan muuttaneiden omankieliseen ohjaus- ja neuvontapalveluun Salon työllisyysalueella.

Palvelun tavoitteena on antaa ohjausta ja neuvontaa maahan muuttaneille heidän omalla äidinkielellään eri laisissa kysymyksissä, jotka saattavat liittyä toimeen tuloon, perheasioihin, työhön, oleskelulupa-asioihin, asumiseen tms.

Neuvojalta vaaditaan seuraavat kriteerit. Näiden kriteerien valossa voit vastata lomakkeeseen

- Neuvojan tulee käyttää pääasiallisena neuvontakielenä äidinkieltään tai äidinkieleen verrattavissa olevaa kieltään. Eli ohjaajalla tulee olla neuvontakielensä osalta vähintään hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen kielitaito, ja hän on pitänyt ja pitää kielitaitoansa jatkuvasti yllä sekä päivittää sanastoa Suomessa ja ohjaajan työssä tarvittavilla käsitteillä.

- Neuvojalla tulee olla ajankohtainen maahanmuutto- ja kotouttamistyön tuntemus. Lisäksi hänellä tulee olla hyvä ymmärrys yhteiskunnan ja erityisesti sen peruspalveluiden toiminnasta, tarvittava maahanmuuttoon liittyvä lainsäädäntö- sekä tarvittava alueen paikallistuntemus (paikalliset toimijat ja palvelut).

- Lisäksi neuvojalla tulee olla yleistä tietämystä suomalaisesta yhteiskunnasta ja tavoista sekä siitä, miten ne eroavat asiakkaiden lähtömaista.

- Neuvojan tulee pyrkiä löytämään oikea tieto asiakkaan kysymykseen. Hänen tulee myös pystyä asioimaan asiallisesti ja ymmärrettävästi puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse eri palveluntuottajien ja viranomaisten kanssa. Työssä tarvitaan myös hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, asiakaspalvelun ja kohtaamisen taitoja sekä kulttuurisensitiivisyyttä.

- Neuvojan suomen kielen taito tulee olla vähintään B2.2 taitotaso, jotta hän voi kommunikoida eri viranomaisten ja työntekijöiden kanssa sekä suullisesti että kirjallisesti, ja auttaa asiakkaita kirjallisesti lomakkeiden täytössä sekä muussa kirjallisessa viestinnässä. Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa tarvitaan myös erilaisessa tiedonhankinnassa sekä ohjauksen tiimityössä.

- Neuvojalla tulee olla vähintään ammatillinen peruskoulutus ja suoritettu ammatillinen tutkinto ja vähintään yhden vuoden kokemus maahanmuuttajien ohjaus- ja neuvontatyöstä tai vastaavasta työstä tai vapaaehtoistyöstä (esim. ohjaaja, kouluttaja tms.).

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll build and run the global operating system that drives Land: the strategy, programs, and operating mechanisms that create net-new and upgrade iARR across regions.

This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency.

You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build and lead the global net-new business motion: define strategy, program portfolio, operating cadence, governance, and performance standards across regions

 - Own the global net new business strategy for Land, including ICP and segmentation guardrails, plays, coverage model assumptions, annual and quarterly planning, sequencing, and investment trade-offs

 - Establish global definitions and standards for stages, qualification, handoffs, pipeline math assumptions, and reporting integrity

 - Build and run global pipeline generation programs in partnership with Marketing and regional leaders, including campaign-to-pipeline motions, partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account plays, and field event program standards

 - Define the measurement framework for new business programs, connecting inputs to outputs and outcomes across cost, pipeline, iARR, velocity, and win-rate lift

 - Partner with SC leadership and practice owners to ensure the Land-side SC motion has standard plays, discovery patterns, demo and problem-solving expectations, certification paths, ramp mechanisms, and ongoing bar-raising rituals

 - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models

 - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Senior GTM leadership experience owning new business acquisition programs at scale across multiple regions

 - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity

 - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change

 - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms

 - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency

 - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution

 - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions

 - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and help customers achieve better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market

 - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation

 - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact

 - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale

jobs.title: Souschef søges til 7-Eleven
jobs.description:
Souschef søges til 7-Eleven

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst souschef til vores 7-Eleven-butik på Istedgade.

Som souschef bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med butikschefen og resten af teamet. Du skal være med til at sikre en veldrevet butik, høj kundeservice og en god oplevelse for både kunder og medarbejdere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af daglig drift af butikken, kundeservice og salg, koordinering og oplæring af medarbejdere, varebestilling og vareopfyldning, modtagelse af leverancer, kontrol af lager og svind, kassehåndtering og kasseafstemning samt sikring af, at butikkens standarder for rengøring, fødevaresikkerhed og egenkontrol bliver overholdt.

Du vil desuden hjælpe butikschefen med vagtplanlægning og den daglige ledelse af medarbejderne og have ansvar for butikken, når butikschefen ikke er til stede.

Vi forventer

Vi søger en person, der er serviceminded, stabil og ansvarsbevidst og som trives i en travl butik med mange kunder.

Erfaring fra detailhandel, convenience, restaurant eller lignende er en fordel. Ledererfaring er ligeledes en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har lyst og evne til at tage ansvar og lede andre medarbejdere.

Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, bevare overblikket i travle perioder og være fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider.

Da butikken har åbent alle ugens dage, vil arbejdstiden kunne ligge på dag-, aften-, nat- og weekendvagter.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk og/eller engelsk på et niveau, der gør dig i stand til at varetage jobbet.

Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder en fast fuldtidsstilling i en travl og spændende 7-Eleven-butik med ansvar og mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Arbejdstiden er fuldtid og planlægges efter vagtplan.

Løn, pension, ferie og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår aftales i forbindelse med ansættelsen og følger de gældende regler og vilkår for stillingen.

Stillingsbetegnelse: Souschef
Ansættelse: Fastansættelse
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
Antal stillinger: 1
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale

Er du interesseret i stillingen, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

The Senior Project Manager will work closely with the process owner and coordinate the initiative across Privacy, Legal, Data, Technology and relevant business stakeholders. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
jobs.description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

You’ll build and run Replit’s acquisition pipeline, identifying the teams and technologies that can accelerate our mission. You’ll develop a deep understanding of the AI, developer tools, and software infrastructure ecosystem. You’ll build relationships with founders, investors, and industry participants to source and evaluate mergers & acquisitions.

This is a hands-on ownership role for someone who combines strong transaction execution skills with product judgment, relationship-building ability, and the ability to drive complex decisions across teams. You’ll work closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, AI, Engineering, People and Legal. The role reports to the Head of Finance, but partners very closely with our Co-Founder & CEO and President & Head of AI.



What You’ll Do

 - Shape M&A strategy: Partner with senior leadership to define where M&A can accelerate Replit’s product and company strategy, translating strategic priorities into actionable acquisition themes and target areas.

 - Source opportunities: Proactively identify acqui-hire, tuck-in and large-scale acquisition opportunities aligned with Replit’s strategic priorities.

 - Develop relationships: Establish trusted relationships with founders, investors, bankers, operators, and other participants across the ecosystem. Identify and attend industry events to source M&A opportunities.

 - Map the ecosystem: Build and maintain a detailed view of relevant markets, including AI infrastructure, developer tools, emerging technologies, competitors, and potential M&A targets.

 - Evaluate strategic fit: Assess companies and opportunities based on product alignment, market position, technical differentiation, financial profile, and potential value to Replit. Partner with Product, AI, and Engineering leaders to assess build, buy, and partner alternatives and deliver clear go/no-go recommendations.

 - Lead transaction execution: Own the transaction process from initial evaluation through signing and closing. Lead valuation and financial modeling, structure transactions, drive cross-functional due diligence, and lead negotiations in partnership with executive sponsors and Legal. Be accountable for the deal workplan, timelines, risk escalation, and decision materials. Coordinate integration planning with functional leaders, establishing clear owners and success measures before close.



Required Skills and Experience

 - 8+ years of experience in corporate development, venture capital, investment banking, or a related strategic role.

 - Strong product & technological intuition.

 - Demonstrated experience leading technology transactions through signing and closing, with direct responsibility for valuation, due diligence, transaction structuring, and negotiation.

 - Experience researching markets, identifying companies, and developing actionable opportunity pipelines.

 - Strong financial modeling, valuation, and analytical skills.

 - Ability to synthesize complex product, technical, market, and financial information into clear recommendations.

 - Strong relationship-building and written and verbal communication skills.

 - High degree of ownership, curiosity, and comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

 - Proven ability to own complex transaction workstreams, hold cross-functional teams accountable to deadlines, and resolve issues across technical, business, and external advisory teams.



Bonus Points

 - Existing relationships across the AI, developer tools, or software infrastructure ecosystem.

 - Experience at a scaling technology company.

jobs.title: Practice Assistant @ White & Case
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled assistant eager to grow your expertise in an international law firm? Do you thrive on helping others in a fast-paced environment? Are you known for your proactive and detail-oriented approach to work?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because this could be the position for you!

**We are looking for** a practice assistant to join White & Case's team in a full-time, permanent position. Key tasks in this role include assisting lawyers with client-related work, along with other tasks to ensure that the daily operations run smoothly at the office. As a practice assistant, you will join a dynamic team of 45 professionals in the Helsinki office.

**In this role,** you will provide assistance across all practice groups. Your responsibilities include a wide range of administrative tasks, such as assisting lawyers with editing and formatting legal documentation, conducting research, providing translation support, as well as preparing and maintaining transaction data rooms. In addition, your duties include liaising with clients, various governmental authorities as well as White & Case's global offices. As a practice assistant, you are also ready to provide support with meeting arrangements, calendar management and other back-office duties.

**You will join** an efficient team of four practice assistants as the fifth member of the team and share your daily work with three evening assistants, a reception assistant and a senior practice assistant. White & Case's team works mainly on-site at their office in the heart of Helsinki, with the flexibility to work remotely once a week during most weeks.

**You may be the person we are looking for if you:**

- have at least one year of experience in a legal assistant or an administrative assistant role within a professional services organization, ideally in a law firm, consulting firm or financial institution;

- have a suitable educational background, such as a Bachelor of Business Administration degree;

- are highly organized and demonstrate great attention to detail;

- enjoy taking initiative and working independently while valuing teamwork and supporting your colleagues;

- are skilled in managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high quality in your work;

- have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and oral communication skills in Finnish and English; and

- are proficient in MS Office programs (especially Word) and able to quickly learn new software and systems.


**White & Case offers you:**

- an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment within a highly regarded international law firm;

- a diverse, key support role where you will also have the opportunity to assist lawyers with client assignments;

- a close-knit work community that invests in the development of each team member; and

- comprehensive benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare, optional health and accident insurance, and internal training opportunities to support your development. In addition, White & Case offers a selection of alternative benefits, which can be used, for example, for dental care, eyeglasses, a public transport pass, cultural activities or sports.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter **in English** by **Monday 12 October 2026**. We encourage you to apply early, as we will start reviewing applications already during the application period. If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjons recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

White & Case's lawyers and business services professionals are globally minded, enterprising, collaborative and committed to excellence. White & Case operates on a one firm basis, which is present in the day-to-day work of its professionals. They advise multinational corporates, financial institutions and private equity firms on corporate and financing transactions across all major industry sectors. White & Case's core practice areas in Finland are Capital Markets, Debt Finance and M&A/Private Equity._

jobs.title: Vastaava toimintaterapeutti
jobs.description:
**Vastaava toimintaterapeutti – tule rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää arkea ja vaikuttavaa toimintaterapiaa**

Etsimme joukkoomme **vastaavaa toimintaterapeuttia**, joka haluaa yhdistää vahvan toimintaterapiaosaamisen, asiakastyön ja toiminnan kehittämisen. Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan sekä asiakkaidemme kuntoutukseen että koko toimintamme sujuvuuteen ja kehittymiseen. Sinulla tulee olla vähintään toimintaterapeutti (AMK) koulutus sekä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston (Entinen Valvira) laillistus terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilönä. Arvostamme esimerkiksi toimintaterapian YAMK- opintoja tai kiinnostusta joko niiden tai muiden johtamis- ja esihenkilötyötä tukevien opintojen suorittamiseen lähitulevaisuudessa.

Vastaavana toimintaterapeuttina työsi muodostuu monipuolisesti asiakastyöstä (noin 70-80 %), toiminnan koordinoinnista ja hallinnollisista tehtävistä. Tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään omaa ammatillista osaamistasi, mutta samalla ottamaan vastuuta suuremmista kokonaisuuksista.

**Mitä tehtävä pitää sisällään?**

Tehtävässä vastaat yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa toimintamme laadukkaasta ja sujuvasta toteutumisesta. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakastyötä ja toimintaterapeuttista arviointia sekä kuntoutuksen suunnittelua

- asiakaspaikkojen ja asiakasohjauksen koordinointia

- työntekijöiden työn, tavoitteiden ja toiminnan toteutumisen seurantaa

- työntekijöiden tukemista, ohjaamista ja perehdyttämistä

- toiminnan suunnittelua ja kehittämistä

- hallinnollisia tehtäviä ja talousasioiden seurantaa

- yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, läheisten, työntekijöiden ja yhteistyötahojen kanssa.


Toivomme sinulta kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia ja viedä asioita käytännössä eteenpäin. Tehtävässä tarvitaan hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja, oma-aloitteisuutta, päätöksentekokykyä sekä kiinnostusta toiminnan kehittämiseen. Arvostamme erityisesti rakentavaa ja kannustavaa työotetta sekä kykyä kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja ammatillisesti.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää myös valmiutta ottaa vastuuta taloudellisista ja hallinnollisista kokonaisuuksista. Aiempi kokemus esimerkiksi esihenkilötyöstä, hallinnollisista tehtävistä, talouden seurannasta, asiakasohjauksesta tai työntekijöiden tavoitteellisesta ohjaamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Tulet työskentelemään pienessä lämminhenkisessä ja kodinomaisessa perheyrityksessä, jossa välillä pääset pukemaan saappaat jalkaan ja hyppäämään mukaan mitä moninaisempiin toimintoihin.

Olemme sitoutuneet Terveyttä luonnosta – työnantajasitoumuksen kautta tuomaan luonnon osaksi työelämää. Lue lisää Työterveyslaitoksen Terveyttä luonnosta sitoumuksesta täältä.

**Sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä työstä omannäköistäsi**

Meille toimintaterapia on ennen kaikkea asiakkaan arjen, osallisuuden ja toimintakyvyn tukemista. Haluamme tarjota työntekijöillemme mahdollisuuden toteuttaa terapiaa luovasti ja asiakkaan yksilölliset tarpeet huomioiden.

Meillä on mahdollista hyödyntää **eläinavusteista ja luontolähtöistä työotetta**, ja Green Care -ajattelu on tärkeä osa toimintaamme. Toivomme, että sinulla on suoritettuna **Green Care -perusteet 5 op** -verkkokurssi. Mikäli koulutus ei ole vielä suoritettuna, sitoudut suorittamaan sen ensimmäisen työskentelyvuoden aikana. Tuemme mielellämme myös muun ammatillisen osaamisen ja täydennyskoulutuksen kehittämistä.

Tehtävä edellyttää **rikostaustaotteen esittämistä alle 18-vuotiaiden kanssa työskentelyä varten** sekä voimassa olevia ensiaputaitoja. Toivomme, että sinulla on vähintään **EA1-koulutus** suoritettuna.

Lue lisää https://voimatassu.fi/voimatassu-2/toihin-voimatassulle/

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos koet, että tässä voisi olla sinulle sopiva seuraava askel, kuulisimme mielellämme sinusta!

Voit jättää kirjallisen hakemuksen sähköpostitse osoitteeseen **voimatassu@voimatassu.fi** tai alla olevan hakemuslomakkeen kautta mieluiten **30.10.2026 mennessä**.

Laita sähköpostin otsikoksi **Työhakemus vastaava toimintaterapeutti**.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit kysyä alla olevan lomakkeen kautta tai soittamalla tai WhatsApp-viestillä numeroon **040 358 9827**. Lisätietoja antaa **Eeva Kahilaniemi** asiakastyön lomassa.

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme toimintaterapiaa, jossa ihmiset, luonto ja eläimet voivat olla osa hyvää ja merkityksellist**ä arkea!

jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

jobs.title: Murersvend søges til Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS i Bagsværd – frihed, firmabil og ordnede forhold
jobs.description:
Murersvend søges til Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS i Bagsværd.

Vil du have frihed under ansvar, firmabil og fleksible arbejdstider? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Om stillingen

Hos Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS søger vi en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst murersvend til alsidigt og varieret murerarbejde.

Du får stor frihed i hverdagen, arbejder selvstændigt og får mulighed for selv at planlægge og tilrettelægge dine opgaver. Afhængigt af opgaven arbejder du enten alene, sammen med en kollega eller som en del af et større hold.

Du bliver en del af en stabil virksomhed med ca. 20 engagerede kollegaer, hvor vi lægger vægt på ordnede forhold, godt samarbejde og frihed under ansvar.

Vi tilbyder

  • Firmabil, som kan tages med hjem (jf. gældende regler)

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at planlægge din arbejdsdag

  • Fleksible arbejdstider

  • God lønpakke efter kvalifikationer

  • Fast fuldtidsansættelse

  • Ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • Stabilt arbejde og en god ordrebeholdning

  • Alsidige opgaver – både mindre serviceopgaver og større byggesager

  • Gode kollegaer og korte beslutningsveje

  • En fast og tryg arbejdsplads i en solid virksomhed

Dine opgaver kan bl.a. være

  • Renovering og reparation af eksisterende bygninger

  • Opmuring i mursten, Leca og porebeton

  • Reparation og pudsning af vægge, lofter og facader

  • Facaderenovering, netpuds og forskellige pudssystemer

  • Efterisolering og facadeisolering

  • Reparation af murværk og fuger

  • Tagarbejde, herunder tegl, rygninger og grater

  • Flisearbejde, badeværelser, gulve og vægge

  • Mindre ombygninger og renoveringsopgaver

  • Spjæld- og servicearbejde hos private, erhverv og offentlige kunder

  • Større byggesager, hvor du arbejder sammen med vores øvrige håndværkere

Det er ikke et krav, at du kan eller ønsker at udføre alle typer murerarbejde. Hvis du eksempelvis ikke arbejder med fliser, tagarbejde eller spjæld/service, er det ikke nødvendigvis et problem. Vi har forskellige typer opgaver og forsøger at bruge vores medarbejdere dér, hvor deres erfaring og kompetencer passer bedst.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet murer og har erfaring fra faget

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Kan planlægge og gennemføre dine egne opgaver

  • Sætter en ære i godt håndværk og kvalitet

  • Har en god omgangstone over for kunder og kollegaer

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har kørekort B

  • Har lyst til en arbejdsplads med stor frihed og ansvar

Om os

Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS er en solid entreprenørvirksomhed med base i Bagsværd og ca. 20 medarbejdere.

Vi udfører bygge- og renoveringsopgaver for private, erhverv, boligforeninger og offentlige bygherrer. Vi arbejder med både murer- og tømrerarbejde samt fag- og hovedentrepriser.

Hos os lægger vi vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og frihed under ansvar. Vi ønsker, at vores medarbejdere har plads til selv at tilrettelægge deres arbejde og tage ansvar for deres egne opgaver.

Ansøgning

Stillingen er fast og på fuld tid, og vi ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til:

Gladsaxe Bygningsentreprise ApS
Att.: Johnni Regnarsson
E-mail: johnni@gladsaxebyg.dk

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du også velkommen til at ringe på 50 90 18 74.

jobs.title: Directeur d'hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
La bonne compétence, au bon endroit, au bon moment.

Chez Potentiel Humain, ce n'est pas qu'un slogan, c'est une façon de travailler.

Cabinet de conseil en compétences, nous accompagnons les entreprises de Montpellier, Nîmes, Béziers et Perpignan dans leurs enjeux humains et stratégiques.

Nos expertises :

- Recrutement CDI / CDD / Intérim
- Management de transition / Temps partagé / Freelancing
- Formation sur mesure

Nous recrutons pour notre client, un hôtel situé au cœur du village naturiste du Cap d'Agde, un Directeur d'Hôtel H/F.

Caractéristiques :

- Type de contrat : CDD saisonnier
- Durée : de mars à fin octobre 2027
- Lieu de mission : Cap d'Agde
- Démarrage : mars 2027
- Base horaire : 6 jours sur 7, de 9h à 19h lorsque l'hôtel est ouvert ; 5 jours sur 7 lorsque l'hôtel est fermé
- Rémunération proposée : 3 846 € brut mensuel
- Statut : Cadre

Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous aurez la responsabilité du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement et de la qualité de l'expérience proposée aux clients.

Vous aurez pour principales missions :

- Piloter l'ouverture et la fermeture saisonnières de l'hôtel : préparation des chambres, anticipation des besoins, gestion des stocks et coordination des opérations nécessaires au démarrage et à la fin de saison.
- Superviser l'exploitation quotidienne : contrôle de la qualité et de la propreté des chambres, suivi du linge, des consommables, du bar, du snacking et des produits d'entretien.
- Assurer le suivi administratif et financier courant : contrôle des facturations, clôtures journalières dans le logiciel hôtelier, vérification de la caisse et des tickets, traitement des remboursements si nécessaire et suivi des fournisseurs.
- Organiser l'activité et manager les équipes : optimisation du planning et de l'occupation des chambres, recrutement et suivi de l'équipe de ménage, coordination des différents intervenants et renfort opérationnel lors des pics d'activité.
- Garantir une expérience client de qualité : superviser l'accueil et le service, être attentif aux attentes de la clientèle et personnaliser la relation avec les clients fidèles.
- Coordonner les prestataires et préparer les saisons suivantes : suivi des interventions et travaux, gestion des services complémentaires en haute saison, suivi des réservations, des mails et du courrier hors période d'ouverture.

Polyvalent(e) et présent(e) sur le terrain, vous pourrez également renforcer ponctuellement les équipes, notamment à la réception, au bar ou sur l'activité snacking, lorsque l'activité le nécessite.

Comment notre client vous imagine ?

Vous justifiez d'une expérience de 5 à 10 ans minimum sur un poste similaire dans l'hôtellerie et maîtrisez les différents enjeux liés au fonctionnement quotidien d'un établissement.

Votre anglais vous permet d'échanger avec aisance avec une clientèle internationale, aussi bien à l'oral que dans les échanges professionnels courants.

Manager de terrain, vous savez organiser l'activité, encadrer une équipe et prendre des décisions tout en restant disponible pour intervenir opérationnellement lorsque la situation le demande.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre sens du service, votre organisation, votre fiabilité et votre réactivité. À l'aise dans la relation client, vous savez vous adapter à une clientèle exigeante et instaurer une relation professionnelle et personnalisée.

Votre polyvalence constitue un véritable atout : gestion administrative, suivi des prestataires, organisation des équipes, contrôle des chambres ou soutien aux différents services font partie d'un quotidien que vous appréciez.

Enfin, vous disposez d'un réel sens commercial et savez identifier les attentes des clients afin de leur proposer un service adapté.

jobs.title: Ingénieur de production DEVOPS (H/F)
jobs.employer: UCC EXPERTS UNIFIED COMMUNICATION AND CO
jobs.description:
Ingénieur DevOps Cloud / Kubernetes (H/F)
1. Contexte du Poste & Enjeux à Toulouse
Expérience requise : 9 ans minimum (profil Senior / Expert).
Localisation : Toulouse et agglomération (Blagnac, Labège, etc.).

Contexte local :
Missions Principales
Architecture & Design de Plateformes Cloud : Concevoir, bâtir et faire évoluer les architectures Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP ou Cloud Souverain) et on-premise hautement disponibles, scalables et sécurisées.
Stratégie Kubernetes & Containerisation : Définir la stratégie de conteneurisation globale de l'entreprise, industrialiser le déploiement des clusters Kubernetes à grande échelle et garantir leur résilience.
Industrialisation & Automatisation (CI/CD) : Concevoir les pipelines d'intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) les plus optimisés possibles pour automatiser le cycle de vie applicatif du code à la production.
FinOps & Performance : Optimiser les coûts d'infrastructure Cloud (démarche FinOps) et veiller aux performances globales des environnements.

Leadership Technique & Culture DevOps : Porter la culture DevOps/DevSecOps au sein des équipes, évangéliser les bonnes pratiques, rédiger les standards d'architecture et mentorer les ingénieurs juniors/seniors.

3. Compétences Techniques Détaillées (Hard Skills)
A. Containerisation & Écosystème Kubernetes (Expertise Majeure)
Orchestration : Maîtrise approfondie de Kubernetes (architecture des control planes, etcd, kube-proxy, CNI, CSI). Expérience sur les managed clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE) et on-premise (Rancher, OpenShift, k3s).

Networking & Service Mesh : Configuration des CNI (Calico, Cilium, Flannel), gestion des Ingress Controllers (NGINX, Traefik) et mise en place de Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) pour la gestion du trafic inter-services.

Stockage & Stateful : Gestion des volumes persistant (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook/Ceph, NFS).

Package Management : Maîtrise de Helm pour le templating et le packaging d'applications.

B. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Providers
Cloud Publics : Maîtrise avancée d'au moins un grand Cloud provider (AWS ou Azure / GCP), ou des environnements OpenStack / VMware pour les contextes on-premise/privés.

IaC & Provisioning : Maîtrise absolue de Terraform / OpenTofu (gestion d'état, modules, remote state) et Ansible pour la configuration.

Immutable Infrastructure : Utilisation d'outils comme Packer pour la génération d'images de VM/conteneurs.

C. CI/CD & Automatisation du Software Delivery
Pipelines CI/CD : Conception de chaînes d'intégration complexes avec GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Argo CD ou Jenkins.

GitOps : Implémentation de paradigmes GitOps avec ArgoCD ou FluxCD pour synchroniser l'état des clusters Kubernetes avec les repositories Git.

D. Observabilité, Monitoring & SRE
Supervision & Métriques : Déploiement et administration de Prometheus, Thanos, Cortex, et design de dashboards sur Grafana.

Centralisation des Logs & Tracing : Maîtrise des stacks d'observabilité (ELK / EFK, Grafana Loki, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry).

Fiabilité (SRE) : Définition des SLO, SLA et SLI, gestion des alertes et automatisation de la remédiation (incident response).

E. Sécurité (DevSecOps) & Compliance
Software Supply Chain Security : Analyse de vulnérabilités des images (Trivy, Clair), signature d'images (Cosign), SBOM (Software Bill of Materials).

jobs.description:
Seksjon for fysioterapi har flere vikariater ledig! 
Flere av våre dyktige ansatte har frikjøpt tid til forskning og utvikling, i tillegg har vi fire som skal ha foreldrepermisjon. Vi har derfor flere vikariater ledig med ulik stillingsprosent. 

  • Vikariat 1: 100% 06.10.26-22.08.27 (kombinert vikariat og sommervikariat)
  • Vikariat 2: 100% 06.01-10.9.27
  • Vikariat 3: 100%: 06.01-27.09.27
  • Vikariat 4: 100% 06.01-01.10
  • Vikariat 5: 100% 06.01-22.08 (kombinert vikariat og sommervikariat)
  • Vikariat 6: 40-100% 06.01-30.6 

I vår fysioterapiseksjon er vi i overkant av 20 svært kompetente og driftige fysioterapeuter.
Seksjonens fysioterapeuter jobber til daglig i hovedsak med inneliggende pasienter. Vi behandler en rekke ulike pasientkategorier på intensivavdelingene, sengeposter og i treningssal. Hovedvekten av våre pasienter er:

  • Hjerte: hjerte-/karkirurgi, hjertetransplantasjon og kardiologiske pasienter
  • Lunge: lungetransplantasjon og lungeoperasjoner
  • ØNH: voksne pasienter operert for cancer
  • Gastro/transplantasjon: gastrokirurgi, gastromedisin, nyretransplanterte, levertransplanterte
  • Pasienter på sengepost for Blodsykdommer og Infeksjon

Hverdagen vår er varierende, størstedelen av våre behandlinger er på sengepost, men vi har også noe poliklinisk drift i intensiv- og bløderpoliklinikk. Vi er svært opptatt av faglig utvikling og setter fokus på evidensbasert tilgang gjennom kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid. Vi er stolte av å ha et åpent og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, som gjør at vi arbeider godt sammen, både internt og ut mot sengepostene.

Vi søker deg som ønsker å jobbe med våre pasientgrupper, og som har erfaring fra spesialisthelsetjenesten. Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring med intensivfysioterapi og er godt kjent med lungefysioterapi til ulike pasientgrupper.

 

Det er mulighet for forlengelse i enkelte vikariater. Ved intern ansettelse kan vikariater at ulik varighet og stillingsprosent bli ledig.

Intervjuer gjennomføres fortløpende.


Oslo universitetssykehus er en arbeidsplass med stort mangfold. Vi mener dette er avgjørende for å løse våre oppgaver på best mulig måte. Vi ønsker at dette mangfoldet skal gjenspeiles blant søkerne til våre stillinger, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater, uavhengig bakgrunn, til å søke!
Arbeidsoppgaver

Hvordan ser en arbeidshverdag ut? 

  • Pasientbehandling på sengeposter, intensivposter og i treningssal
  • Fortløpende elektronisk dokumentering.
  • Deltakelse i utviklingsprosjekter av større eller mindre grad.
  • Mulighet for turnusarbeid med helg/kveldsarbeid hver 5. helg.
Kvalifikasjoner

For å trives med arbeidsoppgaver hos oss, ser vi etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner:

  • Autorisert fysioterapeut
  • Relevant sykehuserfaring etter autorisasjon

Vi ber om at relevant dokumentasjon legges ved søknaden.

  • har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

Du har betydning for pasientsikkerhet, trivsel på arbeidsplassen og utvikling av en trygg, åpen og inkluderende kultur.
 
Vi er opptatt av at du skal trives og utvikle deg, les under hva vi kan tilby deg:

  • Du blir en del av en faglig sterk arbeidsplass og stolte fagpersoner. 
  • Du blir en del av et viktig samfunnsoppdrag, hvor du er tett på pasienter og pårørende.

  • Du blir gitt gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. Du får god opplæring og det vil være mulighet for interne kurs og årlige seminarer, samt faglig påfyll underveis.
  • Vi tar vare på våre nye medarbeidere og støtter deg gjennom oppstartsfasen med vårt sentrale nyansattprogram, les mer: https://www.oslo-universitetssykehus.no/om-oss/jobb-og-utdanning/arbeidsplassen-var/velkommen-med-pa-laget/
