About the LCSB
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB) is an interdisciplinary research centre of the University of Luxembourg.
We conduct fundamental and translational research in the field of Systems Biology and Biomedicine – in the lab, in the clinic and in silico. We focus on neurodegenerative processes and are especially interested in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and their contributing factors. The LCSB recruits talented scientists from various disciplines: computer scientists, mathematicians, biologists, chemists, engineers, physicists and clinicians from more than 50 countries currently work at the LCSB. We excel because we are truly interdisciplinary, and together we contribute to science and society.

Your role
We seek a highly motivated software developer to join a FNR JUMP-funded project translating a validated suite of bioinformatics software tools into CausalOmics, an integrated software platform for causal analysis of omics data. The platform identifies root causal genes and candidate drug targets from multi-omics datasets.
The candidate will contribute to the further development of the unified, point-and-click user interface, implement interactive visualization frameworks for complex biological networks, and develop the core platform architecture that connects the analysis modules, spanning preprocessing, network and pathway analysis, causal reasoning, drug target assessment, and machine learning, through robust APIs.
Further responsibilities include setting up the cloud deployment infrastructure (SaaS architecture, REST API) and ensuring the platform is scalable, reproducible, and accessible to users without coding or bioinformatics expertise. The role is closely linked to the CausalOmics go-to-market project, and the candidate will work directly with the project's principal investigator and its interdisciplinary bioinformatics and business development team.
This position is offered with the explicit intent that the successful candidate may take on the role of Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Lead Developer of the planned CausalOmics spin-off company after incorporation.

Your profile
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field: MSc or equivalent; PhD an advantage
• Proven experience in full-stack web development, including front-end frameworks and back-end/API design
• Experience with interactive data visualization and building user-friendly, no-code interfaces for complex analytical workflows
• Familiarity with cloud deployment (SaaS architectures, REST APIs, CI/CD) is highly advantageous
• An interest in, or prior exposure to, bioinformatics or biomedical data is a plus but not required
• Strong software architecture and code quality skills, including experience with scalable, modular system design
• Cross-disciplinary aptitude, strong organizational and interpersonal skills, and interest in a translational, commercially oriented research environment
• Excellent command in English

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter, including a brief description of past software development experience and future interests, as well as the earliest possible starting date
• Copies of degree certificates and transcripts
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/ICA ENGLESKOG JEZIKA
jobs.description: Objava natječaja na HZZZ-u od 28.09.- 06.10.2026. Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10. - ispr., 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18 i 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23), članka 13. Pravilnika o radu i članaka 6. i 7. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja Osnovne škole Remete (u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik), ravnatelj Osnovne škole Remete objavljuje: N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa 1. Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika, na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme (6 sati tjedno), 1 izvršitelj/ica Uvjeti: Kandidati uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br.: 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) i čl.17. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine br. 6/19, 75/20). Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08 i 69/17) U prijavi na natječaj navode se i podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, adresa e-pošte, isključivo za potrebe postupka), naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i datum objave natječaja. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi 4. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 5. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika“.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/ICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE U PRODUŽENOM BORAVKU
jobs.description: Objava natječaja na HZZZ-u od 28.09.- 06.10.2026. Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10. - ispr., 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18 i 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23), članka 13. Pravilnika o radu i članaka 6. i 7. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja Osnovne škole Remete (u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik), ravnatelj Osnovne škole Remete objavljuje: N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa 1. Učitelj/ica razredne nastave u produženom boravku, na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme, 3 izvršitelja/ice Uvjeti: Kandidati uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br.: 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) i čl.17. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine br. 6/19, 75/20). Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08 i 69/17) U prijavi na natječaj navode se i podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, adresa e-pošte, isključivo za potrebe postupka), naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i datum objave natječaja. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi 4. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 5. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Učitelj/ica razredne nastave u produženom boravku“.

jobs.title: TERENSKI SERVISER/KA
jobs.description:
Terenski serviser (m/ž)

Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti:

  • izvođenje servisnih radova u tvrtki i na terenu, na uređajima tvrtke RASCO i na ostalim uređajima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa i distribuira
  • remont strojeva preuzetih od kupaca
  • izvođenje osnovne obuke za upravljanje Rasco strojevima i uređajima, i onima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa
  • prijava nesukladnosti prikupljenih sa terena
  • unos podataka i korekcija u baze podataka kojima raspolaže servis
  • vođenje točnih zapisa vezanih za servisne radne naloge
  • kontrola tehničke ispravnosti i održavanje osobnih, dostavnih i teretnih vozila tvrtke

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • SSS tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, autoelektričar, elektromonter itd.)
  • Poželjno 1 - 3 godina radnog iskustvu u sličnim poslovima, ali razmotriti ćemo i kandidate bez radnog iskustva, a koji su spremni proći intenzivnu obuku namijenjenu serviserima početnicima
  • Engleski ili njemački jezik (osnovna razina)
  • Korištenje računalom i MS Office aplikacijama (osnovno)
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorija
  • Sklonost terenskom radu
  • Odgovoran pristup radnim zadacima
  • Sklonost timskom radu i fleksibilnost u poslu

Što nudimo:

  • Početnu plaću sukladno prethodnom iskustvu uz jasno definiranu mogućnost povećanja primanja nakon savladavanja zahtjeva radnog mjesta
  • Naknade troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla, dodatak za topli obrok i radne rezultate kao i isplata pripadajućih dnevnica i terenskog dodatka i prekovremenog rada na terenu
  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad od 3 mjeseca
  • Mentora i sustavno praćenje napretka s ciljem osiguravanja podrške i uspješno uvođenje u posao
  • Dodatne edukacije vezane uz specifičnosti radnog mjesta i edukacije namijenjene osobnom razvoju
  • Radno okružje s visokom razinom odgovornosti te rad sa iskusnim stručnjacima u navedenom području

Mjesto rada: Kalinovac, Koprivničko-križevačka županija Molimo pošaljite nam svoju prijavu i životopis najkasnije do 31.10.2026. godine.

jobs.title: STROJAR U SLUŽBI PROČIŠĆAVANJA OTPADNIH VODA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS strojarskog smjera

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 1 smjena - prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.335,14 € do 1.535,40 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • kontroliranje, popravljanje, ugradnja i održavanje strojarske opreme, uređaja i crpki u
  • procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda i crpnim stanicama,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i
  • zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja
  • otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme, remont opreme, servisi opreme,
  • zamjena ulja, podmazivanje zapornica i opreme koja se koristi u pročišćavanju otpadnih
  • voda ,
  • održavanje strojarske opreme i crpki (kontrola nastanka korozije, zaštita adekvatnim
  • premazima),
  • rukovanje i upravljanje strojo opremom, podmazivanje i kontrola nivoa ulja,
  • praćenje intervala za redovite servise opreme,
  • briga oko pravovremene nabavke rezervnih dijelova,
  • održavanje opreme u službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda (pranje, čišćenje),
  • rukovanje s opasnim kemikalijama,
  • nadopuna kemikalija u odgovarajuće spremnike prema radnim postupcima,,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti slijedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme (preslik svjedodžbe/diplome);
  3. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije
  4. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e radna knjižica);

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Operater u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS

Opis posla:

  • održavanje opreme, uređaja, građevina i okoliša u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

otpadnih voda,

  • dehidriranje otpadnog mulja,
  • nadopuna spremnika za kemikalije prema radnim postupcima,
  • skidanje korozije po opremi i zaštita odgovarajućim sredstvima,

  • održavanje alata,
  • održavanje travnjaka,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i

zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja

otpadnih voda,

  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme (pranje grubih i finih rešetki, zgrtača,

mjerne opreme, bazena, izlaznih brana, skidanje korozije, zaštita opreme odgovarajućim

zaštitnim sredstvima..),

  • kontrola ispunjenosti kontejnera za otpad i po potrebi zamjena beskonačnih vreća za

otpad,

  • pomoć oko čišćenja kod pražnjenja mastolova, zamjena hvatača masti i ulja…,
  • čišćenje građevina postrojenja i prihvata septika,

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Database Excellence
AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead


    • Experience and qualifications

    Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

  • Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

  • Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

  • Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Service engineer for our client.

Your Role and Responsibilities:
As a Service Engineer, based in the Helsinki or Turku area, you will be responsible for commissioning, maintaining and servicing electric propulsion systems for marine applications. You will execute service work according to work instructions and in accordance with standard processes, quality requirements and safety guidelines.

You will work closely with customers and internal engineering and service teams, acting as the technical point of contact while ensuring high-quality service and customer satisfaction.

The position involves approximately 150 days of mostly international travel per year, as you will provide practical technical support at customer sites around the world. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work with advanced marine technology, develop your technical expertise and gain international experience in a highly customer-oriented industry.

You will be mainly accountable for:
 Commissioning and maintaining electric propulsion systems
 Supervising installations, startup, testing and commissioning in cooperation with customers
 Performing service and warranty work on operating vessels
 Installing and commissioning equipment and identifying and analysing technical problems through remote and on-site activities
 Performing various service tasks, including installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions and equipment replacements
 Consulting and advising customers on suitable service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures and safety guidelines
 Building and maintaining strong customer relationships and providing specialist technical assistance
 Diagnosing equipment failures and recommending corrective actions to prevent recurring problems
 Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and working methods

Qualifications for the Role:
 B.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, automation, marine engineering or another relevant field
 Ability and willingness to perform mechanical service work when required
 Previous practical experience in commissioning relevant products or systems is an advantage
 Willingness and ability to travel internationally extensively, up to approximately 150 days per year
 Experience in shipbuilding, marine systems or industrial equipment is an advantage
 Experience with electrical propulsion systems is considered an advantage
 Collaborative and solution-oriented approach
 Good Finnish and English language skills, as the role involves regular interaction with customers and internal teams
 Additional language skills are an advantage
 Good knowledge of MS Office
 Ability to work independently as well as effectively as part of a team
 Strong customer service and communication skills

More about the company:
Our client operates in the marine technology sector and develops advanced electric, automated and digital solutions for vessels and maritime operations. The company is committed to supporting the transition towards more sustainable and energy-efficient marine transportation.

You will join an international and dynamic working environment where advanced technology is delivered through large-scale projects around the world. The role offers the opportunity to work in a highly globalized, customer-oriented industry and develop your expertise through challenging international assignments.

The company values collaboration, continuous learning, customer focus and innovation, and offers a range of professional development and employee wellbeing benefits.

About Uplane

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. Our software supports creative producers with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, and much more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native content producers and need ambitious, creative ad designers with strong taste who will use our AI engine to deliver high-performing static ads for our customers.

We're seeking a highly motivated, English-speaking AI-native Static Ad Designer with experience in designing static ads for performance marketing campaigns to join our team full-time (in San Francisco or Berlin on-site, hybrid or remote). In this role, you will work with our self-developed AI static ad engine to create and deliver static ads for the paid social campaigns of our clients. Your creatives will reach millions of people across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok.

Why Join

  • Uplane is the best place to learn how to design ads with AI. This is the skill every creative lead will need. Learn how to do it today, not in three years.

  • AI does the grunt work, you do the creative work. Our engine handles the tedious stuff so your time goes into concept, taste and design.

  • Millions of people will see your ads.

  • Take ownership and grow quickly.

  • Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company.

  • Culture: fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble.

Responsibilities

  • AI Static Ad Design: You use our powerful, self-developed AI static ad engine to create and design beautiful static ads that will be seen by millions of people. You are in charge, the AI helps you fulfill your mission.

  • Creative Testing: You develop new angles, hooks and visual concepts, test them in live campaigns and double down on what performs.

  • Team Collaboration: Work with an ambitious team of marketing managers and creative designers to ensure projects are executed to a high standard and in a timely manner.

  • Shape the AI engine: Give feedback to our product and engineering team and shape how our static ad engine will evolve and improve over time.

Requirements

  • Passion for designing ads, you love design and creative work

  • Years of experience in designing static ads

  • Work experience in paid social or with performance marketing campaigns

  • Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant

  • Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it

  • Fluent English

Nice to Have

  • You have won awards for your creative work

About the role

In this role, you will get the opportunity to develop mechanical components and assemblies while adapting existing designs to specific customer orders. The work perfectly combines practical design tasks with cross-functional collaboration across engineering, production, and supplier teams. You will be supported by experienced colleagues, making this a fantastic environment to grow your expertise in mechanical engineering and manufacturing documentation.

In this role, you will be employed in a 12-month fixed-term contract with our client company, working as an embedded consultant for an in-house product company.

What our client can offer to you:
- Salary: 2500–3500 €/month, depending on your background and current skill level.
- A strong start to your career: You will get hands-on experience in a real product company environment, learning the complete lifecycle from CAD design to manufacturing.
- A collaborative environment: You will work closely with different departments, ensuring you gain a broad understanding of industrial engineering.

Work tasks

Your daily tasks will revolve around 3D modeling and creating precise manufacturing documentation for customized orders. You will ensure that technical specifications are met and that production has the correct information to build the components.
- Producing and updating 3D models for mechanical parts and subsystems.
- Preparing accurate, detailed manufacturing drawings.
- Adapting established product designs to order-specific requirements.
- Keeping design records and related information up to date in PDM and ERP systems.
- Collaborating with sales, R&D, manufacturing, and suppliers.

The work contract is with our client company, a consultancy company and you

jobs.title: Prentari / Printer
jobs.description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

4. What we offer

  • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

  • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

  • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

  • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale.

Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks

  • Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure

  • Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features

  • Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines

  • Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs

  • Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment

  • Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load

  • Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet

  • Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)

  • Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms

  • Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team

  • Take ownership and can work independently when needed

  • Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have)

What you can look forward to:

  • Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

  • Collaborative and supportive work environment

  • Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

  • Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.

 

What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

  • Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

  • Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

  • ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

  • Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale.

 

What you'll bring

We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience.

You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include:

  • strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements)

  • startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them)

  • FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms)

 

What we value

We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building infrastructure that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable.

Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe.

 
 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.title: Personal Trainer
jobs.description:
**Etsimme kahta(2) Personal Traineria – Ole.Fit Turenki**

**Onko liikunta sinulle elämäntapa?**

Pidät ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja haluat valmentaa ympäristössä, jossa hyvinvointi syntyy yhdessä tekemisestä? Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta alusta asti?

Ole.Fit Turenki etsii Personal Traineria osaksi uudistuvaa kuntokeskusta ja kasvavaa valmennustiimiä.

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan uutta Ole.Fit Turenkia**

Uudistuneen keskuksen avajaisia vietettiin alkusyksystä, joten nyt sinulla on ainutlaatuinen mahdollisuus hypätä mukaan rakentamaan uudenlaista valmennuskulttuuria heti alusta lähtien.

Ole.Fit Turenki ei ole pelkkä kuntosali – vaan **kylän olohuoneen**, jossa asiakkaat viihtyvät, liikkuvat yhdessä ja kokevat kuuluvansa yhteisöön.

**Mikä tekee Ole.Fit Turengista erityisen?**

Keskuksessa on noin **500 m² monipuolinen kuntosali**, joka soveltuu niin tavoitteelliseen voimaharjoitteluun, toiminnalliseen harjoitteluun kuin kuntouttavaankin liikuntaan. Lisäksi keskuksessa järjestetään monipuolista ryhmäliikuntaa, mikä luo aktiivisen ja innostavan ympäristön myös Personal Trainerin asiakashankintaan.

Saat ympärillesi kokeneen henkilöstön, joka tukee sinua arjessa, jakaa osaamistaan ja auttaa onnistumaan. Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa yhdessä tekeminen, avoimuus ja asiakkaiden hyvinvointi ovat kaiken toiminnan keskiössä.

Valmennustoiminta on meillä organisoitua. Käytössäsi on toimiva PT-toimintamalli, joka tukee valmentajan arkea, myyntiä ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamista – kuitenkaan rajoittamatta omaa asiakaslähtöistä valmennustyyliäsi.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa täysin uudistuvaa Ole.Fit-keskusta.

- Noin 500 m² monipuolisen ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän treeniympäristön.

- Ryhmäliikunnan tuoman aktiivisen asiakasvirran.

- Kokeneen ja helposti lähestyttävän henkilöstön tuen.

- Yhteisöllisen työympäristön, jossa valmentajaa arvostetaan.

- Selkeän ja toimivan PT-toimintamallin, joka tukee asiakashankintaa, myyntiä ja arjen tekemistä.

- Ole.Fit-ketjun toimintamallit, markkinoinnin ja valtakunnallisen tuen.

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikainen ja kannattava valmennusliiketoiminta.


**Kenelle paikka sopii?**

Etsimme kahta Personal Traineria, joka haluavat sitoutua keskuksen kehittämiseen ja rakentaa omaa asiakaskuntaansa osana kasvavaa Ole.Fit Turenkia.

Toivomme, että:

- olet koulutettu Personal Trainer tai liikunta-alan ammattilainen (tai koulutuksesi on loppusuoralla, ei pelkästään verkko-opintoina suoritettu)

- haluat työskennellä 3–5 päivänä viikossa ja olet valmis työskentelemään myös asiakkaiden suosituimpina aikoina klo 16–20

- toimit itseohjautuvasti ja kannat vastuuta omasta työstäsi

- olet yrittäjähenkinen ja ymmärrät valmennuksen liiketoimintana

- haluat kehittää keskusta yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa

- olet helposti lähestyttävä ja kohtaat asiakkaat aidosti

- osaat rakentaa yksilöllisiä ja tuloksellisia valmennuskokonaisuuksia

- toimit kevytyrittäjänä, toiminimellä tai muulla yritysmuodolla

- hallitset sujuvasti suomen kielen.


**Mitä työ mahdollistaa?**

Vakiintuneella asiakaskunnalla valmentajan laskutus on tyypillisesti noin **2 000–4 000 € / kk (alv 0 %)**.

Saat käyttöösi toimivat työkalut, modernisoituvan keskuksen, aktiivisen jäsenyhteisön sekä ympärillesi tiimin, jonka tavoitteena on auttaa niin asiakkaita kuin valmentajiakin onnistumaan.

**Tämä voi olla urasi seuraava askel**

Jos haluat olla mukana rakentamassa Turengin liikuntakulttuurin uutta kohtaamispaikkaa ja tehdä valmennustyötä, jolla on aidosti merkitystä, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

**Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si osoitteeseen:** laura.nurminen@ole.fit

Rakennetaan yhdessä Ole.Fit Turengista paikka, jossa jokainen tuntee olevansa tervetullut – kuntokeskus, joka on koko kylän olohuone.

As an Account Director, Client Solutions, you will own a portfolio of strategic client relationships from discovery through delivery, renewal, and expansion. The role combines consulting, account leadership, commercial ownership, and project direction without requiring you to be the hands-on technical builder. You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scoped, delivered, and aligned with business objectives. With clients across Europe and North America, you’ll operate in a diverse environment spanning multiple industries, technologies, and regulatory contexts. Do našeho týmu hledáme zkušeného kolegu/kolegyni na pozici Rozpočtář elektro, který se bude podílet na přípravě cenových nabídek a rozpočtů elektro zakázek. Zaměřujeme se především na slaboproudé systémy (EPS, EZS, CCTV, SKS, přístupové systémy, Wi-Fi, optické sítě a další technologie), přičemž znalost silnoproudých elektroinstalací je velkou výhodou.
Náplní práce je zpracování cenových nabídek a rozpočtů elektro zakázek, studium projektové dokumentace a technických výkresů, tvorba výkazů výměr, poptávání materiálu a subdodavatelů, komunikace se zákazníky, projektanty a dodavateli, technická podpora obchodního oddělení a spolupráce při přípravě realizace zakázek. Součástí práce je také hledání technicky i ekonomicky vhodných řešení pro jednotlivé projekty.
Požadujeme SŠ nebo VŠ vzdělání elektrotechnického směru, prokazatelné zkušenosti s tvorbou rozpočtů elektro zakázek, praxi v oblasti slaboproudých systémů (EPS, EZS, CCTV, SKS, přístupové systémy, Wi-Fi apod.), schopnost samostatně číst projektovou dokumentaci a zpracovat cenovou nabídku, orientaci v technických normách a používaných technologiích, samostatnost, pečlivost, zodpovědný přístup, dobré komunikační schopnosti a řidičský průkaz skupiny B.
Výhodou je znalost silnoproudých elektroinstalací, zkušenosti s oceňováním silnoproudých i slaboproudých zakázek, orientace v moderních elektroinstalačních technologiích, zkušenosti s výběrem materiálu a komunikací s dodavateli, znalost rozpočtových programů, platné oprávnění dle NV 194/2022 Sb. a zkušenosti s přípravou nebo řízením elektro projektů.
Pružná pracovní doba, možnost práce z domova, notebook a mobilní telefon, motivační finanční odměny, možnost profesního růstu a dalšího vzdělávání.
