jobs.title: Autonasentaja
jobs.description:
**Haemme kokenutta autonasentajaa Joensuuhun**

**Onko vianhaku ja diagnostiikka sinun vahvuutesi?** Etsimme korjaamollemme asentajaa, joka pystyy selvittämään autojen ongelmia itsenäisesti ja tekemään laadukasta korjaustyötä.

Olemme Joensuussa toimiva Bosch Car Service monimerkkikorjaamo. Huollamme ja korjaamme bensiini-, diesel-, hybridi- ja sähköautoja. Työhösi kuuluu henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä sekä vianhakua ja diagnostiikkaa. Saat eteesi myös tilanteita, joissa vikakoodi ei yksin kerro, mikä autossa on vialla. Osaat suunnitella tutkimisen, tehdä tarvittavat mittaukset ja edetä havaintojen perusteella kohti ratkaisua.

**Odotamme sinulta:**

- kokemusta eri automerkkien huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- kykyä tehdä vianhakua ja diagnostiikkaa itsenäisesti

- sähköisten järjestelmien ja diagnostiikkalaitteiden hyvää tuntemusta

- huolellista, järjestelmällistä ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa

- halua tehdä työsi hyvin ja palvella asiakkaita asiallisesti.


Bosch-laitteiden tuntemus on eduksi. Arvostamme alan koulutusta, mutta meille tärkeintä on käytännön osaamisesi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn**, nykyaikaisen korjaamoympäristön sekä osaavan työyhteisön tuen. Pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi tekniikan mukana ja osallistumaan esimerkiksi Boschin autotekniikan koulutuksiin.

Hyvästä osaamisesta maksetaan sen mukaisesti. Sovimme palkasta kokemuksesi ja taitojesi perusteella, ja olemme valmiita maksamaan hyvin asentajalle, joka hallitsee itsenäisen vianhaun ja diagnostiikan. Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavan työterveyshuollon, vapaa-ajan vakuutukset sekä kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedun. Järjestämme myös yhteisiä tapahtumia, ja korjaamoa voi käyttää iltaisin oman auton huoltoon ja korjaamiseen.

**Kiinnostuitko?** Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja CV osoitteeseen **huolto@auto-france.fi**. Kerro erityisesti, millaisista vianhaku- ja diagnostiikkatöistä sinulla on kokemusta. Kirjoita viestin otsikoksi **Ajoneuvoasentaja**. Käsittelemme hakemuksia niiden saapuessa.

Jos haluat kysyä tehtävästä lisää, Jarno Valkonen vastaa mielellään numerossa **040 558 8572**.

jobs.title: Chargé de qualité (H/F)
jobs.description:
PRODIMED est un acteur reconnu dans le domaine des dispositifs médicaux, engagé dans une démarche d'excellence qualité et d'amélioration continue afin de garantir la sécurité et la performance de ses produits. Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre équipe Qualité, nous recherchons un(e) Chargé(e) Qualité.

Missions principales :  
Préparer et vérifier les dossiers de lot de production en vue de la libération des produits par le RQARA,
S'assurer de la conformité des essais réalisés en vue de la libération (ex : tests MEA, biocharges, LAL, HSSA.)
Préparer les certificats d'analyse
Réaliser la libération informatique des produits
Alerter en cas de problème rencontré, être l'interlocuteur qualité avec la production et les prestataires
Réclamation et vigilances :  
Traiter les réclamations clients assure l'enregistrement et le pilotage, incluant la coordination de l'investigation terrain l'identification de la root cause, l'analyse des tendances et de la criticité, avec les différents acteurs concernés.  
Animer les RC board avec les différents acteurs, et réaliser un reporting auprès de la production pour les informer, et, au besoin, les sensibiliser.  
Amélioration continue :  
Être support et acteur dans la démarche d'amélioration continue  
Animer les plans d'actions liés à la qualité produit
Gestion des Non-Conformités en lien avec son activité : Identifier, documenter et gérer les non-conformités, enquêter sur leurs causes et mettre en place des actions correctives. L'analyse des causes et la gestion des actions correctives et préventives (CAPA). Coordonner et suivre les plans d'action préventive (autocontrôle, autoévaluation, retour d'expérience)
Evaluer les conséquences des modifications techniques sur ses activités.
Vérifier / réaliser les rapports d'analyses en cas d'évolution normative survenant dans le périmètre de ses activités.

jobs.title: Chef to join our international kitchen team
jobs.description:
CHEF WANTED FOR STAFF RESTAURANT IN COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

Looking for a chef position in Copenhagen with great working hours, professional cooking and weekends mostly free?

We are looking for a skilled and motivated chef to join our international kitchen team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Your main workplace will be The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine, located at Kalvebod Brygge in central Copenhagen.

This is a full-time position with working hours primarily Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 14:30 – giving you the opportunity to work in an ambitious professional kitchen while still having your afternoons, evenings and most weekends free.

Occasional evening and weekend events may occur.

THE JOB

You will become part of a professional kitchen team responsible for the daily production and service at our staff restaurant.

We cook from scratch and care about good ingredients, seasonality, flavour and proper craftsmanship.

You will work primarily with hot kitchen production and take responsibility for your own preparation and tasks while working closely with the rest of the team.

Our kitchen is busy, so we are looking for someone who works efficiently and in an organised manner without compromising quality.

Just as importantly, we are looking for a good colleague.

We believe a professional kitchen should be a place where people communicate respectfully, help each other and enjoy coming to work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You may already be living in Denmark, or you may be considering moving to Copenhagen from another EU/EEA country.

We would like to hear from you if you:

  • are a trained chef or have equivalent professional kitchen experience

  • have experience from à la carte restaurants, quality staff restaurants, hotels or similar professional kitchens

  • have solid experience in the hot kitchen

  • have a genuine interest in food, ingredients and good craftsmanship

  • can organise your own work and maintain a good pace throughout the day

  • are reliable and comfortable starting work early

  • enjoy working as part of a team

  • communicate in a positive and respectful way

  • can maintain an overview when the kitchen gets busy.

A background in classic French or Mediterranean cuisine would be particularly relevant to our kitchen.

However, we are also interested in chefs who bring their own culinary background and experience. Whether your inspiration comes from France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, North or South America, Asia or somewhere else, we would like to see what you can bring to the team.

We want to taste what you are passionate about.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a full-time chef position in central Copenhagen with a working schedule that is unusual in the restaurant industry:

Monday–Friday
Primarily 06:30–14:30
Most evenings and weekends free

You will join a friendly and international workplace with experienced colleagues, high professional standards and room to contribute your own knowledge and ideas.

We value professional pride, teamwork, reliability and a positive working environment.

Our goal is simple: good food, good ingredients, good craftsmanship and a kitchen team that works well together.

MORE THAN A STAFF RESTAURANT

Your daily workplace will be:

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Kalvebod Brygge 35
1560 Copenhagen V
Denmark

Our kitchen also produces food for our small Copenhagen wine bar, Sankt Annæ 8, located in Christianshavn.

Within the same ownership group, we operate several Copenhagen restaurants, including Le Métier, La Propina and Ma Cuisine.

You will therefore become part of a wider restaurant family with different concepts and opportunities for future professional development.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Chef
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Primarily Monday–Friday, 06:30–14:30
Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark
Starting date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications and experience and agreed individually
Evening/weekend work: Occasional events only

INTERESTED?

Send us your CV and a short application in English to:

job@willworkforfood.dk

Please write “CHEF FOR ABACUS” in the subject line.

Tell us a little about yourself, your kitchen experience, what kind of food you enjoy cooking and when you would be available to start.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and suitable candidates will be invited for an interview.

If you are currently living outside Denmark, please mention your current location and when you would potentially be available to relocate to Copenhagen.

We look forward to meeting you for a coffee and a conversation about food, ambitions and your future in Copenhagen.

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Copenhagen, Denmark

jobs.title: Senior Digital Design Engineer for ASIC Development
jobs.description:
Take digital ASIC designs from early concepts all the way to mass production.



We are strengthening our ASIC Design Team at Murata Finland and are looking for a Senior Digital Design Engineer to join us in Vantaa, Finland. We work in a hybrid model, so partial remote work is possible.

Murata Finland develops leading-edge gyroscope and accelerometer safety-critical sensors for global automotive, industrial and healthcare markets. We design full-custom mixed-mode ASICs from concept to volume production, including wafer-level testing.



Your role

As a Senior Digital Design Engineer, you will work on digital ASIC design from early concept development through to mass production ramp-up. You will collaborate with design partners, Murata lead engineers, product managers and the design team throughout the development process.



What you bring

We are looking for an experienced digital design professional with:

- Technical education (e.g. B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D. or D.Sc.) with an emphasis on digital microelectronics
- 3+ years of experience in digital design
- Experience in Verilog (or VHDL) RTL coding
- Experience in design verification using digital design tools
- Understanding of the RTL-to-GDSII flow
- A proactive, systematic and careful way of working
- Fluent communication skills in English
- Good communication skills and the ability to understand various requirements and communicate effectively with external partners and internal teams
- An innovative mindset and interest in working in an international environment



Additional experience we value

Experience in any of the following areas is considered an advantage:

- Architecture planning and functional specification
- Implementation of DSP algorithms, such as FIR or IIR filters and floating-point MAC (Multiply and Accumulate) calculations
- Digital interfaces: SPI, I2C, I3C or PSI5
- Test bench reference models using e.g. Matlab, Simulink or Python
- Verification environments: UVM (Universal Verification Methodology) based on SV (SystemVerilog) or CocoTB (Coroutine cosimulation testbench) based on Python
- ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) and LBIST (Logic Built-In Self-Test)
- FPGA, e.g. as a development environment, for customer emulator use or test support
- Digital backend design, including synthesis, timing analysis, DFT, layout and power analysis



How we work

Our culture is based on two values: employee satisfaction and customer satisfaction. Together, we have defined what these values mean in practice in what we call our cultural etiquette.

For us, employee satisfaction means helping each other, treating each other equally and in a friendly manner, and maintaining an open discussion culture. Customer satisfaction means being proactive and innovative and considering our customers needs in what we do. Would this kind of work community suit you?



Small technology, real-world impact

We believe that the tiniest things can have the greatest impact. With our innovative sensor technology, cars remain in their lanes, peoples hearts keep beating and bridges do not collapse.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology that contributes to the advancement of society. The combination of our Finnish and Japanese capabilities will enable safe and autonomous driving – in all places.



Interested?

For more information, please contact the hiring manager Teemu Salo tel. +358 50 327 8984 or e-mail teemu.salo@murata.com, who will be happy to tell you more about Murata and the position.

Please send your application, resume and salary expectations by 18 October 2026 via the application link. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

Read more about Murata at www.muratafinland.com and follow us in LinkedIn (Murata), Instagram (@muratafinland) and Facebook (@MurataFinland).



From our News & Stories, you can read more about what it's like to work at Murata and find out if Murata is the right workplace for you! You can read about the different teams, the study and career path opportunities, as well as how development and growth appear at Murata, from product development to production work.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Clinical Pharmacy
jobs.description:
Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy, and Environmental Medicine at the Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health, University of Southern Denmark, is offering a new 5-year (20%) position for an Associate Professor within clinical pharmacy. The position is to be filled from February 1st, 2027.

The academic position

The research areas of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM) span from pharmacological epidemiology to clinical studies and cell-based basic pharmacology. CPPEM has a strong background in investigations of exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. The academic position is affiliated with the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, that utilizes the Danish registries to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. 

The area of research is flexible within the area of pharmacoepidemiologic and clinical research and could be (but is not limited to) drug use patterns and rational pharmacotherapy. The department has a strong focus on interdisciplinary collaboration both in-house and with external researchers and the new person is expected to continue this tradition.
 

Areas of responsibility

The applicant will be expected to establish their own research area within the pharmacoepidemiologic research group at the department. Thus, the applicant should be able to attract external research funding to support research and employ scientific and technical staff. The applicant may have a background within pharmacy or medicine.

The research unit teaches in four educations: Medicine, Pharmacy, Chiropractor, and Biomedicine, and the position comes with teaching obligations within these subjects at the University as well as supervision of bachelor and master projects. Additionally, we expect that you will contribute to administrative duties, e.g., participating in Study Board or other similar activities. 

Fluent English (both written and spoken) is required. You are expected to have qualifications that renders it probable that you will be able to establish your own research area within the research unit. Further, you are required to have a PhD degree or similar research experience. 
 

Employers

Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine today has approximately 50 employees. It consists of three separate research groups: pharmacoepidemiology, translational pharmacology, and environmental medicine. Additionally, it collaborates closely with the Department of Pharmacology at OUH. Collectively, this constitutes Denmark’s largest center for research, teaching and clinical service in pharmacology.

It produces approximately 100 international peer-reviewed publications per year. 

Professor Tore B. Stage heads the unit and Professor Pernille Tanggaard Andersen heads the Department.


Management

The Associate Professor answers to the research leader for the unit of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine.
 

Contact information

Further information can be obtained from the leader for the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, Professor Anton Pottegård (apottegaard@health.sdu.dk).
 

Application deadline and interviews

November 1, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. CET
 

Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the university.

Applications – including the required attachments – must be sent via the below-mentioned link “Apply online". Only online applications will be accepted. Attached files must be Adobe PDF or Word format. Each field in the application form can contain up to max. 10 MB.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.
 

Application (as pdf- or Word/docx- files):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of PhD diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please notice that one pdf- or docx- file must be attached for each publication

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

References will be obtained for the applicant who is the first choice for the position – from the applicant’s most recent employer and previous employers as required.

Further particulars concerning the application – please see the link below.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies
jobs.description:
PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies, Military Artificial Intelligence, Peace and International Security

The Danish Institute for International Studies (DIIS) is recruiting a PhD candidate to research military applications of artificial intelligence and their implications for peace and international security. We are especially interested in projects that examine how the development and use of AI-based military capabilities affect established practices of decision-making, human control, and accountability. The project should connect a nuanced understanding of the dynamics of technological change to wider questions of arms control and international regulation. 

The position is based at the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and will thematically be placed under one of the three pillars of the Centre, namely Arms control in a time of arms races and war. One of the questions that the Centre focuses on is how Nordic countries, including Denmark, can navigate a situation where the development of new technologies (e.g. AI and drones), along with increasing great power rivalry and competition in space, entail new types of security risks that traditional arms control models and treaties do not effectively regulate.

The successful candidate will develop an independent PhD project that speaks to the overall focus of the center and produces research relevant to Nordic and international debates on security and peace.

About the position 
AI is changing how military organizations collect information, assess threats, select targets and coordinate operations. These capabilities are currently developed faster than military doctrine, legal interpretation and oversight arrangements intended to govern their use. This raises questions about who exercises control, how responsibility is assigned, and how other states interpret capabilities whose operation is difficult to observe. Within this overall frame relevant proposals may examine:

  • The relationship between the adoption of AI and the development of military doctrine

  • The effects of AI-enabled decision support on military decision-making and the human role therein

  • The impact of uncertainty and opacity around the current state of AI integration among militaries on escalation dynamics and arms-race dynamics

  • Regulation of AI through multilateral governance mechanisms in and beyond the UN

  • Human judgement and accountability in military applications of AI

About DIIS and the position
The successful candidate will be employed by DIIS in a three-year, full-time PhD position, expected to commence on 1 February 2027. The candidate will be enrolled in the PhD School at the Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), while their primary place of work will be the Centre for Peace Research at DIIS.

The PhD project will be jointly supervised by a senior researcher at DIIS and Professor Ingvild Bode at SDU.

At DIIS, the PhD candidate will join an inspiring and ambitious research environment committed to advancing multidisciplinary scholarship. The successful candidate is expected to engage actively in cross-disciplinary collaboration and to value insights from colleagues working with different theoretical and methodological approaches. Such exchanges across disciplinary boundaries are central to the research environment at DIIS.

We expect the candidate to:

  • have obtained a master’s degree in a relevant field

  • have at least received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master’s thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale and a high weighted grade point average 

  • meet the general requirements for being accepted for enrolment as a PhD candidate (see below)

  • live up to the DIIS entry criteria for PhD positions https://www.diis.dk/files/media/document/diis-entry-criteria-rev-okt-24.pdf 

  • communicate clearly in written and spoken English, and proficiency in Danish is an advantage.

DIIS as a workplace
We offer an attractive and inclusive workplace where our employees can develop. We consider knowledge sharing and feedback essential to creating a dynamic workplace. We expect you to participate proactively in the common efforts of the institute. We prioritize a high degree of presence but want our employees to have a good work-life balance. Therefore, we offer flexible working hours and some possibility of working from home. We are located very close to Copenhagen’s city center with excellent public transportation options.

DIIS is a diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply for this position regardless of their personal background. DIIS is also a workplace where we consider the environmental consequences of our activities and strive to adopt more environmentally sustainable practices both in relation to our daily business at DIIS and our global travel activities.

In the assessment, consideration will be given to the following criteria:

  • The applicant has a relevant master’s degree or equivalent qualifications (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process), cf. the Danish qualifications framework for higher education

  • Quality and relevance of the project description

    • Quality and relevance of the methodical and theoretical choices

    • Consistency and coherence between the research problem and the choice of method and theory

    • The realistic and feasible scope of the PhD project

  • Relevance of the project for the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and DIIS in general

Contract and remuneration
The position as PhD candidate starts on 1 February 2027 and is a 3-year full-time position. Remuneration and other job conditions follow the general agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the Danish Ministry of Finance, local collective agreements at DIIS as well as the 28 June 2019 Danish state protocol on PhD candidates. 

The standard starting salary for a PhD candidate at DIIS is 379,702,61 DKK per year excl. pensions – this may be increased depending on prior work experience after the acquisition of the master’s degree. A pension contribution of 18,07% is added to the above-mentioned salary.

Do you want to know more?
Visit http://www.diis.dk/jobs to learn more about DIIS as a workplace. Questions regarding employment and renumeration can be sent to hr@diis.dk. If you have inquiries regarding the professional focus of the position, you can contact Senior Researcher and Head of Research Unit, Mona Kanwal Sheikh at mosh@diis.dk  

The application
Deadline for applying is 23 October 2026, at 12.00 pm CET. 

Please note that we only accept applications through DIIS’ electronic recruitment system. 

Your application must include all the following documents:

  1. A motivational letter

  2. Curriculum Vitae 

  3. Master’s diploma including grades. If you hold a master’s degree which is not within the ECTS-framework, please also provide:

jobs.title: Santa Claus
jobs.description:
SANTA CLAUS WANTED IN ROVANIEMI CITY CENTRE – JOIN SANTA CLAUS CITY OFFICE!

Would you like to bring joy and create unforgettable moments as Santa Claus? Santa Claus City Office is looking for a Santa Claus performer at Lordi Square in the heart of Rovaniemi for the season from 1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027.

SHIFTS AND EARNING OPPORTUNITIES Evening shifts are available every day from 4 pm to 9 pm or 10 pm. Morning shifts are also available on Saturdays and Sundays.

Ideally, we would like to find someone who can work plenty of shifts. For the right person, we offer good pay and the opportunity to make this a full-time job for the season.

However, shifts can also be shared among several Santa performers as a team, just as we did last year. You do not need to be available for every shift – a few shifts a week or occasional cover would also be a valuable help. You can combine this role with another job and start with a few shifts to get to know the work.

Please feel free to apply and tell us what availability would suit you. Lets see how we can arrange the shifts together!

WHAT IS THE WORK LIKE? Being Santa is all about warm welcomes and creating happy moments. You will meet children and adults from around the world, chat with them and become part of their Christmas memories.

This is a cheerful, people-focused role where you can bring your own personality and sense of humour. We value a relaxed, positive atmosphere where both our team and our visitors feel welcome.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We are looking for a warm, calm and friendly person with a customer service mindset who feels comfortable stepping into the role of Santa Claus. We value a convincing Santa presence, life experience and the ability to connect with both children and adults.

Basic conversational English is enough – you do not need perfect grammar or fluent English. Most of our visitors are not native English speakers either, so basic English and a willingness to chat will take you a long way. Any additional language skills are a bonus!

International and English-speaking applicants are warmly welcome. Previous experience is not essential, as we provide training. Training will begin soon, and we will agree on your starting date with you.

LOCATION Santa Claus City Office, Lordi Square, Rovaniemi, Finland. You will work in a warm Santas cabin brought to the square for the season.

HOW TO APPLY Send us a short introduction about yourself by email. Tell us why you would suit the role of Santa Claus, how much work you are looking for and when you could start training. Please also describe your language skills and your availability for evening shifts and weekend morning and evening shifts.

We would love to hear from you!

CONTACT

Marko Paksuniemi, Santa Claus City Office

paksuniemimarko@yahoo.com

EMAIL SUBJECT JOB APPLICATION – Santa Claus / Santa Claus City Office

PLEASE NOTE BEFORE APPLYING Unfortunately, we are unable to provide accommodation. Applicants must already be in Rovaniemi or be able to arrange their own travel to Rovaniemi and accommodation for the entire employment period. Applicants must also have the legal right to work in Finland.

jobs.description:
Kompetent lægesekretær eller klinikassistent søges til velfungerende speciallægepraksis i øre- næse- halssygdomme.

 

Øre-næse-halsklinikken i Vejen er en speciallægeklinik med én fast speciallæge og én

konsultationssygeplejerske samt én lægesekretær. Vores dygtige sekretær søger nye udfordringer, hvorfor vi søger en ny medarbejder til et alsidigt og spændende job.

 

Om jobbet

Vi søger en dygtig,  engageret og arbejdsom medarbejder. Arbejdet foregår i tæt samarbejde med sygeplejersken og speciallægen. Vi har godt humør i hverdagen. Antallet af timer kan aftales fra 25-30 timer fordelt på 4-5 hverdage.

Arbejdsdagen består blandt andet af visitering af patienter i telefontiden som er ca. 2-3 timer dagligt. Desuden er der flere afvekslende opgaver såsom høreprøver, allergitest, lungefunktionsundersøgelse, svimmelhedsundersøgelser samt rengøring af instrumenter. Du vil blive grundigt oplært i alle opgaver. Der er desuden operationsdage i fuld bedøvelse, hvor du skal hjælpe til.

 

Om dig

Vi forventer en god arbejdsmoral med glæde og godt humør til patienterne. Det er vigtigt med gode kommunikative egenskaber og imødekommenhed. Du har gåpåmod, er sympatisk og pligtopfyldende.

Det er vigtigt, at du er robust og kan håndtere en til tider travl hverdag i klinikken.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse som enten lægesekretær eller klinikassistent, men hvis du passer ind i vores team og har den rette indstilling, er uddannelsen mindre vigtig.

 

Om os

Vi tilbyder en fantastisk arbejdsplads med en varieret arbejdsdag, gode kolleger og supervision. Vi sætter patientens velvære i klinikken højt og bidrager med godt humør. Faglighed og ordentlighed er i højsæde.

jobs.title: Postdoc in intestinal regeneration and mucosal immunology
jobs.description:
A full-time (100%) postdoctoral position is available in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to two years, with the possibility of extension subject to funding.

Research tasks

The position comprises research, teaching, professional development and supervision within intestinal tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The postdoc will join a translational research programme that investigates how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be targeted to promote safe and durable mucosal healing.

The successful candidate will combine patient-derived organoid and co-culture models with molecular biology, functional assays, and computational analysis of single-cell and spatial datasets. The position is particularly suited to a researcher who can connect experimental biology with bioinformatics and clinically relevant questions.

Research environment

The postdoc will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Department of Clinical Research and the Department of Molecular Medicine at SDU. The project benefits from close interaction among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop an independent research profile, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and build collaborations across experimental, computational and clinical disciplines.

Research project

The project investigates how inflammatory history establishes persistent epithelial and niche memory, shapes epithelial plasticity and influences intestinal regeneration in IBD. Using patient-derived biopsies, intestinal organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures, we will determine how epithelial memory and injury-induced cell-state transitions influence regenerative capacity and distinguish effective from impaired mucosal healing.

Functional experiments will be integrated with single-cell RNA sequencing, chromatin-accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. CRISPR-engineered patient-derived organoids, including lineage reporters and targeted genetic perturbations, will be used to trace epithelial cell states and validate candidate mechanisms. Selected organoids will also be tested in engraftment models to determine whether regenerative phenotypes translate into improved tissue integration and repair in vivo.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and fibroblast–immune-cell co-cultures to investigate epithelial plasticity, cell-state transitions, regeneration, inflammatory responses and barrier function.

  • Generate and validate CRISPR-engineered organoids, including reporter lines and targeted genetic perturbations, and perform engraftment studies to assess regenerative potential in vivo.

  • Analyse and integrate scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic and spatial epigenomic datasets using reproducible workflows for quality control, differential analysis, cell-state annotation, trajectory analysis and multimodal integration.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods, including qPCR, immunostaining, advanced microscopy, flow cytometry and ELISA-based assays, and validate candidate pathways using pharmacological and CRISPR-based perturbations where appropriate.

  • Collaborate with clinicians, experimental scientists and bioinformaticians to analyse and interpret patient-derived samples and data.

  • Maintain accurate and reproducible records, present findings, prepare manuscripts and conference contributions, and contribute to grant applications, teaching and supervision where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications

The successful applicant must hold a PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, bioinformatics, computational biology, regenerative medicine, biomedicine or a closely related discipline, with documented research experience relevant to the project.

Essential qualifications

  • Documented experience in organoid biology, preferably involving intestinal or other tissue-derived epithelial organoids, and in designing mechanistic studies of epithelial plasticity and regeneration.

  • A strong background in tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology, inflammatory disease or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated expertise in analysing single-cell or spatial-omics data, with proficiency in R and/or Python and experience developing reproducible computational workflows.

  • Hands-on experience in molecular and cell biology, with the ability to design, perform, troubleshoot and interpret experiments using a structured and careful approach to data analysis, documentation and responsible research practice.

  • A strong publication record appropriate to career stage; excellent written and spoken English; and the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, fibroblast or immune-cell culture, or epithelial–stromal–immune co-culture models.

  • Experience integrating scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic, spatial epigenomic or other multimodal datasets.

  • Familiarity with advanced imaging, quantitative image analysis, flow cytometry, organoid phenotyping or high-content screening.

  • Demonstrated experience generating and validating CRISPR-engineered organoids, including knock-in reporters or targeted gene perturbations, and with intestinal organoid engraftment or transplantation and in vivo assessment of epithelial regeneration is highly preferred.

  • An interest in supervising junior researchers and contributing to collaborative teaching and research activities.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Dr. Srustidhar Das, Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), tel.: +45 71504339, e-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

November 1, 2026 at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M, Denmark.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Apulaispäällikkö, ABC Pitkälahti
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUOPIO

ABC PITKÄLAHTI etsii nyt APULAISPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ vakituiseen kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen - ihan tavallisiin töihin, poikkeuksellisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Työ alkaa: sopimuksen mukaan

ABC Pitkälahti on vilkas, ympäri vuorokauden palveleva liikennemyymälä Kuopiossa Vitostien varrella. Asiakkaitamme ovat niin paikalliset, matkailijat kuin ammattiautoilijatkin. Ravintolamme tarjonta ulottuu aamiaisesta nouto- ja pizzapöytään, à la carte -annoksiin ja ABC Burgerin tuotteisiin. Kahvilasta asiakkaat saavat suolaiset ja makeat herkut sekä juomat ympäri vuorokauden. Kokonaisuuteen kuuluvat myös kattavat autoilijan palvelut tankkauksesta sähköautojen lataukseen ja autopesuun.

Millaista työ käytännössä on?
Apulaispäällikkönä johdat ravintolan päivittäistä toimintaa ja huolehdit siitä, että vuorot sujuvat hyvässä hengessä. Olet läsnä tiimin arjessa, autat työntekijöitä onnistumaan ja rakennat yhdessä henkilöstön kanssa kannustavaa työarkea. Samalla pidät katseen myynnissä, asiakaskokemuksessa ja toiminnan tuloksellisuudessa. Seuraat keskeisiä tunnuslukuja ja kehität toimintaa yhdessä liikennemyymäläpäällikön kanssa. Toimit hänen tukenaan ja otat hänen poissa ollessaan laajemmin vastuuta koko liikennemyymälän sujuvasta toiminnasta.

Odotamme sinulta
- kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja vuorojen johtamisesta
- innostavaa ja tavoitteellista johtamisotetta sekä halua kehittää toimintaa ja henkilöstön osaamista
- asiakaslähtöisyyttä sekä hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja myös kiireessä
- valmiutta vuorotyöhön
- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä valmiutta käyttää englantia erilaisissa työtilanteissa
- kykyä pitää monta lankaa käsissä ja nähdä liikennemyymälä yhtenä kokonaisuutena

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Monipuolista ja vastuullista esihenkilötehtävää
- Mahdollisuutta vaikuttaa suuren ravintolatiimin toimintaan ja kehitykseen
- Osaavia ja kannustavia työkavereita
- Liikennemyymäläpäällikön ja muun esihenkilötiimin vahvaa tukea
- Mahdollisuutta kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi
- Kattavia S-ryhmän ja Osuuskauppa PeeÄssän henkilöstöetuja, kuten henkilökunta-alennuksia ja Epassin etuja jopa 250 euroa arvosta vuodessa. Lue lisää tästä.

Palkkaus
Tehtävän palkka on MaRaVa-esihenkilöiden työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 4 mukaisesti 2 501-2 713 euroa kuukaudessa kokemusvuosista riippuen. Tämän lisäksi maksetaan työryhmän kokoon perustuvaa lisää, joka on tällä hetkellä 4 %.
Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus ansaita vuosittaista tulospalkkiota Osuuskauppa PeeÄssän kulloinkin voimassa olevan tulospalkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti.

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta - ja välillä juhlastakin - vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

Kuulostaako tämä sinun paikaltasi? Lähetä hakemuksesi - kuulemme sinusta mielellämme!

Hakuaika päättyy 13.10.2026. Ethän kuitenkaan jää odottelemaan viime hetkeen, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia ja pidämme haastatteluja jo hakuaikana. Tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ABC Pitkälahden liikennemyymäläpäällikkö Mira Myllynen, p. 050 446 0227. Jos kiinnostuksesi heräsi tai jokin asia mietityttää, ole rohkeasti yhteydessä - kysymällä se selviää!

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Lundi ja Sale Gammelbacka / Försäljare, Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

MYYJÄ, SALE LUNDI JA SALE GAMMELBACKA, 30 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme myyjää Sale Lundiin ja Sale Gammelbackaan vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, 30 tuntia viikossa. Myyjänä työskentelet monipuolisesti kaupan eri tehtävissä: palvelet asiakkaita kassalla, hyllytät tuotteita, huolehdit tuotteiden esillepanosta ja päiväysten seurannasta sekä varmistat myymälöiden siisteyden, viihtyisyyden ja tuotteiden saatavuuden. Perehdytyksen jälkeen tunnet tarjoamamme tuotteet ja palvelut sekä asiakasomistajuuteen liittyvät asiat ja osaat kertoa niistä asiakkaillemme heidän tarpeensa huomioiden.

Me Sale Lundissa ja Sale Gammelbackassa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita, että työ olisi tylsää – päinvastoin! Tarjoamme vaihtelevan työn asiakaspalvelun parissa ja tiimin, jossa kaveria ei jätetä.

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaslähtöistä asennetta sekä oma-aloitteista ja vastuuntuntoista työotetta.
- Halua oppia uutta ja kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Valmiutta työskennellä kaikissa vuoroissa myymälöiden kaikkina aukioloaikoina, myös viikonloppuisin ja juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta (10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtunti tulospalkkioon yrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 11.10.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa toimipaikkapäälliköt Sari Pulli ja Janica Venäläinen (sara.pulli@sok.fi / janica.l.venalainen@sok.fi ). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

--------------------



FÖRSÄLJARE, SALE LUNDI OCH SALE GAMMELBACKA, 30 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka för en fast anställning på 30 timmar i veckan. Som försäljare arbetar du mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter: du betjänar kunder i kassan, plockar upp varor, sköter produktpresentationer och datumkontroller samt ser till att butikerna är rena och trivsamma och att varorna finns tillgängliga. Efter introduktionen känner du till våra produkter och tjänster samt frågor som gäller ägarkundskap och kan berätta om dem för kunderna utifrån deras behov.

Vi på Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka brukar säga att vi har helt vanliga jobb. Det betyder ändå inte att arbetet är tråkigt – tvärtom! Vi erbjuder ett varierande arbete inom kundservice och ett team där vi ställer upp för varandra.

Vi önskar att du:
- Bemöter kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätta stället <3
- Har ett energiskt och kundorienterat förhållningssätt samt arbetar initiativrikt och ansvarsfullt.
- Vill lära dig nytt och har förmåga att ta till dig olika system.
- Är beredd att arbeta alla skift under butikernas samtliga öppettider, även veckoslut och helgdagar.
- Har kunskaper i finska; kunskaper i svenska ses som meriter.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- En arbetsplats där det är trevligt att komma till jobbet och trevligt att gå hem efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där ingen lämnas ensam och där cheferna deltar i det dagliga arbetet.
- Möjligheter att utvecklas och utbilda sig.
- Rabatter på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster – mat, dryck, kosmetik, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat.
- Kultur-, välmående- och motionsförmåner.

Lön
- Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för handelsbranschen (10,89 €/h–14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 % om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till en gemensam resultatbonus för hela personalen på upp till 1,70 € per arbetad timme, utifrån företagets resultat och branschspecifika mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi går vidare med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast söndagen den 11.10.2026. Närmare information om uppgiften ger enhetscheferna Sari Pulli och Janica Venäläinen (sara.pulli@sok.fi / janica.l.venalainen@sok.fi ). Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse.

Hos Callmark ApS har vi forrygende travlt, og vi søger derfor en ny kollega til telemarketing og mødebooking. Vi leder efter dig, der allerede ved, hvad det kræver at løfte røret, og som motiveres af den gode, professionelle dialog.

Om dig: Du kender gamet og mestrer kold canvas

Vi leder ikke nødvendigvis efter mange års erfaring, men det er et krav du har dokumenteret erfaring med kold canvas over telefonen og forstå dynamikken i en opsøgende dialog. Din baggrund kan være fra telesalg, mødebooking, annoncesalg eller lignende.

  • Du har telefon-erfaring: Du har prøvet at arbejde med kold canvas, kundedialog eller dataindsamling før.

  • Du skaber tillid: Du formår hurtigt at opbygge en god relation over telefonen og booke kvalitetsmøder.

  • Det er en fordel (men ikke et krav), hvis: Du tidligere har booket møder inden for HR, IT, marketing, forsikring eller pension.

  • Du er selvkørende: Du trives med frihed under ansvar.

Jobbet: Stor frihedsgrad og professionelle projekter

Som vores nye kollega bliver du tilknyttet 2-4 faste kundeprojekter. Vi booker det indledende, strategiske salgsmøde for vores kunder, og vi indhenter markedsinformation af høj kvalitet.

Vi stoler på vores medarbejdere. Derfor tilbyder vi en yderst fleksibel arbejdsuge, hvor du som udgangspunkt arbejder 2-3 dage på vores kontor i Greve og 2-3 dage hjemmefra. Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring i vores produkter og processer, så du får de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkedes.

Hvem er Callmark ApS?

Vi er et veletableret mødebookingbureau med mere end 20 års erfaring i branchen. Vi er i dag 10 dedikerede medarbejdere. Her møder du et voksent, dygtigt og humoristisk team, hvor fagligheden er høj, og hvor vi sparrer med hinanden på tværs.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Matcher du profilen, så tøv ikke med at sende os din ansøgning og dit CV med det samme. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Ansøg her: https://career.hitalento.com/callmark/job/modebooker/

jobs.title: Chefs/ Souschefs - Job opportunities at LOCA – Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Join LOCA – gastronomy, hospitality and sustainability

LOCA Group is looking for talented and passionate Chefs and Sous Chefs to join our restaurants in Copenhagen.
At LOCA, we work with something we believe is one of the most important things in the world: the meal. We believe gastronomy can help create a better future, and every day we work to combine high gastronomic standards, genuine hospitality and concrete sustainable choices.
For us, sustainability starts with the ingredient. We work with seasonal produce, high levels of organic ingredients, local producers and reducing food waste.
We want to raise the bar for how sustainability is approached in gastronomy – without compromising flavour or the guest experience.

We are looking for Chefs and Sous ChefsWe are looking for both experienced Chefs and Sous Chefs who want to become part of our different kitchens.We are looking for people who:

  • Are trained Chefs or have equivalent relevant experience

  • Have experience from professional kitchens with high gastronomic standards.

  • Work in a structured way and remain calm and focused during service.

  • Have strong culinary skills and a genuine passion for gastronomy.

  • Enjoy teamwork and contribute positively to the kitchen environment.

  • Are curious and motivated to develop both professionally and personally.

  • Have an interest in sustainability, organic ingredients, seasonal produce and local producers.

  • For Sous Chef positions, you should also have experience with leadership, planning, ordering, food safety and the daily operation of a professional kitchen.


We value respect, collaboration, responsibility and the desire to keep improving.

Our restaurants

As part of LOCA, you will have the opportunity to work in different gastronomic environments:

Amélie – The Opera House
A modern Danish brasserie where classic French techniques meet Danish ingredients and the unique atmosphere of the Opera House. The kitchen works across à la carte, opera service and larger events
.PAULA – Carlsberg Byen
A modern French-Japanese kitchen focusing on deep umami, precision, seasonal ingredients and a minimum of 60% organic produce. A small, focused team with high gastronomic ambitions.
DOLORES – Carlsberg Byen
A vibrant restaurant inspired by San Francisco’s Mission District, serving creative sharing-style dishes with seasonal ingredients in a relaxed atmosphere.
Restaurant RADIO – Frederiksberg
A modern Nordic restaurant with more than 15 years of history. The restaurant focuses on organic and seasonal ingredients, local producers, vegetables and fish from Nordic waters.LOCA also operates
Kilden i Haven in Tivoli and several canteens.

What we offer

  • A workplace with high gastronomic ambitions.

  • An international and diverse working environment.

  • Passionate and dedicated colleagues.

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.

  • Responsibility and influence in your daily work.

  • Opportunities for further training and development within LOCA.

  • Salary and employment conditions based on qualifications.

  • The opportunity to become part of a company actively working to shape the future of sustainable gastronomy.


Why LOCA?We believe the best restaurants are created by people who want to succeed together.At LOCA, you are not simply joining a kitchen. You become part of a community where we share knowledge, support each other and work together to create great meals and great workplaces.We believe Every Meal Matters – and that the choices we make today help create a better world tomorrow.Practical information

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment: Full-time

Positions: Chef / Sous Chef

Start: By agreement / as soon as possible

Salary: Based on qualifications

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
If you would like to join LOCA, please send your CV and application telling us a little about yourself, your experience and why you would like to work with us.Send your resume to job@locarestauranter.dk

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator / Secretary – Hellerup Office Center
jobs.description:
Hellerup Office Center ApS runs a business centre on Strandvejen in Hellerup, where we provide offices, reception, secretarial and related office services to our clients. As we are adding new services for our clients, such as maintenance, cleaning and repair, IT support and telephone services, our administration is growing.   • Filing and maintaining client, contract and supplier records

  • Practical coordination with suppliers and external service providers

  • Registering and following up on client enquiries and complaints

You will report to our Head of Administration.

Your profile

Hellerup Office Center ApS

CVR no. 40925546

jobs.description:
Tervetuloa Onnin lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun!


----------------------------------------

Etsimme joukkoomme lämminhenkisiä ja reippaalla palveluasenteella varustettuja lähihoitajia tai loppuvaiheen opiskelijoita!

Onnin lähihoitajana olet perheiden tuki ja apu arjessa ja työskentelet perheen kotona itsenäisesti palveluperiaatteidemme mukaisesti. Työtehtäviisi sisältyy perheen tarpeiden mukaisesti esim. kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, lastenhoitoa ja muita perhettä tukevia toimia. Toivomme hakijalta osaamista vammaispalveluiden palveluista. Työ on pääsääntöisesti arki-iltaisin tai viikonloppuisin tehtävää.

Arvomme ystävällisyys, joustavuus ja luotettavuus näkyvät päivittäisessä työssämme.

Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammatissasi. Onnilaisten rempseä tiimi jakaa arjen kanssasi ja toimii tukenasi. Maksamme sinulle kokemusvuosiesi perusteella 15,51€/h - 16,92€/h + mahdolliset Tes-lisät

Kuulumme kotimaiseen Tradeka-konserniin, ja tarjoamme onnilaisille kattavia etuja, kuten:

* Alennuksia Restelin ravintoloissa

Tehtävään valitun henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Odotamme jo hakemustasi! Ole yhteydessä rohkeasti tiimiesihenkilö Katja Lahtiseen, katja.lahtinen@onnion.fi tai hae helposti viimeistään 13.10 mennessä.


Tutustu tarkemmin henkilöstöetuihin ja Onniin työnantajana täällä: https://www.onnion.fi/rekrytointi/ [https://www.onnion.fi/rekrytointi/]

----------------------------------------

Tehtävä kuuluu työtehtäviin, joissa työnantajalla on yksityisyyden suojasta työelämässä annetun lain (759/2004) mukaisin edellytyksin mahdollisuus pyytää tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus.

Compete à profissional realizar avaliações especializadas, identificar dificuldades ao nível da linguagem oral e escrita, fala, voz, comunicação e deglutição, bem como planear e implementar programas de intervenção terapêutica individualizados, adequados às necessidades de cada utente. jobs.title: AGENTES DE CRÉDITO E EMPRÉSTIMOS
jobs.description:
E se o seu próximo trabalho fosse ajudar pessoas a concretizar alguns dos projetos mais importantes das suas vidas?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa de Intermediação de Crédito em Portimão e procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, de números e, sobretudo, de encontrar soluções.

Mais do que um Gestor de Crédito, procuramos uma pessoa curiosa, determinada e com vontade de fazer a diferença. Alguém capaz de ouvir um cliente, compreender a sua realidade e acompanhá-lo na procura de uma solução de financiamento adequada, competitiva e responsável.

No dia a dia, irá analisar necessidades e perfis financeiros, preparar e acompanhar processos de crédito, contactar entidades financeiras, comparar propostas e estar ao lado do cliente desde o primeiro contacto até à conclusão do processo.

Experiência na banca, crédito, seguros ou área financeira será valorizada, e muito. Mas não é o único caminho para chegar até nós. Se tem perfil comercial, facilidade de comunicação, capacidade de organização e vontade genuína de aprender, queremos conhecê-lo(a).

Procuramos alguém com energia, empatia, responsabilidade, capacidade de negociação e gosto por objetivos. Acima de tudo, alguém que perceba que por detrás de cada processo existem pessoas, famílias e projetos de vida.

Da nossa parte, encontrará formação, acompanhamento, ferramentas de trabalho e uma equipa disponível para ajudar. Queremos que cresça profissionalmente, desenvolva competências e encontre espaço para construir o seu próprio percurso connosco.

Se procura apenas mais um trabalho, talvez não sejamos o projeto certo. Se procura uma oportunidade para aprender, crescer e sentir que o seu trabalho tem impacto real na vida das pessoas, queremos falar consigo.

jobs.title: AGENTE IMOBILIÁRIO E GESTOR DE PROPRIEDADES
jobs.description:
E se o seu próximo desafio profissional não tivesse dias todos iguais?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa imobiliária em Portimão e procuramos pessoas com energia, iniciativa e vontade de construir uma carreira onde o contacto humano, a autonomia e os resultados fazem parte do dia a dia.

Não procuramos apenas alguém para vender imóveis. Procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, que tenha curiosidade pelo mercado e que queira tornar-se um verdadeiro profissional de confiança para quem precisa de comprar ou vender uma casa.

O dia a dia passa por conhecer e trabalhar uma determinada zona, identificar oportunidades, contactar proprietários, angariar e promover imóveis, acompanhar compradores e vendedores, realizar visitas, negociar propostas e estar presente em todas as etapas até à concretização do negócio.

Já tem experiência no imobiliário ou na área comercial? Excelente. Nunca trabalhou no setor? Isso não é necessariamente um problema. Procuramos sobretudo atitude, capacidade de comunicação, resiliência e vontade de aprender. O conhecimento e as ferramentas podem ser adquiridos; a vontade de fazer acontecer tem de partir de si.

Valorizamos pessoas positivas, responsáveis, organizadas e com espírito empreendedor. Pessoas que saibam ouvir, criar relações de confiança e que não tenham receio de sair da zona de conforto para alcançar objetivos.

Da nossa parte, encontrará formação, acompanhamento próximo, apoio comercial, jurídico e de marketing, CRM e ferramentas para desenvolver a sua atividade, integrando uma equipa onde a entreajuda faz parte da forma de trabalhar.

Não prometemos que todos os dias serão fáceis. Prometemos que serão diferentes.

Se procura uma profissão onde possa conhecer pessoas, desenvolver-se, superar-se e sentir que o seu trabalho é realmente seu, talvez esteja na altura de nos conhecermos.

RESPONSABILITÉS :

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Applications pour assurer l'interface technique principale entre les clients, les partenaires système et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora. Ce rôle combine accompagnement client, support technique, intégration de plateformes et résolution de problèmes au niveau système, afin d'assurer le succès du déploiement des solutions IA basées sur l'accélérateur Vsora.


Vos responsabilités :
- Servir de pont entre les clients et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora, assurant une communication efficace et la priorisation des problèmes techniques. Traduire les exigences clients, les demandes de fonctionnalités et les défis de déploiement en retours actionnables pour les équipes.
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de validation logicielle, runtime, compilateur, logiciel IA et matériel pour résoudre les problèmes et améliorer le produit.
- Suivre et gérer les escalades clients jusqu'à leur résolution, en maintenant une communication claire avec l'ensemble des parties prenantes.
- Accompagner les fabricants de serveurs, OEM, ODM et partenaires plateforme dans l'intégration des accélérateurs Vsora dans des systèmes de production. Résoudre les problèmes au niveau système impliquant le matériel, le firmware, les drivers, le réseau, le stockage, l'alimentation et la thermique.
- Collaborer avec les équipes hardware pour diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes d'intégration plateforme et d'interopérabilité.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

- Solide expérience en support technique, ingénierie terrain (FAE), solutions engineering, ingénierie client ou intégration système.
- Expérience en infrastructure IA, serving d'inférence, déploiement ML ou plateformes datacenter.
- Familiarité avec les frameworks IA et solutions de serving : PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server ou technologies équivalentes.
- Expérience avec les systèmes Linux, les technologies de containerisation, les systèmes distribués. Compréhension de l'architecture serveur, des accélérateurs PCIe et de l'infrastructure datacenter.
- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et débogage : hardware, firmware, drivers, systèmes d'exploitation et logiciels applicatifs.
- Excellentes capacités de communication et de relation client, avec la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non-techniques.
- Expérience avec des OEM, ODM, hyperscalers, cloud providers ou clients enterprise est un fort atout.

jobs.title: Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. Supervised by the CSSF we have the ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

When you join us you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE) preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance within the financial services industry (Larger bank / big four preferred), with a focus on AML, ABC, sanctions, and policy framework.
• In-depth knowledge of European and UK regulatory requirements related to financial crime compliance, including AML directives, sanctions regimes, and bribery/corruption laws.                          
• Proven experience in developing and implementing FCC policies, procedures, and controls across multiple jurisdictions.
• Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to effectively oversee a team and drive results in a dynamic and complex environment.  

Attributes and Qualities

• Leadership & People Management                                
• Collaborative Teamwork                                
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                                
• Conflict Resolution & Negotiation

Technical Skills

• MS Office proficiency

Languages Skills

• English: Fluent
• Any other Quintet language is considered an asset

jobs.description:
Internal Audit - Consulting Senior

Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive

Job description

Requisition ID:  1746567

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity

Join our Internal Audit team in Luxembourg and work with regulated financial institutions on assignments that combine assurance, risk insight and practical transformation. As a Senior Consultant, you will manage key parts of engagements, engage directly with client stakeholders and coach junior colleagues, while deepening your expertise in the Luxembourg regulatory environment. You will join a team that combines deep internal audit expertise, regulatory insight, technology-enabled auditing capabilities and practical experience gained both within financial institutions and through complex advisory engagements.

Your key responsibilities

• Plan and execute risk-based internal audit engagements.
• Assess the design and operating effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control arrangements.
• Draft concise, evidence-based findings that articulate root cause, risk and business impact, and propose pragmatic recommendations.
• Coordinate engagement activities, monitor progress, manage priorities and help ensure high-quality delivery in line with professional standards and agreed timelines.
• Maintain constructive stakeholder relationships.
• Support the design and enhancement of internal audit frameworks, risk assessments, audit universes, methodologies and annual audit plans.
• Monitor remediation of control deficiencies and assess whether corrective actions address the underlying risk.
• Identify opportunities to leverage data analytics, automation and AI-enabled auditing techniques to improve audit coverage, efficiency and insight.
• Coach junior team members, review their work and contribute to knowledge sharing, training and practice development.
• Contribute to proposals and internal audit solutions that respond to client needs and evolving regulatory expectations.

Skills and Attributes for Success

• Strong analytical judgement and the ability to connect detailed control observations with broader business and regulatory risks.
• Clear, confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders professionally and constructively.
• Excellent organization, ownership and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several priorities in a project-based environment.
• A collaborative and curious mindset, with a genuine interest in continuous learning, technology and the development of others.
• Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or a related field.
• At least 2 to 3 years of professional experience in internal/external audit or a related role within the Luxembourg financial sector.
• A sound understanding of risk-based internal audit methodologies, control design, testing and professional reporting.
• Knowledge of the financial-services industry and the Luxembourg regulatory environment.
• Fluency in English and French. German or another European language is an advantage.

Ideally, You'll Also Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas: finance, IT controls, data privacy and protection, anti-bribery and corruption, investor protection, outsourcing, operational resilience, anti-money laundering, AI governance or emerging technology risks.
A relevant professional certification, or a clear interest in working towards one, such as CIA, CRMA or CISA.
Experience using data analytics or technology-enabled auditing techniques.

What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Assurances Vie Entreprises (m/f)
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire Assurances Vie Entreprises

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Professionnels
Home Office Oui

Votre job en bref

En tant que Gestionnaire Vie Entreprises, vous assurez la gestion et le suivi des contrats d'assurance groupe destinés aux entreprises au Luxembourg. Vous accompagnez les clients, partenaires et affiliés tout au long du cycle de vie des contrats, tout en garantissant leur conformité aux exigences légales et réglementaires. Grâce à votre expertise en assurance Vie Groupe (Employee Benefits), vous contribuez à la qualité du service, à la satisfaction des clients et au développement durable des relations commerciales.

Ce qui vous attend

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

• Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vie des contrats d'assurance groupe et des régimes complémentaires de pension : mise en place, renouvellements, décomptes, paiements, investissements, affiliations, sorties et prestations.
• Accompagner les entreprises, les services RH, les affiliés et les courtiers dans le traitement de leurs demandes et le suivi de leurs contrats.
• Contrôler la conformité des dossiers et veiller au respect des exigences légales et réglementaires applicables, notamment en matière d'AML/KYC et d'IGSS.
• Analyser les besoins des entreprises et contribuer à la mise en œuvre de solutions adaptées ainsi qu'à la mise en place de nouveaux contrats.
• Développer et renforcer les relations avec les clients et partenaires, participer aux présentations auprès des employés et assurer le suivi des commissions des agents et courtiers.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Finance, Actuariat, Ventes, Juridique et Compliance afin de garantir une gestion fluide et efficace des contrats.
• Participer au partage des connaissances, aux projets de l'équipe et aux initiatives contribuant à l'amélioration continue de l'activité Vie Entreprises.
• Assurer une veille sur les évolutions du marché et du cadre réglementaire afin de contribuer au maintien de la qualité et de la pertinence des solutions proposées.

Ce que nous attendons

• Formation de niveau BAC+3 à BAC+5 en assurances, gestion, finance ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans une fonction opérationnelle du secteur des assurances, idéalement dans l'environnement Vie Groupe ou Employee Benefits.
• Bonne connaissance des produits Vie Groupe, des régimes complémentaires de pension et du fonctionnement des contrats collectifs.
• Compréhension des enjeux fiscaux, financiers et réglementaires liés au marché luxembourgeois de l'assurance et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement fortement réglementé.
• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques, bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et aisance dans l'utilisation des outils de gestion propres au secteur de l'assurance.
• Esprit d'analyse, aisance avec les chiffres, sens de l'organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers avec rigueur.
• Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, orientation client, sens du service et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes.
• Maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais. L'allemand et/ou le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.
