Véritable manager de proximité, vous combinez expertise en assurance Vie Groupe, leadership et vision opérationnelle. Vous pilotez la performance de l'activité, accompagnez le développement de vos collaborateurs et jouez un rôle moteur dans la transformation et l'optimisation de nos processus.

Ce qui vous attend

Dans ce rôle, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Piloter l'activité Vie Entreprises et contribuer, avec le COO, à la définition des priorités et de la vision du service.
• Garantir la qualité, les délais, la maîtrise des risques et la performance opérationnelle de l'activité.
• Manager, accompagner et développer l'équipe au quotidien : définition des objectifs, coaching, feedback, développement des compétences et suivi des performances individuelles et collectives.
• Promouvoir une culture orientée client, résultats, collaboration et amélioration continue.
• Superviser le portefeuille clients, suivre les principaux KPI et accompagner l'équipe dans le traitement des demandes spécifiques des clients et courtiers.
• Participer aux rendez-vous clients et prospects et apporter votre expertise en soutien aux équipes commerciales.
• Garantir le respect du cadre réglementaire et de conformité applicable à l'activité Vie Groupe ainsi que l'intégrité et la traçabilité des données.
• Préparer les audits internes et externes et assurer le suivi des éventuels plans d'action.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les différentes parties prenantes internes : actuariat, Sales, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT, etc.
• Identifier, prioriser et piloter les projets d'amélioration, de digitalisation et d'automatisation des outils et processus.
• Accompagner les équipes dans la conduite du changement liée aux différents projets de transformation du service.
• Participer activement au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.

Ce que nous attendons

• Diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en assurances, gestion, finance ou équivalent.
• Environ 10 ans d'expérience en assurance Vie Groupe, idéalement avec une première expérience en management.
• Excellente connaissance des produits Vie Groupe et des contrats collectifs, ainsi que de leurs enjeux fiscaux, financiers et réglementaires.
• Leadership, capacité à développer une équipe et forte orientation client et résultats.
• Esprit d'analyse, rigueur et capacité à travailler efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés.
• Maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais. L'allemand et/ou le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

jobs.title: Lower School Learner Support Teacher - 1 year contract (m/f)
jobs.description:
Want to help every learner access, participate and thrive?

At the International School of Luxembourg (ISL), we believe that learner diversity enriches our community. We are looking for a Lower School Learner Support Services (LSS) Teacher who is passionate about creating inclusive learning environments where children feel known, valued and empowered to grow.
Working within our learning community, you will support students with language acquisition and/or diverse learning needs, partnering closely with classroom teachers, families and colleagues across Learner Support Services. Through responsive teaching, targeted intervention and inclusive practice, you will help remove barriers to learning and enable students to develop confidence, agency and independence.
Why does this Role matter?
You will be an important advocate for learners and a resource for our whole learning community. Your expertise will help teachers respond to learner variability, help families understand and support their child's development, and—most importantly—help students recognise themselves as capable, active and successful learners. At ISL, learner support is not simply about helping students overcome challenges. It is about creating the conditions in which every child can participate, develop agency, experience success and reach their potential.

Why ISL?
At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:
● Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
● Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
● Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future
At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for teachers who see teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What will You do?
● Support learners individually, in small groups and within the classroom through inclusive, evidence-informed language and learning interventions.
● Co-teach and collaborate with classroom teachers to differentiate learning experiences and ensure meaningful access to the IB Primary Years Programme curriculum.
● Build learner agency by involving students in understanding their strengths, setting learning goals and reflecting on their progress.
● Use assessment purposefully to identify learning needs, monitor growth and adapt interventions and support.
● Develop and monitor Individual Learning Plans, accommodations and targeted learning goals for students requiring additional support.
● Case-manage students receiving language or learning support, maintaining clear records and coordinating communication between students, families, teachers and relevant specialists.
● Partner with families, building trusting and respectful relationships around each child's learning, development and wellbeing.
● Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, including classroom teachers, counsellors, school leaders and external specialists.
● Strengthen inclusive practice by sharing expertise, resources and strategies with teachers and teaching assistants.
● Contribute actively to the wider Learner Support Services Team and our collaborative professional learning culture.
● Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
● Engaging in personal professional growth and bring fresh ideas into the classroom.
● Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
You will thrive here if you …
● Build positive, trusting relationships with children and creates a strong sense of belonging and psychological safety.
● See learner variability through a strengths-based and inclusive lens.
● Differentiate learning thoughtfully and creatively to reduce barriers and increase participation.
● Collaborate effectively and sees co-teaching as a shared professional practice.
● Communicate sensitively and clearly with students, families, colleagues and external specialists.
● Use evidence, observation and assessment to make informed decisions about learning.
● Are organised and dependable when managing individual learning plans, referrals, documentation and confidential information.
● Reflect on your practice, seeks feedback and remains curious about developments in language acquisition and inclusive education.
● Demonstrate cultural responsiveness, empathy and respect within a diverse international community.

Who are You?
● Strong knowledge of inclusive education, learning differences and/or English language acquisition.
● An understanding of multi-tiered systems of support (“MTSS”) and the use of targeted, evidence-informed interventions.
● Experience with co-teaching, differentiation and inclusive classroom practice.
● Able to use assessment information to identify needs, establish goals and monitor student progress.
● Hold a current teaching qualification/certification and a Bachelor's degree or equivalent; a Master's degree in Special/Inclusive Education, Learning Support, Learning Differences or Language Acquisition is highly valued.
● Preferably two years of recent successful experience working with preschool or primary-aged learners with language and/or learning support needs.
● Experience supporting multilingual learners and recognising multilingualism as an asset.
● Experience interpreting psychoeducational assessments and translating recommendations into classroom practice would be an advantage.
● Experience in an international school and/or IB PYP environment is highly valued.
● Near-native fluency in English and confidence using digital tools to support learning, collaboration and documentation.

We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
Recruitment timeline:
• If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.
• If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

jobs.title: HR Specialist, Research, Strategy & Solutions, Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO) m/f
jobs.description:
HR Specialist, Research, Strategy & Solutions, Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO)
Job ID: 10553049 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

Amazon's Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO) organization exists to earn, drive, deliver and protect the trust between Amazon and its 1.5M+ workforce. Within EXO, the Research, Strategy & Solutions Team is EXO's center of excellence for employee relations research, intelligence, proactive strategies/consulting and solutions. We are seeking a HR Specialist to join our team as an individual contributor reporting to the Research, Strategy and Solutions Leader.

In this role, you will assess data, workplace dynamics, behaviors, external trends, and relationships to identify risks and gaps in the work environment, and translate those insights into sustainable, scalable initiatives, mechanisms, and programs that drive long-lasting change at all levels. You will influence leaders to gain alignment and support, and work cross-functionally and globally to design and execute large-scale proactive strategies.

This is a research-forward role: the emphasis is on data-driven analysis, strategic foresight, and forward-looking trend intelligence rather than reactive ER issues management or investigations. Success requires deep employee and labor relations expertise, strong analytical and research skills, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively.

Key job responsibilities

Research & Trend Intelligence

• Design and maintain ongoing workforce research and trend-monitoring frameworks that detect emerging labor market shifts, geopolitical signals, and employee sentiment patterns
• Conduct competitive benchmarking to identify best practices and emerging risks
• Develop predictive risk models to anticipate ER challenges before they escalate
• Produce research outputs that inform strategic decision-making

Risk Detection and Mitigation

• Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends and challenges, predict and mitigate risk, and develop and execute solution-focused strategies and programs
• Synthesize workforce data, labor-market intelligence, and employee sentiment to surface emerging risks and opportunities

Data Analysis & Strategic Insights

• Exercise strong analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations
• Define and measure success of programs through clear KPIs and research-backed evaluation frameworks

Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnership

• Partner with cross-functional teams including Internal Communications, Public Policy, Public Relations, Legal, Human Resources, and Operations to develop and implement comprehensive strategies that align with organizational priorities
• Lead research initiatives that inform policy decisions and public-facing communications

Program & Project Delivery at Scale

• Independently design, own, and lead successfully large-scale, network-wide projects that improve frontline employee experience
• Translate research findings into scalable mechanisms and programs for entire networks
• Lead the design and implementation with cross functional partners (e.g., Ops Tech) of tech solutions aiming at managing employee relations

Communication & Executive Influence

• Rapidly produce high-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and move solutions from concept to execution
• Present research findings and strategic recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and impact
• Build constructive relationships with critical stakeholders and peers to share information, influence change, and leverage resources to deliver results

Problem-Solving & Ambiguity Management

- Work independently with minimal supervision in ambiguous situations and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions
• Challenge current practices and industry status quo to generate creative mechanisms that bring about large-scale solutions

A day in the life

We are open to hiring this role out of a corporate location from the following countries: Luxembourg, UK/IE, France, Germany, Italy, Spain.

About the team

Our team is committed to building an inclusive workplace where every employee can do their best work. We partner closely with business leaders to deliver people programs that support Amazon's long-term goals, and we pride ourselves on tackling tough problems with creativity and rigor. As we continue to grow, we are focused on scaling our processes and raising the bar on the employee experience. If you want to be part of a collaborative group that values trust, candid feedback, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in employee relations, labor relations, human relations or labor/employment law
- Experience as an HR specialist, HR generalist (e.g., HR Business Partner or HR Partner), HR manager, or in HR program roles
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences
- Experience creating and implementing large-scale organizational programs
- Experience analyzing HR data and translating metrics into actionable workforce strategies
- Experience supporting large hourly workforces
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience delivering complex, data-driven recommendations to senior leaders

jobs.title: Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS) (m/f)
jobs.description:
Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
Job ID: 10541583 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In France, we deliver that experience across more than 15,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store.

The ISX Regional Program Manager, France owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole French network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.

This is not only a field-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the entire France network at once: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in France, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on-the-ground insight into lasting structural improvement.

This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager for France and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the in-store returns experience in France across ~17,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types.
• Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.
• Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most.
• Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.
• Deploy network-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market.
• Shape strategy from the field. Turn on-the-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start.
• Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership.
• Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the French market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy.

A day in the life

You start the week by reviewing performance data for France and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the French rollout of a new signage standard and a store-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most.

About the team

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end-to-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse-logistics networks in retail.

Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once.

Our culture is hands-on, data-driven, and high-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works - because the best decisions about in-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand.

In addition, the candidate may be eligible to participate in a restricted stock unit scheme operated independently by Amazon.com Inc. in USA.

Your recruiting team will share final salary and any restricted stock unit scheme if applicable, depending on skills and requirements.

Basic Qualifications

- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading process improvements

The Amazon Robotics Supply Chain team provides strategic sourcing for a portfolio of robotic technologies and is responsible for delivering new products by enabling the right suppliers and technologies, and getting the right materials at the right cost to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.

The NPI Supply Chain Product Management team develops supply chain strategies for new Fulfillment Tech and Robotics products from concept to general availability. jobs.title: Security Engineer, Detection and Response
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.




We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion.




You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next.




We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up.

 - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety.

 - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful.

 - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements.

 - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

 - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality.

 - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response.
   




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.
   
   - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role.

jobs.title: Tekniker
jobs.description:
Vi søger en en tekniker til automationsopgaver i produktionsvirksomhed – hos en af vores faste industrikunder i Hedensted. Du vil indgå i vores faste serviceteam, hvor du primært får service- og optimeringsopgaver, men kan også deltage i projekter

Om jobbet

Kundens maskinpark omfatter alt fra gamle maskiner med relæstyring til nye produktionsanlæg med PLC, HMI og robotter. Du arbejder med alt fra fejlfinding på eksisterende anlæg til design og programmering af nye styringer – og både med el, mekanik og pneumatik. Du skal derfor trives med praktiske opgaver, hvor du indimellem får snavsede fingre. Vi forbereder løbende kundens produktionsanlæg med fokus på sikkerhed, driftsoptimering og betjening – og fungerer som kundens tætte rådgiver.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet elektriker, tekniker eller lign. og har erfaring med eller flair for PLC-programmering; gerne Rockwell og Siemens. Du har den rette indstilling, bidrager positivt og tager ansvar for opgaven, indtil den er løst. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og holder den gode tone – og er derudover mødestabil.

Kjærgaard tilbyder dig

Du får en spændende stilling i en lille afdeling med ordnede forhold, kompetence kollegaer og gode muligheder for personlig udvikling i et selvstændigt og udfordrende miljø. Efter endt oplæring skal du deltage i vores vagtordning (ca. hver 8-10. uge). Du kommer til at arbejde i et uformelt miljø, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, kvalitet og faglig stolthed højt. Du får en central rolle i vores værksted og bliver en del af et stærkt hold.

  • et alsidigt job hvor du både arbejder med montage, service og tilpasning

  • frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at præge din hverdag

  • et fagligt stærkt miljø med gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

  • en arbejdsplads hvor vi prioriterer trivsel og ordnede forhold

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Du skal kunne identificere dig i overensstemmelse med vores værdisæt K7.

Ansøgning og CV

Vi arbejder på at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt og tager ansøgere ind løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte divisionschef Michael Haislund på mih@kia.dk eller 4080 0097.

Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på “Søg stillingen”-knappen til højre. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt
jobs.description:
Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt

Er du detaljeorienteret, serviceminded og god til at holde mange bolde i luften?

Hos Smag & Slægt søger vi en engageret Selskabskoordinator på fuld tid, som brænder for at skabe den bedste oplevelse for vores gæster – længe før de træder ind ad døren.

Du bliver den gennemgående kontaktperson for vores selskaber og arrangementer. Fra første tilbud til den endelige bekræftelse og opfølgning sikrer du, at alle detaljer er på plads, og at både gæster og kollegaer føler sig i trygge hænder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud og bekræftelser på selskaber og arrangementer.

  • Opfølgning på eksisterende og kommende selskaber.

  • Håndtering af gæstehenvendelser via mail og kontortelefon.

  • Oversættelse og korrekturlæsning af materiale på engelsk.

  • Daglig administration af vores bookingsystemer

  • Betjening af vagttelefonen

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkken, Front of House og salgsafdelingen for at sikre en gnidningsfri afvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er struktureret og har sans for detaljen.

  • Har erfaring med administration, booking eller koordinering – gerne fra restaurations-, hotel- eller eventbranchen.

  • Trives med kundekontakt og sætter en ære i at yde en professionel service.

  • Kommunikerer på dansk og har gode engelskkundskaber – både skriftligt og mundtligt.

  • Er fortrolig med IT-systemer og lærer hurtigt nye programmer.

  • Bevarer overblikket, også når tempoet er højt.

Din arbejdsdag

Du får en fast kontorplads, men ikke fast arbejdstid hos Smag & Slægt. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for koordineringen af vores selskaber og arrangementer. Her håndterer du bookingforespørgsler, udarbejder tilbud, følger op på gæster og sikrer, at alle detaljer er på plads inden afviklingen.

Selvom din primære arbejdsplads er kontoret, skal du forvente at være en synlig del af huset ved større arrangementer. Her hjælper du med koordinering og fungerer som bindeled mellem gæsterne og vores drift, så arrangementerne forløber professionelt og gnidningsfrit.

Det er en stilling for dig, der motiveres af at skabe struktur, tage ansvar og være med til at levere oplevelser, hvor intet er overladt til tilfældighederne.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

  • Fuldtidsstilling

  • Primær arbejdstid er kl. 12.00–20.00.

  • Fri hver anden weekend.

  • Der må forventes fleksibilitet i forbindelse med større arrangementer, samt deltagelse i vagttelefonordningen efter nærmere aftale.

  • Fast arbejdsplads hos Smag & Slægt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor kontaktflade.

  • Et passioneret team med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og gæsteoplevelser.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor ordentlighed, værtskab og gastronomi går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og CV til os. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Software Tester & Quality Specialist – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Software Tester & Quality Specialist who likes to make a difference! 

Job description: 

As a Software Tester & Quality Specialist in the Quality Management team, you will work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers to help ensure the quality of Nordic RCC's systems and services.

We believe quality starts long before testing begins. Therefore, you will be involved early in the development process, helping teams identify risks, clarify requirements, and prepare testing activities before solutions are implemented. We are in the progress of strengthening our processes and “shifting-left” to achieve this target state.

You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle by reviewing acceptance criteria, creating test data, designing and executing tests, supporting business and operators is test decision and execution, and communicating test results and quality concerns. By working closely with both business and development teams, you will help ensure that quality is built into our solutions from the start.

Your key responsibilities are:

  • Work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Participate in requirement reviews, refinement sessions, and solution discussions to identify risks, gaps, and testing needs as early as possible.

  • Help ensure that testing considerations are included early in development activities and that quality is addressed before implementation is completed.

  • Review requirements, user stories, and solution designs to identify potential risks, gaps, and ambiguities.

  • Identify dependencies, prerequisites, and test data requirements for testing activities.

  • Create, maintain, and analyse test data to support testing across different systems and environments.

  • Design, maintain, and execute test cases and test scenarios based on business and technical requirements.

  • Perform manual and exploratory testing to verify functionality, usability, integrations, and business processes.

  • Identify, document, and follow up on defects and quality issues in collaboration with development teams and business stakeholders.

  • Support investigation and root cause analysis of defects and recurring quality issues.

  • Contribute test cases, effort estimates, dependencies, and risks as input to test planning activities.

  • Document and communicate test results, findings, and quality concerns to support project and test management reporting.

  • Collaborate with developers and test automation specialists to improve testing practices and automated quality controls.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methods, test data practices, and quality assurance processes across Nordic RCC.

Proactive position with outstanding attention to detail and excellent communication skills 

On the personal level you have attention to details, good communication and collaboration skills, analytical thinking and problem solving. You are a self-driven and proactive person, responsible, structured and have a strong focus on finding a solution to the problems at hand.

The ideal candidate is expected to have a minimum of 5 years in manual test experience, an education at BA or MA level in computer science or engineering, but experience from a similar role is more important.

Technical skills: 

  • Collaborate with internal and external development teams in the CI/CD process. 

  • Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc), tools, processes, and development cycles (SDLC). 

  • Experience with test data creation

  • Good understanding of test automation

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • ISTQB certification or equivalent 

  • Experience with test management tools - Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

Employment conditions 

You will join a team of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 22 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note: The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 1st November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Håkon Rosenaa Nystad, Manager, Quality Management, hny@nordic-rcc.net.

jobs.title: Chef for Trading afdeling, Meldgaard Miljø, Miljøpladser, Kolding
jobs.description:
Meldgaard har i mange år sorteret og håndteret affald, jord og genbrugsprodukter. I dag har vi miljøcentre/modtageanlæg i bl.a. Kolding, Klintholm, Herning, Aabenraa og posesortering i Aalborg. 
Afdelingerne har været igennem en kraftig udvikling med masser af nye aktiviteter i en spændende branche. 
Hovedaktiviteterne på pladserne er håndtering af jord, have-/parkaffald, træ og øvrige affaldsfraktioner, der kommer ind på de forskellige pladser. 
Vi har en uformel omgangstone med gensidig respekt for hinanden og har med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding tæt kontakt med alle modtageanlæg samt vores hovedkontor i Aabenraa. Vi er et stærkt team med en ambition om at have tilfredse kunder og levere kvalitet hver gang.

Om jobbet
Som chef for Trading (træ, metal m.m.) får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse og videreudvikling af afdelingen. Du leder et mindre team og står for styring og koordinering af samarbejdet med kunder, samarbejdspartnere og relevante specialister.

Der er tale om et forretningsområde i vækst, og du får en central rolle i både den strategiske og kommercielle udvikling af området.

Stillingen er placeret i Kolding, og du refererer direkte til direktøren for området. For den rette kandidat vil stillingen på sigt kunne medføre deltagelse i chefgruppen i Meldgaard-koncernen. 

Om dig
Vi søger en leder, der kan være det stabile omdrejningspunkt i en travl hverdag. Du bevarer overblikket, skaber struktur og sætter en tydelig retning, samtidig med at du bidrager med positiv energi og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejderne trives og udvikler sig.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende lederstilling - dog betyder det rigtige mindset mere end tidligere titel 
  • Har stærke kommercielle kompetencer og en veludviklet købmandsmæssig forståelse 
  • Er en dygtig leder, der kan skabe engagement og følgeskab 
  • Trives med ansvar og evner at skabe struktur i komplekse processer 
  • Er resultatorienteret og motiveres af at udvikle forretning

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du:

  • Kan sætte en tydelig retning og sikre opfølgning på mål og aktiviteter 
  • Er stærk i relationer og samarbejde med både kunder, leverandører og kolleger 
  • Har gennemslagskraft og naturlig autoritet 
  • Kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når tempoet er højt 
  • Bidrager aktivt til en positiv kultur og et godt arbejdsmiljø

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold i en velkonsolideret familievirksomhed med over 55 års erfaring. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte direktør Henrik Meldgaard pr. mail hm@meldgaard.com eller send os din ansøgning via Ansøg senest 22. oktober 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project - Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs
jobs.employer: DTU Afdelingen for Uddannelse og Studerende
jobs.description:
Would you like to contribute to the development of DTU’s educational offers? Do you want to help shape the future of European higher education and collaborate with colleagues and partners across Europe?

The Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS) at DTU is looking for a proactive Project Manager to join the Office of International Education as Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project, a newly awarded 24-month EU-funded project focused on the European Degree Label.

In this role you will help translate new European educational frameworks into practice and support their implementation across DTU, contributing to the continued development and internationalisation of DTU’s educational portfolio.

As Project Manager, you will be at the centre of this work, coordinating partners across Europe while taking responsibility for key training, stakeholder engagement, and implementation activities. Through your work, you will help strengthen DTU’s capacity to engage in new forms of European educational collaboration and turn emerging opportunities into lasting value for DTU and its students.

The job
You will join the Office of International Education, as part of the Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS), which has approximately 120 employees and is responsible for developing and supporting DTU’s educational processes, with a strong focus on our students.

As our new Project Manager, you will coordinate the EuroTeQ Pathway Project from planning and reporting, to partner coordination and delivery of key activities.

This is not a conventional project management position. You will also take an active role in developing the project’s content, leading training and stakeholder activities, and strengthening DTU’s understanding of the European Degree Label and its implications in a Danish context. You will work closely with consortium partners and DTU colleagues, while taking responsibility for the quality and delivery of the project activities within your remit.

The role offers an opportunity to combine international project leadership with educational development and stakeholder engagement, while helping translate European developments into value for DTU and its educational portfolio. We anticipate 5-10 travel days a year.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Coordinate the overall project plan, including timelines, milestones, budget, risks, and dependencies across the four work packages.
  • Coordinate consortium partners and EU project reporting, ensuring timely delivery of project outputs and milestones
  • Lead the development and implementation of key project activities, including training, communication, and stakeholder events.
  • Organise and facilitate the national stakeholder workshop and contribute to the project’s national roadmap.
  • Build and maintain relationships with national and international stakeholders across higher education, quality assurance, and policy.
  • Strengthen DTU’s institutional understanding of the European Degree Label and translate relevant project outcomes into value for DTU’s educational development.

Knowledge of Danish is not required for the position. However, as much of DTU's internal administration is conducted in Danish, you should expect to encounter Danish in larger meetings and institutional contexts.

Our expectations of you
You have a university degree and, ideally, experience from the education sector or another publicly funded organization, with experience in project management.

We would like you to:
  • Have a proactive and self-driven approach, with a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative, move activities forward independently, and know when to seek input and involve relevant colleagues
  • Seek out effective collaboration and cross-functional coordination
  • Be able to follow and devise formalised processes
  • Are able to familiarise yourself with study regulations and the legal framework in the education sector, for example, Knowledge of European higher education, particularly quality assurance, accreditation, and/or cross-border regulatory frameworks. Familiarity with frameworks such as the European Approach for Quality Assurance of Joint Programmes or EQAR would be an advantage.
  • Experience planning and delivering stakeholder events, from initial concept and logistics through to facilitation, delivery, and follow-up.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Monday, 12 October 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Director of International Education Morten Overgaard, +45 2112 9850.

For specific questions about the tasks for this role or the broader project, please contact International Programme Manager Paige Daly, +45 2365 2213.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in ‘Experimental Nanooptics’.
jobs.description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Nano Optics (www.sdu.dk/nano-optics) invites applications for an Associate Professor position in ‘Experimental Nano-Optics’. The starting date is Feb 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The successful candidate is expected to conduct cutting-edge experimental research within nano-optics involving advanced optical characterization of localized and propagating strongly enhanced and confined electromagnetic excitations with the state-of-the-art amplitude and phase-resolved near-field microscope available (NeaSpec). The near-field characterization is expected to be complemented with other optical characterization techniques as well as with performing advanced electromagnetic modelling. The candidate should have documented teaching experience at both BSc and MSc levels along with the corresponding teaching portfolio.

The application material should include a detailed motivation and an outline of the research activities that are to be pursued. In their applications, applicants should highlight their ten most significant journal publications, detailing also their author contributions. Applicants who wish to be considered should provide a link to a fully-updated ResearcherID (www.researcherid.com). The application material should also include detailed accounts on supervision and teaching experience.

The prospective candidates should have a Ph.D. degree in physics, preferably within nano-optics, and documented research experience in the aforementioned experimental techniques. They are expected to have a notable international profile, strong record of research publications, and demonstrated exceptional potential to excel in scientific research. We expect the candidate to actively engage in the development of academic research, conducting vigorous fund raising activities, and educational environment at the Centre for Nano Optics.

The candidate is expected to teach and instruct both graduate and undergraduet students as well as supervise bachelor and master projects. Furthermore, the candicate is expected to contribute actively to young-researcher education through supervision of Ph.D. students and postdoctorial researchers. 

For further information about the position and research infrastructure as well as Centre for Nano Optics, contact Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Read more on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger

Contact information
For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci.

Please be aware that we will not accept any email applications, as all applications must be submitted through the SDU online recruitment system.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Research plan for the position in question (max. 2 pages). 
    Upload in the field called "Project description". 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, external funding etc.

  • Verified copies of official Certificates/Diplomas (BSc, MSc and PhD) 

  • List of publications with most relevant publications highlighted.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers, who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected.

jobs.description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers
After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

jobs.title: Norwegian or Swedish speaking insurance sales agent (Norwegian market)
jobs.description:
Do you like to challenge and are you fluent in Norwegian and/or Swedish and have a profound understanding for the Norwegian market?
- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurance solutions to existing customers in the financial sector. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone. It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.


Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales/telemarketing from a previous job
 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.

- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

 

Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to send your resumé and an application marked "Norwegian sales agent".

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til automatisering og forretningsudvikling
jobs.description:
Bliv driftschefens højre hånd hos Holstebro Vægtservice.

Vi har vejet Danmark siden 1977, alt fra fisk til fyldte lastbiler. Nu bygger vi virksomheden op på ny: mere digital, mere struktureret og klar til vækst. 

Til det søger vi en studerende, der vil arbejde tæt sammen med driftschefen om at udvikle forretningen. Vejen fra idé til handling er kort, og ansvaret er større, end studenterjobs normalt byder på. Du er også velkommen til at bruge HOVA som case i dit semesterprojekt, bachelor eller speciale.

Det praktiske

8 til 15 timer om ugen, tilpasset dit semester. Timeløn efter kvalifikationer.

Forventet start hurtigst muligt. Typisk 1 til 2 faste dage i Holstebro, resten aftaler vi, når du kender dit skema. Vi ligger cirka 30 minutter fra Herning ad motorvejen.

Din første opgave

Når du er sat ind i virksomheden, bliver din første opgave at undersøge, hvordan vi kan effektivisere og måske automatisere processen omkring salg af labels til kunder. Herfra er du med til selv at pege på, hvilke processer vi lettest kan effektivisere og få mest værdi ud af.

Opgaverne

  • Udvikle webshop og hjemmeside: oprette produkter, forbedre indhold og skabe mersalg

  • Producere SoMe-indhold, der viser, hvad vi laver

  • Drive igangsatte initiativer helt i mål

  • Undersøge og præsentere processer og struktur, så forretningen kan skalere

  • Teste og bygge automatiseringer med AI, Make eller N8N, og finde ud af, hvad der faktisk virker


I starten fokuserer vi mest på de tre første, men løbende udvikles dit ansvarsområde, som du starter og udvikler dig.

Du kommer også med teknikerne ud til kunderne for at se hvad vi laver og giver en hånd på værkstedet, når fx. ordrer skal pakkes. 

Hvem er du?

  • Du læser fx BDE eller ITKO i Herning, eller noget der ligner

  • Du er nysgerrig og arbejdsom, og du får ting færdige, ikke kun startet

  • Du tør træffe beslutninger og stå på mål for dem

  • Du behøver ikke kunne kode, men AI skal vække din nysgerrighed. Kender du Make eller N8N, er det et plus

  • Du behøver ikke vide noget om vægte. Det kommer.

Det får du

  • Reelt ansvar: egne projekter og direkte samarbejde med driftschefen. Dine beslutninger kan ses i forretningen, ikke i et slidedeck

  • Fleksible timer: timetallet følger dit semester, og der er plads til at skrue ned op til eksamen

  • HOVA som case: brug os i semesterprojekter, bachelor eller speciale

  • Læring på tværs: strategi, drift, salg, marketing og teknik i samme uge

  • En arbejdsplads, ikke kun en skærm: opgaverne løses primært hos os i Holstebro, men fleksibilitet er en nøgleværdi, og vi finder en model, der passer med dit studie

Hvorfor Holstebro Vægtservice?

Vi er et lille team, og i dag en del af VF Stålindustri. Vores kunder spænder fra
fiskeindustri og landbrug til produktion, og fælles for dem er, at intet må veje forkert. Vi står midt i en rigtig spændende periode i virksomhedens historie, og du kan være med til at forme den.

jobs.title: Vi søger pumpechauffør til Unicon i Avedøre eller Herfølge
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med store maskiner, tage ansvar på komplekse byggeprojekter og være den, der får betonen sikkert frem til målet?

Hos Unicon søger vi en pumpechauffør til vores team i Avedøre eller Herfølge. Har du den rette erfaring, tekniske forståelse og motivation, hjælper vi dig eventuelt med det nødvendige kørekort og de relevante certifikater til et job, hvor du både får udfordringer og kommer hjem hver dag. I videoen nederst kan du se eksempler på det udstyr, du skal køre og betjene.

Du kan naturligvis være Pumpechauffør i dag, men du kan lige så godt være uddannet maskinfører eller have tilsvarende erfaring. Du kan også være i entreprenørbranchen, betonbranchen eller landbruget. Det vigtigste er, at du trives med store maskiner, kan tage ansvar og bevare overblikket, når opgaverne bliver komplekse.

 

Du får ansvar for en af byggepladsens vigtigste opgaver

 

Som pumpechauffør hos Unicon er du specialist på byggepladsen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger, betonchauffører, byggeledere og kunder for at sikre, at støbningen bliver gennemført sikkert, effektivt og i den rigtige kvalitet.

Du er med til at sikre, at betonen bliver leveret og pumpet i den rette hastighed, så støbningen forløber som planlagt, og kunden får det resultat, der er aftalt. Det kræver både teknisk forståelse, gode samarbejdsevner og evnen til at træffe beslutninger, når forholdene ændrer sig.

Som pumpechauffør kører du pumpebilen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen. Her placerer du udstyret sikkert – ofte under trange forhold – og opsætter pumpen, så den passer til den konkrete opgave. Når støbningen går i gang, betjener du det avancerede pumpeudstyr og fungerer som kundens sparringspartner på pladsen.

Unicon er markedsleder i Danmark, og du bliver en del af projekter, der sætter varige spor i samfundet – fra boligbyggeri og infrastruktur til større erhvervs- og anlægsprojekter.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Din vej til jobbet kan være forskellig, men vi forestiller os, at du opfylder mindst ét af disse kriterier:

  • Uddannet maskinfører eller tilsvarende erfaring

  • Erfaring med beton- og støbearbejde

  • Erfaring med større maskiner og processer fra f.eks. landbrug eller industri

  • Erfaring med kraner, entreprenørmateriel eller andet teknisk udstyr

  • Relevant erfaring fra entreprenør- eller byggebranchen

Lige så vigtigt er det, at du:

  • Trives med ansvar og selvstændige beslutninger

  • Har en god teknisk og mekanisk forståelse

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og serviceminded

  • Kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt

  • Arbejder sikkert, struktureret og løsningsorienteret

Stort kørekort og EU-bevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du den rette profil, tilbyder vi den nødvendige oplæring samt mulighed for at opnå relevante kørekort og certifikater.

 

Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne udstyr og spændende arbejdsopgaver

  • Mulighed for at få relevante kørekort og certifikater gennem Unicon

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og en unik holdånd

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

En arbejdsform med frihed, ansvar og gode muligheder for afspadsering

 

Som pumpechauffør arbejder du ikke efter et traditionelt 7-15-skema.

Når en større støbning er i gang, bliver vi på pladsen, til opgaven er løst. Derfor vil du opleve perioder med lange arbejdsdage og en del overarbejde. Til gengæld får du både den løn, der følger med, og gode muligheder for at opspare afspadsering – ofte i form af hele fridage.

Mange af vores pumpechauffører sætter pris på friheden og variationen i jobbet. Nogle dage er kortere, andre længere, men fælles for dem alle er, at man arbejder sammen om at få opgaven sikkert i mål.

Hvis du trives med ansvar, variation og tanken om at gøre arbejdet færdigt frem for at kigge på klokken, vil du passe godt ind hos os.

 

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig – også selvom du ikke opfylder alle kravene på papiret.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Ib Jepsen på telefon 2484 0935.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.
